title.zh: 全球焦点

title.en: House Democrat to launch challenge to Trump’s ‘Lake America’ order – US politics live
title.zh: 众议院民主党人将发起挑战，反对特朗普的“美国湖”命令——美国政治直播

summary.en: Debbie Dingell plans to introduce her ‘Hands Off Our Great Lakes Act’ today following the president’s latest escalation in the US-Canada trade war. Canada erects a giant ‘Lake Ontario’ sign as the spat with Trump over the name escalates.
summary.zh: 在总统与加拿大的贸易战最新升级之后，黛比·丁格尔计划于今日推出她的“勿碰我们的五大湖法案”。加拿大竖起巨大的“安大略湖”标志，与特朗普就名称的争执升级。

body.en: Debbie Dingell plans to introduce her ‘Hands Off Our Great Lakes Act’ today following president’s latest escalation in US-Canada trade war Canada erects giant ‘Lake Ontario’ sign as spat with Trump over name escalates Sign up for US Breaking News emails Donald Trump ⁠on Sunday said NBC ’s Kristen ‌Welker – host of Meet the Press – should face “rebuke or punishment” from the Federal Communications Commission (FCC). Welker, during a live segment for a local Washington DC affiliate, described the success record of political candidates whom the president had endorsed as “mixed”. The segment aired prior to Sunday’s edition of Meet the Press. Continue reading...
body.zh: 黛比·丁格尔 (Debbie Dingell) 计划在今天推出“放开我们的五大湖法案”，此前总统美加贸易战最新升级，加拿大竖立巨大的“安大略湖”标志，与特朗普因名字升级而发生口角。唐纳德·特朗普周日表示，NBC 的《与媒体会面》节目主持人克里斯汀·韦尔克应该面临联邦通信委员会 (FCC) 的“谴责或惩罚”。韦尔克在华盛顿特区当地附属机构的现场直播中，描述了总统认可的政治候选人的成功记录“好坏参半”。该片段在周日版《与媒体见面》之前播出。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the midst of escalating political tensions, Representative Debbie Dingell is introducing legislation to protect the Great Lakes, a proactive step towards de-escalation. This effort to find legislative solutions, rather than mirroring aggressive rhetoric, embodies the pursuit of peace even when faced with contentious disputes.
reflection.zh: 在政治紧张局势不断升级之际，众议员黛比·丁格尔正在提出立法以保护五大湖，这是朝着缓和局势迈出的积极一步。这种寻求立法解决方案而非效仿激进言论的努力，体现了即使面对争议性争端，也要追求和平的精神。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Badenoch to reshuffle shadow cabinet following Patel and Cleverly resignations
title.zh: 巴登诺赫在帕特尔和克利弗利辞职后重组影子内阁

summary.en: Tory leader expected to install Tom Tugendhat as shadow foreign secretary as Cleverly quits to run for London mayor Kemi Badenoch is to reshuffle her shadow cabinet on Monday, and is expected to install Tom Tugendhat as shadow foreign secretary to replace Priti Patel. Tugendhat, a former security minister, was a...
summary.zh: 保守党领袖预计将任命汤姆·图根哈特为影子外交大臣，因克利弗利辞职竞选伦敦市长。凯米·巴登诺赫将于周一重组她的影子内阁，并预计将任命汤姆·图根哈特为影子外交大臣，接替普里蒂·帕特尔。图根哈特曾任安全部长，是一名领导候选人，此前曾拒绝加入影子内阁。巴登诺赫还预计将接替影子社区大臣詹姆斯·克利弗利，后者已辞去影子内阁职务，竞...

body.en: Tory leader expected to install Tom Tugendhat as shadow foreign secretary as Cleverly quits to run for London mayor Kemi Badenoch is to reshuffle her shadow cabinet on Monday, and is expected to install Tom Tugendhat as shadow foreign secretary to replace Priti Patel. Tugendhat, a former security minister, was a leadership candidate who had previously declined to join the shadow cabinet. Badenoch is also expected to replace James Cleverly, the shadow communities secretary, who has resigned from the shadow cabinet to run for London mayor . Continue reading...
body.zh: 克莱弗利退出竞选伦敦市长，保守党领袖预计任命汤姆·图根哈特为影子外交大臣凯米·巴德诺克将于周一改组影子内阁，并预计任命汤姆·图根哈特为影子外交大臣，以取代普里蒂·帕特尔。前安全部长图根哈特是领导候选人，此前曾拒绝加入影子内阁。巴德诺克还有望接替影子社区秘书詹姆斯·克莱弗利(James Cleverly)，后者已辞去影子内阁职务，竞选伦敦市长。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Political leadership often involves navigating shifts and changes, as seen with Kemi Badenoch's shadow cabinet reshuffling. The principle of righteous rule calls for integrity and justice in all governance, even in the internal workings of a party. May leaders seek wisdom to govern with fairness and serve the common good.
reflection.zh: 政治领导力常常需要应对变动和调整，正如凯米·巴登诺赫重组影子内阁一样。公义治理的原则要求在所有治理中都秉持正直和公正，即使是在政党内部运作中。愿领导者寻求智慧，以公平治理，服务共同利益。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: US man says ‘hold tight’ to loved ones after wife and toddler killed by lightning
title.zh: 美国男子称在妻子和幼儿被闪电击毙后要“紧紧抓住”所爱之人

summary.en: Kameron Glasgow of Florida honored his wife Kenya and daughter Kennedi at a local vigil after last week's tragedy. A Florida man whose wife and toddler daughter were killed by a lightning strike while he was near them recently implored people to “hold … tight” to their loved ones. Kameron Glasgow made that arresting...
summary.zh: 佛罗里达州的卡梅隆·格拉斯哥在上周的悲剧发生后，于当地守夜活动中悼念了他的妻子肯尼亚和女儿肯尼迪。一位妻子和年幼女儿在他身边被闪电击毙的佛罗里达男子最近恳求人们“紧紧抓住”他们的亲人。卡梅隆·格拉斯哥在上周末的一次聚会上，在悼念他妻子肯尼亚和两岁女儿肯尼迪的活动中，向当地媒体发表了这番令人震惊的言论。她们于8月23日因...

body.en: Kameron Glasgow of Florida honors wife Kenya and daughter Kennedi at local vigil after last week’s tragedy A Florida man whose wife and toddler daughter were killed by a lightning strike while he was near them recently has implored people to “hold … tight” to their loved ones. Kameron Glasgow made that arresting remark to local media at a weekend gathering honoring the memories of his wife, Kenya, and two-year-old daughter Kennedi after they died on 23 August from an exceedingly rare cause. Continue reading...
body.zh: 佛罗里达州卡梅隆·格拉斯哥在上周的悲剧发生后，在当地守夜纪念妻子肯尼亚和女儿肯尼迪。佛罗里达州一名男子的妻子和蹒跚学步的女儿最近在他附近时被雷击身亡，他恳求人们“紧紧抓住”他们的亲人。卡梅伦·格拉斯哥在周末聚会上向当地媒体发表了这一引人注目的言论，纪念他的妻子肯尼亚和两岁的女儿肯尼迪，他们于 8 月 23 日因极其罕见的原因去世。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The suddenness of lightning strikes can leave survivors reeling, grappling with a reality that feels incomprehensible. In the face of such profound loss, the shortest verse in the Bible, "Jesus wept," offers a powerful model. It shows that grief is not a sign of weak faith, but a deeply human response that even the divine shares.
reflection.zh: 闪电的突然袭击会让幸存者晕头转向，难以理解现实。面对如此巨大的损失，《圣经》中最短的一节经文“耶稣哭了”提供了一个有力的榜样。它表明悲伤并非信心的软弱，而是神也同样分担的深刻人性回应。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Iran hostilities flare after US strike in strait of Hormuz – Middle East crisis live
title.zh: 伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡遭美袭击后敌意升级——中东危机直播

summary.en: The US targeted Iran’s Larak Island in the first exchange of fire in over a month, leading to retaliatory attacks against US forces in the region. The UAE condemned an Iranian drone attack intercepted over its territorial waters as a 'dangerous escalation.'
summary.zh: 美国在超过一个月来首次交火中袭击了伊朗的拉拉克岛，引发了针对该地区美军的报复性袭击。阿联酋谴责了在其领海截获的一架伊朗无人机袭击事件，称其为“危险的升级”。

body.en: US targets Iran’s Larak Island in first exchange of fire in more than a month, sparking reprisals against US forces in the region US strikes Iranian launchers in strait of Hormuz, prompting Iranian retaliatory attacks The UAE condemned an Iranian drone attack intercepted over its territorial waters, calling it a “dangerous escalation”. In a statement on X, the UAE’s foreign ministry “strongly condemned the hostile Iranian attack on the country involving a drone that was intercepted by air defence systems over UAE territorial waters”. The ministry also said the UAE reserved the “full and legitimate right to respond”. See post at 09.51 for more details. Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国以伊朗拉拉克岛为目标，这是一个多月以来的首次交火，引发对该地区美军的报复 美国在霍尔木兹海峡袭击伊朗发射器，引发伊朗报复性袭击 阿联酋谴责伊朗在其领海拦截的无人机袭击，称其为“危险的升级”。在 X 的一份声明中，阿联酋外交部“强烈谴责伊朗对该国的敌对攻击，其中一架无人机在阿联酋领海被防空系统拦截”。该部还表示，阿联酋保留“充分且合法的回应权利”。更多详情请参阅 09.51 的帖子。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news from the Strait of Hormuz speaks of escalating hostilities, a dangerous cycle where one act of aggression prompts another. In such moments, the ancient wisdom to 'not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good' calls us to a higher path. May wisdom guide leaders away from further conflict and toward de-escalation.
reflection.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡传来的消息令人担忧，敌对行动不断升级，形成了一个危险的循环，一次侵略行为引发另一次。在这样的时刻，古老的智慧“不要被邪恶打败，反要用善来打败邪恶”呼唤我们走上一条更高的道路。愿智慧引导领导者远离进一步的冲突，走向缓和局势。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Nearly 20 people still missing after ferry capsizes ⁠off northern Cyprus
title.zh: 塞浦路斯北部近海渡轮倾覆，近20人仍失踪

summary.en: Divers are joining search teams to scour deep waters for survivors after a ferry capsized off the coast of northern Cyprus. Eight people have been confirmed dead, and nearly 20 are still missing. The ferry, carrying 267 people, took on water and flipped on Sunday near Kyrenia, with survivors clinging to the hull until...
summary.zh: 在塞浦路斯北部近海一艘渡轮倾覆后，潜水员正加入搜救队伍，在深水中搜寻幸存者。目前已确认8人死亡，近20人仍下落不明。这艘载有267人的渡轮于周日（日期未提供）在吉尔尼亚附近海域进水并倾覆，幸存者一度攀附在船体上等待救援。

body.en: Divers join search teams scouring deep waters for ⁠any survivors, with eight people so far confirmed to have died Nearly 20 people are still missing after a ferry capsized ⁠off northern Cyprus , killing at least eight, as divers join search teams scouring deep waters for ⁠any survivors. The double-hulled ⁠ferry ​with 267 people onboard took in water and flipped over on Sunday just off the port city ⁠of Kyrenia, leaving survivors clinging to the upturned hull. They were rescued by passing vessels and members of the coastguard. Continue reading...
body.zh: 潜水员加入深海搜寻幸存者，迄今已确认 8 人死亡 一艘渡轮在塞浦路斯北部海域倾覆，造成至少 8 人死亡，潜水员加入深海搜寻幸存者，目前仍有近 20 人失踪。周日，这艘载有 267 人的双壳渡轮在港口城市凯里尼亚附近进水并翻覆，幸存者紧紧抓住翻倒的船体。他们被路过的船只和海岸警卫队成员救起。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The image of survivors clinging to an overturned hull, with many still lost in the deep waters off Kyrenia, evokes a profound sense of vulnerability and the desperate search for safety. In moments of such crisis, we are reminded of the ancient words that God is our refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble. May those searching find the...
reflection.zh: 在吉尔尼亚海岸外，幸存者紧抓倾覆的船体，许多人仍在深海中失踪，这一幕令人深感脆弱，也凸显了对安全的迫切渴求。在这样的危机时刻，我们被提醒古老的应许：雅伟是我们的避难所，是患难中随时的帮助。愿搜救人员能找到失踪者，愿所有受影响的人都能找到慰藉和希望。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Dolly Parton laid to rest alongside husband in Nashville
title.zh: Dolly Parton 与丈夫一同安葬在纳什维尔

summary.en: A private family funeral was held for the singer who died at the age of 80. She was laid to rest next to her late husband, Carl Dean, in Nashville.
summary.zh: 这位80岁的歌手举行了私人家庭葬礼。她被安葬在纳什维尔，长眠于她已故的丈夫卡尔·迪恩（Carl Dean）身旁。

body.en:
The singer had a private family funeral in Nashville on Friday, following her death earlier in the week at the age of 80.

She has been placed next to her late husband, Carl Dean, at Woodlawn Memorial Park and Mausoleum in the Tennessee city.

Lainey Parton posted an emotional tribute , external a day after the burial, saying: "It still doesn't feel real that she's gone. I'm going to miss her voice, her laugh, her hugs, and just knowing she was there."

She referred to Parton as "granny" and wrote: "Because she couldn't have kids of her own, she always made us feel like we were hers. She loved us that way, and I'll forever be grateful for that."

Lainey remembered: "From the time I was little, my granny always had a way of making me feel like I was enough. She never made my dreams feel too big or made me feel like I couldn't do something. She believed in me before I even knew how to believe in myself."

Lainey also remembered how Parton had supported her through beauty school, explaining: "She didn't just tell me to chase my dreams, she helped me get there."

"I feel incredibly lucky that I got to call her my granny," she added. "Thank you for always believing in me, loving me, and making me feel like I could do anything. I love you, Granny. Always."

An obituary posted by Woodlawn Memorial Park and Mausoleum , external remembered "her timeless music and prolific songwriting, but also her wit, warmth, and kindness that made us all feel like family".

It continued: "Dolly Parton's legacy is one of love, kindness, and resilience. With a seven-decade career, she inspired multiple generations of artists and fans with her music and an unwavering commitment to making the world a better place."

It added: "In lieu of flowers, the family asks for donations to be made to Dolly Parton's Imagination Library." The Imagination Library was Parton's scheme to send free books to young children.

Amelia Young, a reporter for Nashville's NewsChannel 5, posted photos of flowers , external and a book of condolence at the tomb, which features a brass plaque showing Parton and Dean's names and engravings of their childhood homes.

On Saturday, one of Parton's nieces, Jada Star, performed as part of a tribute concert at Nashville's Grand Ole Opry House, regarded as the home of country music.

Star performed her song The Orchard, which she recorded with her aunt in 2024 on the album Smoky Mountain DNA: Family, Faith and Fables.

"I am walking around in a fog of sadness, like all of you have," Star posted before the performance alongside a broken heart emoji. "I do not take this honor lightly."

Country superstar Jelly Roll made a surprise appearance during the event's finale - a group performance of Parton's 9 to 5 - while other participants included Carly Pearce, who has...
body.zh: 这位歌手于本周早些时候去世，享年 80 岁，周五在纳什维尔举行了私人家庭葬礼。 她被安置在田纳西州伍德劳恩纪念公园和陵墓的已故丈夫卡尔·迪恩旁边。 葬礼一天后，莱尼·帕顿 (Lainey Parton) 在外部发布了一篇感人的悼念文章，她说：“她去世的感觉仍然不真实。我会想念她的声音、她的笑声、她的拥抱，只是知道她就在那里。” 她称帕顿为“奶奶”，并写道：“因为她无法拥有自己的孩子，所以她总是让我们感觉我们是她的。她就是这样爱我们，我将永远感激这一点。” 莱尼回忆道：“从我很小的时候起，我的奶奶总是有办法让我觉得我已经足够了。她从来没有让我的梦想变得太大，或者让我觉得我不能做某事。在我什至不知道如何相信自己之前，她就相信了我。” 莱尼还记得帕顿如何支持她完成美容学校的学业，并解释说：“她不仅告诉我要追逐我的梦想，她还帮助我实现了目标。” “我感到非常幸运，我可以称她为我的奶奶，”她补充道。 “谢谢你一直相信我，爱我，让我觉得我可以做任何事。我爱你，奶奶。永远。” 伍德劳恩纪念公园和陵墓发布的讣告中写道，“她永恒的音乐和多产的歌曲创作，还有她的智慧、温暖和善良，让我们感觉就像家人一样”。 它继续说道：“多莉·帕顿的遗产是爱、善良和坚韧。在七十年的职业生涯中，她用她的音乐和让世界变得更美好的坚定承诺激励了多代艺术家和歌迷。” 它补充说：“家人请求向多莉·帕顿的想象力图书馆捐款，以代替鲜花。”想象力图书馆是帕顿向幼儿免费赠送书籍的计划。 纳什维尔新闻频道 5 的记者阿米莉亚·杨 (Amelia Young) 在坟墓上贴出了鲜花、外部和吊唁簿的照片，吊唁簿上有一块黄铜牌匾，上面写着帕顿和迪恩的名字以及他们童年住所的雕刻。 周六，帕顿的一位侄女贾达·斯塔 (Jada Star) 在被视为乡村音乐之乡的纳什维尔大奥普里大剧院 (Grand Ole Opry House) 举行的致敬音乐会中进行了表演。 Star 演唱了她的歌曲《The Orchard》，这是她与姑妈于 2024 年在专辑《Smoky Mountain DNA：Family、Faith and Fables》中录制的歌曲。 “我在悲伤的迷雾中走来走去，就像你们所有人一样，”斯塔在演出前发布了一个心碎的表情符号。 “我不会轻视这一荣誉。” 乡村巨星 Jelly Roll 在活动的最后一场——帕顿朝九晚五的集体表演——中惊喜亮相，而其他参与者包括卡莉·皮尔斯 (Carly Pearce)，她曾...

reflection.en: The news of Dolly Parton's passing and her subsequent burial brings us face-to-face with the universal reality of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that death is a certainty for all, a shared human experience that transcends fame and talent. In this moment of grief, we are called to reflect on the preciousness of life and the hope that lies beyond.
reflection.zh: Dolly Parton 去世并随后安葬的消息，让我们直面死亡这一普遍的现实。希伯来书9:27提醒我们，死亡是所有人的必然归宿，是一种超越名望和才华的共同人生经历。在这个悲伤的时刻，我们被呼召反思生命的宝贵以及超越死亡的盼望。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
title.zh: 美国数周来首次已知袭击，打击拉拉克岛上的伊朗发射器

summary.en: US forces reportedly struck Iranian launchers on Larak Island, marking the first known American strikes on Iran since late July. Iran claimed civilian casualties and vowed retaliation, subsequently launching an alleged attack on US military targets in Jordan, which Jordan's army intercepted.
summary.zh: 据报道，美军袭击了伊朗拉拉克岛上的伊朗发射器，这是自7月下旬以来首次已知的美国对伊朗的袭击。伊朗声称造成平民伤亡并誓言报复，随后对约旦境内的美军目标发动了袭击，但被约旦军队拦截。

body.en:
Iran and the US have traded strikes after American forces attacked two rocket launchers on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz.

The first known US strikes on Iran since late July killed two people and injured two others, according to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), which vowed "response and punishment".

US Central Command (Centcom) said it took "limited, precise action" after observing Iran preparing to "launch rockets and deploy sea mines into the Strait of Hormuz", according to its spokesperson.

Iran said it had struck US military bases in Jordan in response, with Jordan's army saying it had intercepted eight missiles early on Monday morning.

Iran's state TV also said the Iranian army had targeted an air base in the UAE with drones.

However, the UAE's Ministry of Defence denied the reports that Al-Minhad Air Base had been targeted as "unfounded". The UAE did confirm it shot down a drone.

The US strike is the first known attack on Iran since President Donald Trump paused a renewed military campaign in late July.

Larak Island is just offshore from the key port of Bandar Abbas and sits right on the Strait of Hormuz, a vital waterway for global shipping. Some 20% of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas used to travel through before the war began.

Since the conflict began in February, the strait has effectively been closed, causing wild fluctuations in the price of oil on world markets.

Iran is currently demanding that tanker traffic pass by Larak Island for checks and reportedly forcing vessels to pay $2m (£1.5m) to cross.

Iran's Tasnim news agency, which is affiliated with the IRGC, said earlier that the attack on Larak was carried out by drones.

Hours later, Iranian media carried a statement by the IRGC saying it had attacked the US bases of King Hussein and al-Azraq in Jordan with ballistic missiles in response to the Larak Island attack.

Iran's foreign ministry said on Monday it "strongly condemned the American military aggression on Larak", saying the strikes on bases in Jordan were a "legitimate defence".

Meanwhile Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said in a statement quoted by state TV: "We are not seeking war, but we will deliver a decisive response to the aggressors," according to AFP.

Hours after the US strike, Trump posted apparent AI videos on Truth Social showing oil infrastructure exploding.

One was captioned "Kharg Island being blown to smithereens!!!" in reference to a major oil terminal off the coast of Iran which Trump has threatened to take. His post did not elaborate.

The US and Israel launched wide-ranging strikes on Iran on 28 February, with Iran responding by attacking Israel, US bases and allied states in the Gulf, and effectively closing the Strait of Hormuz to marine traffic.

body.zh: 一名美国官员表示，美国军队袭击了伊朗拉拉克岛的两座伊朗发射器，这是自 7 月底以来美国首次对伊朗发动袭击。 英国广播公司美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻援引美国中央司令部发言人蒂姆·霍金斯上校的话说：“据观察，伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）部队准备向霍尔木兹海峡发射带有水雷的火箭。” 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队表示，周日的袭击造成多人死伤，并发誓要“做出回应和惩罚”。据伊朗官方媒体报道，它后来表示已对约旦的美国军事目标发动了袭击。 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队发表声明后不久，约旦军队表示已拦截了八枚导弹。 据国家佩特拉通讯社报道，约旦武装部队在一份声明中援引军方发言人的话称，“防空系统今天星期一黎明拦截了八枚侵犯王国领空的导弹”。 这是自唐纳德·特朗普总统七月下旬暂停新的军事行动以来，美国对伊朗的首次已知袭击。 拉拉克岛位于阿巴斯港主要港口的近海处，坐落在全球航运的重要水道霍尔木兹海峡上。 伊朗目前正在让油轮通过该岛进行检查，据报道，伊朗迫使船只支付 200 万美元（150 万英镑）的费用。 伊斯兰革命卫队发言人侯赛因·莫赫比称这次袭击是“特朗普政权的战略性致命错误”，并表示“敌人将为这种经济和军事领域误判的后果付出代价”。 隶属于伊斯兰革命卫队的伊朗塔斯尼姆通讯社早些时候表示，此次袭击是由无人机实施的。报道称，两人死亡，两人受伤。 几小时后，伊朗媒体发表了伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队的声明，称其针对拉拉克岛袭击事件，使用弹道导弹袭击了美国在约旦的侯赛因国王基地和阿兹拉克基地。 据法新社报道，伊朗革命卫队表示，它造成了“严重破坏”，并瞄准了“技术基础设施、维护设施和敌方战斗机阵地”。 特朗普上周表示，伊朗为封锁霍尔木兹海峡而埋设的所有地雷均已被引爆或清除。他说，伊朗已收到警告，任何部署新水雷的船只都将被摧毁。 伊朗副外长卡泽姆·加里巴迪称特朗普的说法是“宣传”欺骗。 华盛顿于8月24日宣布采取新的制裁行动，旨在进一步孤立德黑兰并扩大对其盟友的二级制裁后，伊朗面临着新的经济压力。 伊朗官员和官方媒体在很大程度上驳斥了这一行动，认为这是美国之前行动的延续……

reflection.en: The reported US strike on Larak Island and Iran's subsequent vow of "response and punishment," followed by an alleged attack on US targets in Jordan, highlight a dangerous cycle. This pattern of action and retaliation echoes the ancient warning that those who live by violence often face its consequences. It reminds us of the profound challenge in breaking...
reflection.zh: 据报道，美国对拉拉克岛的袭击以及伊朗随后“回应和惩罚”的誓言，紧接着对约旦境内美军目标的袭击，凸显了一个危险的循环。这种行动与报复的模式，呼应了古老的警告：那些诉诸暴力的人，往往也会因此而灭亡。这提醒我们，打破以暴制暴的循环是一个深刻的挑战。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: One dead and more than a dozen missing after 'terrifying' flash flood hits Grand Canyon
title.zh: 大峡谷发生“可怕”的洪水，登山者失踪

summary.en: More than 20 people are thought to be unaccounted for after flash flooding on Saturday.
summary.zh: 周六，山洪暴发，据信有20多人失踪。

body.en:
One person has died and 15 remain missing or unaccounted for after flash flooding swept through parts of the Grand Canyon, the National Park Service (NPS) has said.

The flood hit Bright Angel Canyon and the Phantom Ranch area on Saturday afternoon, wiping out footbridges and propelling boulders downstream.

The body of a 46-year-old man was found on Sunday evening near Crystal Rapids along the Colorado River, the park service told CBS News, the BBC's US partner. Sixty-two people have so far been airlifted out of the area.

"The whole thing was terrifying," said Nikki Baggs, 41, who was among those to be airlifted out of the bottom of the Grand Canyon with her two friends.

"It was a beautiful day and then people were screaming, running," she told the BBC.

Baggs said she and her friends had just dropped off their belongings at a cabin in Phantom Ranch - a remote lodge at the bottom of the Grand Canyon - when they decided to venture out to enjoy the nice day. Before they knew it, a flood of water was sweeping through the area.

As soon as the rain hit, Baggs and her friends headed toward higher ground, where they sat at a picnic table, before rangers yelled to them to run again to a different ledge, where they waited with others for hours before they were evacuated at around 21:30 local time.

Baggs said she and her two friends had been looking forward to a steak dinner at Phantom Ranch - but were now just grateful to be alive thanks to a swift response from park rangers.

"It was a really uniquely coordinated effort," she said. "That's what made us feel safe about all of it in an unsafe situation."

Baggs said she and her friends watched from higher ground as bridges were swept away.

The NPS initially said in a press release it was looking for information about more than 20 people who were thought to be missing or unaccounted for. It later revised that number down to "approximately 15". The BBC has reached out to NPS for comment.

It reported that flooding had caused significant damage in some areas and that trails in the area have been closed.

Overnight guest lodgings in the South Rim will be stopped from Monday until further notice as the floods have caused "extensive damage" to the national park's water infrastructure.

The NPS asked anyone who knew of hikers or backpackers who were in the inner canyon along the Bright Angel Creek corridor on Saturday to get in touch.

The NPS also warned that more thunderstorms and heavy rainfall were forecast for Sunday and Monday, which could lead to "additional flash flooding, debris flows, rockfall and changing trail and river conditions".

The Grand Canyon is one of the most popular national parks in the US, with about five million people visiting each year. The Bright Angel trail is its most popular...
body.zh: 山洪席卷大峡谷部分地区后，据信有 20 多人失踪或下落不明。 据国家公园管理局 (NPS) 称，周六当地时间 14:30 左右（英国夏令时 22:30），袭击发生在光明天使峡谷和幻影牧场地区。 迄今为止，已有 62 人被空运出该地区，预计还会有更多人跟进。目前还没有人员受伤的报告。 “整件事太可怕了，”41 岁的尼基·巴格斯 (Nikki Baggs) 说，她是周六与她的两个朋友一起从大峡谷底部被空运出来的人之一。 “那是美好的一天，然后人们尖叫着、奔跑着，”她告诉英国广播公司。 巴格斯说，她和她的朋友们刚刚把行李放在幻影牧场（大峡谷底部的一个偏远小屋）的一间小屋里，然后决定出去享受美好的一天。在他们意识到之前，洪水席卷了整个地区。 雨一落下，巴格斯和她的朋友们就向地势较高的地方走去，她们坐在野餐桌旁，然后护林员向她们喊叫，让她们再次跑到另一个窗台上，她们和其他人在那里等了几个小时，然后在当地时间 21:30 左右被疏散。 巴格斯说，她和她的两个朋友一直期待着在幻影牧场吃牛排晚餐，但现在很庆幸自己还活着，多亏了公园管理员的迅速反应。 “这是一次真正独特的协调努力，”她说。 “这就是让我们在不安全的情况下感到安全的原因。” NPS 表示，洪水对一些地区造成了严重破坏，该地区的步道已关闭。巴格斯说，她和她的朋友们在地势较高的地方看着桥梁被冲走。 它要求任何认识周六在光明天使溪走廊沿线的内峡谷徒步旅行者或背包客的人与我们联系。 它还警告称，预计周日和周一将出现更多雷暴和强降雨，这可能导致“额外的山洪、泥石流、落石以及步道和河流状况的变化”。 大峡谷是美国最受欢迎的国家公园之一，每年约有 500 万人参观。光明天使步道是最受欢迎的徒步路线。

reflection.en: The Grand Canyon, a place of immense natural beauty, can also become a scene of terrifying power, as seen with the recent flash floods. In moments of overwhelming crisis, when the earth itself seems to tremble, we can find refuge and strength in Yahweh. He is our ever-present help in times of trouble, a steadfast anchor amidst the chaos.
reflection.zh: 大峡谷是一个自然美景极其壮丽的地方，但正如最近的洪水所示，它也可能变成一个充满可怕力量的场景。在压倒性的危机时刻，当地球本身似乎在颤抖时，我们可以在雅伟那里找到避难所和力量。祂是我们患难中随时的帮助，是混乱中的坚定锚。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Algeria president seeks death penalty for arsonists after deadly forest fires
title.zh: 阿尔及利亚总统就致命森林火灾寻求对纵火犯判处死刑

summary.en: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has stated his intention to reinstate the death penalty for individuals found guilty of arson, following a series of over 100 wildfires that resulted in at least 12 fatalities. He indicated that investigations into potential foul play would be conducted.
summary.zh: 阿尔及利亚总统阿卜杜勒马吉德·特本表示，在发生导致至少12人死亡的一系列超过100起森林火灾后，他打算恢复对纵火犯的死刑。他表示将进行调查，以查明是否存在人为纵火。

body.en:
Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has said he wants to reinstate the death penalty for arsonists, following a wave of forest fires that have killed at least 12 people.

The president ordered the justice ministry to introduce changes to the criminal law introducing capital punishment for arsonists. Capital punishment remains in the country's penal code for some offences, but no execution has been carried out since 1993.

More than 100 wildfires have been recorded in recent days in the north-east of the country, most of which have been extinguished.

The Algerian president said necessary investigations would be carried out especially in view of the intensity of the fires.

On Sunday, he gave a 15 September deadline for amendments to provide for the death sentence for anyone convicted of intentionally starting a fire in forested areas.

Under the current law, deliberately starting forest fires is punishable by up to 30 years in prison, or life imprisonment in certain cases.

Deadly blazes swept through large swathes of northern Algeria last week, causing widespread destruction, injuring dozens and displacing thousands of people.

The fires erupted amid an intense heatwave in northern Africa, with Algeria and Tunisia particularly affected.

Algerian civil authorities were on Sunday afternoon still battling to battle some of the fires, with the Algerian Press Service noting that 18 out 19 fires that had broken out in the previous 24 hours had been extinguished

The Algerian president ordered that compensation be paid to the families who have been affected, as well as repairs to damaged homes and essential services.

He said there would be investigations into the extent of the damage and losses caused by the fires.

While Algeria regularly experiences forest fires around the summer months, climate change has exacerbated the intensity and severity of recent wildfires in the country.
body.zh: 阿尔及利亚总统阿卜杜勒马吉德·特布恩 (Abdelmadjid Tebboune) 表示，在造成至少 12 人死亡的一波森林火灾之后，他希望恢复对纵火犯的死刑。 总统命令司法部修改刑法，对纵火犯判处死刑。该国刑法中对某些罪行仍保留死刑，但自 1993 年以来尚未执行过死刑。 最近几天，该国东北部发生了100多起山火，其中大部分已被扑灭。 阿尔及利亚总统表示，将进行必要的调查，特别是考虑到火灾的严重程度。 周日，他规定了 9 月 15 日为修改规定的最后期限，规定对在森林地区故意纵火的任何人判处死刑。 根据现行法律，故意引发森林火灾可判处最高 30 年监禁，在某些情况下甚至可判处无期徒刑。 上周，致命大火席卷了阿尔及利亚北部大片地区，造成大面积破坏，造成数十人受伤，数千人流离失所。 大火在北非的强烈热浪中爆发，其中阿尔及利亚和突尼斯受到的影响尤其严重。 周日下午，阿尔及利亚民政当局仍在奋力扑灭部分火灾，阿尔及利亚新闻局指出，过去 24 小时内爆发的 19 起火灾中，18 起已被扑灭 阿尔及利亚总统下令向受影响的家庭提供赔偿，并修复受损房屋和基本服务。 他表示将对火灾造成的损害和损失程度进行调查。 虽然阿尔及利亚在夏季经常发生森林火灾，但气候变化加剧了该国最近发生的野火的强度和严重程度。

reflection.en: In the face of devastating wildfires that claimed lives, President Tebboune's call for the death penalty highlights a deep human yearning for justice and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true justice is intertwined with mercy and humility, urging us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh.
reflection.zh: 面对夺走生命的毁灭性森林大火，特本总统呼吁判处死刑，这凸显了人类对公正和问责的深切渴望。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，真正的公义与怜悯和谦卑相伴而行，敦促我们行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Where are the thousands missing in Nepal's floods from?
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水失踪的数千人来自何处？

summary.en: People from dozens of countries are unaccounted for after the disaster.
summary.zh: 灾难过后，数十个国家的人员下落不明。

body.en:
At least 4,793 people were listed as missing on Monday, with a further 919 confirmed dead, after the flash floods and landslides that hit the Nepal-Tibet border.

The figures are likely to change, which is not uncommon in the chaos after a major disaster.

Nepal's disaster agency increased the total number of people missing on its side of the border to 4,247 on Monday, saying there were also 903 confirmed deaths.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The number of missing in Tibet is 546, with 16 others dead, China's state broadcaster CCTV reported on Sunday.

Nepal's disaster agency said Monday that 592 foreigners were unaccounted for, without listing them by nationality.

Chinese officials said Sunday at least 261 foreign nationals were among those unaccounted for there.

In India, authorities said they had recovered seven bodies from rivers flowing from Nepal, believed to be flood victims. However, at this time they are not included in the toll.

Among the missing are 933 people working on hydropower projects, 45 Nepali Army soldiers, 38 police and armed police officers and 18 customs and immigration officers.

China's foreign ministry said on Thursday that nearly 100 Chinese nationals were among the missing in Nepal.

The Nepal Tourism Board said eight Chinese were unaccounted for but that 16 had been rescued.

India's foreign ministry said on Saturday that 275 citizens were missing, and an additional 128 persons of Indian origin. Around 900 Indian nationals are still on the Chinese side but are safe and contactable.

Chinese state media said on Sunday that 49 Indian nationals were missing in Tibet.

About 85 US citizens were missing, the State Department said on Sunday, adding that nine had been rescued. It said it was not aware of any US fatalities.

The Nepal Tourism Board put the figure at 65 missing on Friday, and two rescued.

Eighteen US citizens were still missing in Tibet, Chinese state media said on Sunday.

The Nepal Tourism Board put the number of Ukrainians still missing on Friday at 61.

Ukraine's embassy in Nepal said on Friday it was aware of 62 of its citizens with whom contact had been lost, revising its earlier numbers upwards by six.

Thirty-three people from the United Kingdom were missing, the Nepal Tourism Board figures showed on Friday.

In Tibet, 15 people from the United Kingdom were missing, Chinese state media said.

The Nepal Tourism Board said 25 Canadians were among the missing on Friday. Canada's foreign ministry put the figure at 30 in both Nepal and Tibet.

The Nepal Tourism Board said on Friday that nine South Korean tourists were missing.

reflection.en: The sheer scale of the disaster in Nepal, with thousands missing from across the globe, underscores the fragility of human life and the interconnectedness of our world. In such moments of chaos and loss, the call to advocate for the vulnerable, to seek out the lost, and to offer comfort to those left behind resonates deeply. We are reminded to be a voice...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔发生的这场灾难规模巨大，全球数千人失踪，这凸显了生命的脆弱以及我们世界的相互关联。在如此混乱和失落的时刻，为弱者发声、寻找失踪者、安慰幸存者的呼吁显得尤为重要。我们被提醒要为那些被悲剧剥夺声音的人们发出声音。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Monza memories - Italian GP in pictures through the years
title.zh: 蒙扎记忆 - 历年意大利大奖赛图片集锦

summary.en: A selection of images from the Italian Grand Prix at Monza, which has hosted more Formula 1 races than any other circuit.
summary.zh: 精选了蒙扎意大利大奖赛的图片，该赛道举办的 것입니다. F1 比赛比任何其他赛道都多。

body.en:
The Italian Grand Prix takes place this weekend at Monza, arguably the most historic venue on the calendar.

Monza has hosted Formula 1 races more times than any other circuit, staging grands prix in all but one year since the inaugural season in 1950.

Located in a royal park and surrounded by woodland, it is known as the 'cathedral of speed'. It is the spiritual home of Ferrari and the devoted tifosi who adore the Italian team.

It is all but impossible to imagine F1 without Monza - it was where the first world championship was decided 76 years ago and where, last year, Red Bull's Max Verstappen set the fastest lap in F1 history during qualifying.

Throughout the years, Monza has been the scene of thrilling finishes, Ferrari glory, title wins, controversy and tragedy. Its story is F1's story.
body.zh: 意大利大奖赛将于本周末在蒙扎举行，这可以说是日历上最具历史意义的场地。 蒙扎举办一级方程式比赛的次数比任何其他赛道都多，自 1950 年首个赛季以来，仅一年就举办过大奖赛。 它位于皇家公园内，周围环绕着林地，被称为“速度大教堂”。这里是法拉利的精神家园，也是热爱意大利车队的忠实蒂佛西人的精神家园。 几乎无法想象 F1 没有蒙扎——76 年前，第一个世界冠军就是在这里决出的，去年，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘 (Max Verstappen) 在排位赛中创造了 F1 历史上最快圈速。 多年来，蒙扎一直是激动人心的终点、法拉利荣耀、冠军头衔、争议和悲剧的发生地。它的故事就是F1的故事。

reflection.en: The Italian Grand Prix at Monza, known as the 'cathedral of speed,' has a rich history spanning decades. This enduring legacy, built on passion and dedication, reminds us of the value of committing our work, whatever it may be, to a higher purpose. Colossians 3:23 encourages us to 'do everything for the glory of God,' finding meaning in the diligent...
reflection.zh: 蒙扎的意大利大奖赛，被称为“速度的圣殿”，拥有数十年的辉煌历史。这种建立在热情和奉献精神上的持久遗产，提醒我们应将我们所做的任何工作都献身于更高的目标。歌罗西书 3:23 鼓励我们“凡所行的，都凭着主的心，甘心乐意地去作”，在勤奋地完成任务中找到意义。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Why China is censoring footage of the Nepal-Tibet disaster
title.zh: 中国为何审查尼泊尔-西藏灾难的画面

summary.en: A catastrophic flood event in Tibet has underscored the extensive restrictions on information reaching the outside world. Videos of the disaster circulating on social media were notably absent from Chinese media, illustrating the extreme sensitivity surrounding Tibet and its tightly controlled status.
summary.zh: 一场灾难性的洪水事件凸显了尼泊尔与西藏之间边境地区信息传播的严格限制。社交媒体上流传的灾难视频在中国国内媒体上却不见踪影，这表明了西藏在中国严密控制下的极端敏感性。

body.en:
A natural disaster may not seem inherently political. But in Tibet, even footage of a flood can be sensitive.

As videos circulated widely on social media and in news reports last week, showing a devastating torrent of mud, water and debris tearing through a border post between Tibet and Nepal, correspondents in Beijing began to point out a striking absence: in China, the footage was nowhere to be seen.

The apparent censorship highlights the extraordinary sensitivity surrounding Tibet, one of the most tightly controlled regions under Chinese control, and the long and highly contested history stretching back hundreds of years.

Tsering Yangzom, a member of the Tibetan community in Newcastle, NSW, told SBS News her uncle works in the flood-affected region of Tibet, but she's been unable to contact him since the disaster and appears to have been blocked.

She suspects he may be concerned their communications are being monitored, but she's also "really, really worried" about whether he was affected by the deadly floods.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Normally, she says they speak briefly and intermittently on the Chinese messaging app WeChat, sometimes using coded language to protect her uncle.

"If he says the weather is good, then we can talk a little bit more about the normal life," she said. "But if he says the weather is not good and rainy or something ... that means that I can't talk much."

Human Rights Watch's Australia director, Daniela Gavshon, told SBS News censorship and self-censorship are pervasive in Tibetan areas.

"These information controls make it even harder to get accurate information, for families to locate loved ones, or to develop a good understanding of the disaster, its scale, its impact, and the response."

Tibet, isolated both geographically and diplomatically, sits atop a vast area of mountains and plateaus and is often referred to as the "roof of the world".

For centuries, it has had a complicated relationship with China. Beijing maintains that Tibet has been part of China since ancient times, while Tibetans say it had long been independent with its own unique culture, religion and language.

In 1950, troops from China's newly established communist government invaded Tibet and defeated Tibetan forces, in a move the Chinese government described as part of the "peaceful liberation" of the region.

The following year, Tibetan representatives signed an agreement recognising Chinese sovereignty over Tibet, while promising the region autonomy. Tibetan leaders say they were forced into this agreement.

Tensions over Chinese rule grew in the following years, leading to an uprising in 1959 in the Tibetan capital, Lhasa....
body.zh: 自然灾害似乎本质上并不具有政治性。但在西藏，即使是洪水的镜头也可能很敏感。 上周，视频在社交媒体和新闻报道中广泛传播，视频显示泥浆、水和碎片席卷了西藏和尼泊尔之间的边境哨所，造成毁灭性的洪流，北京的记者开始指出一个惊人的缺席：在中国，这段视频无处可见。 明显的审查制度突显了西藏的非凡敏感性，西藏是中国控制下控制最严格的地区之一，而且其历史可以追溯到数百年前，历史悠久且充满争议。 新南威尔士州纽卡斯尔藏族社区成员次仁央宗 (Tsering Yangzom) 告诉 SBS 新闻，她的叔叔在西藏受洪水影响的地区工作，但自灾难发生以来，她一直无法联系到他，而且似乎已被封锁。 她怀疑他可能担心他们的通讯受到监控，但她也“非常非常担心”他是否受到致命洪水的影响。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 她说，通常情况下，他们会在中国通讯应用微信上断断续续地简短交谈，有时会使用密码语言来保护她的叔叔。 “如果他说天气好，那么我们就可以多谈谈正常的生活，”她说。 “但如果他说天气不好，下雨什么的……那就意味着我不能说太多。” 人权观察组织澳大利亚主任丹妮拉·加夫尚 (Daniela Gavshon) 告诉 SBS 新闻，审查和自我审查在藏族地区十分普遍。 “这些信息控制使得家人更难获得准确的信息、找到亲人，或更好地了解灾难、其规模、影响和应对措施。” 西藏地处广阔的山脉和高原之上，在地理和外交上与世隔绝，通常被称为“世界屋脊”。 几个世纪以来，它与中国有着复杂的关系。北京坚称西藏自古以来就是中国的一部分，而藏人则表示西藏早已独立，拥有自己独特的文化、宗教和语言。 1950年，中国新成立的共产党政府的军队入侵西藏并击败了西藏军队，中国政府称此举是该地区“和平解放”的一部分。 次年，西藏代表签署了一项协议，承认中国对西藏拥有主权，同时承诺实行区域自治。西藏领导人表示，他们是被迫签署这项协议的。 接下来的几年里，围绕中国统治的紧张局势加剧，导致 1959 年西藏首府拉萨发生起义。

reflection.en: The news from Tibet shows how even natural disasters can become entangled with political control, leading to the silencing of suffering. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, reminding us that every voice deserves to be heard, especially in times of crisis. May we be moved to advocate for transparency and truth,...
reflection.zh: 来自西藏的新闻显示，即使是自然灾害也可能被政治控制所纠缠，导致苦难的声音被压制。箴言31:8-9呼吁我们为不能自辩的人开口，提醒我们每个人，尤其是在危机时刻，都应该被听见。 愿我们被触动，倡导透明和真相，确保所有人的经历，特别是那些处于边缘化或受控制地区的人们的经历，不被抹去。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Number of missing Australians in Nepal rises, as China links disaster to climate change
title.zh: 澳大利亚人在尼泊尔灾难中伸出援手，中国将灾难与气候变化联系起来

summary.en: Australians are raising millions for Nepal disaster survivors as the death toll rises and thousands remain missing following a devastating torrent of ice, rock, and debris. The Australian government has pledged further humanitarian support, bringing the total assistance to $8 million.
summary.zh: 随着死亡人数的增加和数千人失踪，澳大利亚人正在为尼泊尔的灾难幸存者筹集数百万美元。澳大利亚政府已承诺提供更多人道主义援助，使援助总额达到800万美元。

body.en:
Australians have raised millions of dollars to assist survivors of the Nepal disaster, with many forced into temporary shelters amid mud and chaos.

Authorities said the death toll rose to nearly 800 on Sunday, with more than 3,000 people missing on both sides of the Nepal-China border after a torrent of ice, rock, mud and debris swept through mountain valleys and rivers on Wednesday, causing widespread devastation.

The federal government has announced a further $3 million in humanitarian support for Nepal, including supplies transported by the Australian Defence Force. It brings Australia's total assistance to $8 million.

The survivors remain in desperate need of basic amenities like clean drinking water and medical supplies.

Among them, Rabindra Hamal told the Australian Associated Press (AAP) news agency he and his colleagues working at a dam site were told to flee just minutes before the flood hit their area on Wednesday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They made their escape by car, but as they later tried to reach higher ground by foot, two of the group were swept away.

The group continued to scramble to safety but were forced to wait until the following day to be rescued.

They were flown by helicopter to a nearby army barracks and then evacuated to Kathmandu.

Hamal said that of the several thousand people working on the hydro project, about 500 were still missing.

As of Sunday evening, the number of missing Australians rose to 43, with the federal government continuing to do everything possible to confirm their welfare.

A public candlelight vigil will be held at Melbourne's Federation Square on Monday evening, in memory of those lost in the disaster.

A joint call for aid from the Emergency Action Alliance (EAA), made up of 15 prominent charities, has raised more than $3.5 million, including $2 million in contributions from the federal government.

The funding is going towards providing much-needed emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water, healthcare, hygiene and sanitation services, and supporting longer-term recovery assistance.

Save the Children is one of the organisations participating in the alliance, with the group's global media manager Amy Lefevre, visiting the affected Nuwakot district on Saturday.

"It's just mud everywhere, there's also a lot of confusion and chaos," she told AAP.

"It's just incredibly sad when you look around and you see someone's shoes stuck in the mud, or people's belongings strewn everywhere.

"It's very much still a rescue operation but of course, today is day five, and I think the chance of finding people alive is slowly dimming."

For those who did survive, many families have been ripped...
body.zh: 澳大利亚人筹集了数百万美元来援助尼泊尔灾难的幸存者，许多人在泥泞和混乱中被迫进入临时避难所。 当局表示，周三冰块、岩石、泥浆和碎片席卷山谷和河流，造成大范围破坏，周日死亡人数上升至近800人，中尼边境两侧有3000多人失踪。 联邦政府宣布向尼泊尔再提供300万美元的人道主义支持，其中包括澳大利亚国防军运送的物资。这使得澳大利亚的援助总额达到 800 万美元。 幸存者仍然迫切需要清洁饮用水和医疗用品等基本设施。 其中，拉宾德拉·哈马尔 (Rabindra Hamal) 告诉澳大利亚美联社 (AAP)，周三洪水袭击他们所在地区的几分钟前，他和在水坝工地工作的同事被告知逃离。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们乘汽车逃跑，但当他们后来试图步行到达更高的地方时，其中两人被卷走了。 这群人继续爬向安全地带，但被迫等到第二天才获救。 他们乘坐直升机飞往附近的军营，然后疏散到加德满都。 哈马尔表示，在水电项目上工作的数千人中，仍有约 500 人失踪。 截至周日晚上，失踪的澳大利亚人人数上升至43人，联邦政府继续尽一切可能确认他们的福利。 周一晚上，墨尔本联邦广场将举行公众烛光守夜活动，以纪念在灾难中丧生的人们。 由 15 个知名慈善机构组成的紧急行动联盟 (EAA) 联合呼吁提供援助，已筹集了超过 350 万美元，其中包括联邦政府的 200 万美元捐款。 这笔资金将用于提供急需的紧急住所、食品、安全饮用水、医疗保健、卫生和环境卫生服务，并支持长期恢复援助。 救助儿童会是参与该联盟的组织之一，该组织的全球媒体经理 Amy Lefevre 于周六访问了受影响的努瓦科特地区。 她告诉澳联社：“到处都是泥巴，还有很多混乱和混乱。” “当你环顾四周，看到有人的鞋子陷在泥里，或者人们的财物散落各处时，真是令人难以置信的悲伤。 “这仍然是一次救援行动，但当然，今天已经是第五天了，我认为找到生还者的机会正在慢慢变小。” 对于那些幸存下来的人来说，许多家庭都被撕裂了……

reflection.en: In the face of devastating natural disasters, the human spirit often shines through acts of profound generosity. The outpouring of support from Australians for those suffering in Nepal, with millions raised and significant government aid provided, reflects a deep wellspring of compassion. This response echoes the biblical call to care for the vulnerable,...
reflection.zh: 面对毁灭性的自然灾害，人类的精神常常通过深刻的慷慨之举闪耀。澳大利亚人对尼泊尔苦难人民的援助，筹集了数百万美元并提供了大量的政府援助，这反映了深厚的同情心。这种回应呼应了圣经中关怀弱者的呼召，认识到照顾那些身处困境中的人是一种神圣的行为。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Iran's Kharg Island is being 'blown to smithereens', Trump says, without giving details
title.zh: 美国对霍尔木兹海峡附近的伊朗军队发动自七月以来的首次打击

summary.en: US forces struck two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz after observing preparations to target shipping with sea mines. Iran has since promised to retaliate for the strike, marking the first such military action in the region since late July.
summary.zh: 美国军队袭击了霍尔木兹海峡拉拉克岛上的两个伊朗火箭发射器，此前观察到对方正准备用海矿袭击航运。伊朗随后承诺对此次袭击进行报复，这是自7月底以来该地区首次发生此类军事行动。

body.en:
Iran's energy hub of Kharg Island is being blown to smithereens, United States President Donald Trump said on Monday AEST in a one-line social media post accompanied by an AI-generated video clip.

"Kharg Island being blown to smithereens!!! President DJT," Trump said on social media, but gave no further details.

Reuters news agency confirmed that an accompanying video clip showing dramatic explosions was most likely synthetically generated, using software that detects AI-manipulated imagery.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Attacking Kharg, which handled 90 per cent of Iran's oil exports before the war launched by US and Israeli attacks on 28 February, would severely disrupt its energy trade and put huge pressure on its economy.

The US said on Monday said it had attacked Iran's Larak Island in the strategic shipping lane on Hormuz, marking the first US strikes on its territory in a month.

The US said its attacks were aimed at preventing Iran from placing more sea mines in the strait, days after it announced it had completed clearing explosives from the waterway.

"US forces took limited, precise action against IRGC minelaying forces posing an imminent threat in the Strait of Hormuz," the US Central Command said in a post on X.

In retaliation for the attack, Iran attacked US military targets in the Middle East on Monday.

Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) said they retaliated for Sunday's attack by striking two US military air bases with ballistic missiles in US-allied Jordan, causing "heavy damage".

Jordan's army said it had intercepted eight missiles, without stating their origin.

Iran also said it targeted US military personnel at an air base in the United Arab Emirates and shot down a US drone over the Strait of Hormuz.

The IRGC said the US strikes resulted in "casualties" and that their subsequent attack on Jordan was "in response to the US-Zionist aerial aggression".

"We are not seeking war, but we will deliver a decisive response to the aggressors," Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said in a statement quoted by state TV.

Pezeshkian was speaking before travelling to Kyrgyzstan for the summit of a bloc that seeks to be a counterinfluence to the West, along with Russia's Vladimir Putin and China's Xi Jinping.

The exchange of fire between the US and Iran came shortly after their war hit the six-month mark, and at a time when hostilities had been subsiding.

In recent weeks, the administration of Trump has prioritised "economic warfare" over military strikes on Iran.

Iran has effectively blocked the Strait of Hormuz , a strategic sea lane through which one-fifth of the world's oil passed before the United States and Israel...

While nations seek to preempt danger, the immediate vow of retaliation highlights the persistent cycle where one strike invites another. We pray for wisdom for those in command, asking Yahweh to guide them toward paths that...
reflection.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡附近的交火提醒我们，当和平仅靠武力威胁来维持时是多么脆弱。虽然各国都试图预先排除危险，但伊朗立即发出的报复誓言凸显了一个持久的循环：一次打击往往会招致另一次反击。我们为指挥者祈求智慧，求雅伟引导他们走向能够打破升级势头的道路。

title.en: Guinea-Bissau votes to reshape presidency
title.zh: 几内亚比绍投票重塑总统制

summary.en: Guinea-Bissau's military government held a referendum to amend the constitution, aiming to grant more powers to the president, ahead of planned elections in December. The opposition called for a boycott, leading to low voter turnout.
summary.zh: 几内亚比绍军政府举行了一次修宪公投，旨在赋予总统更多权力，此前该国计划于12月举行选举。反对派呼吁抵制，导致投票率较低。

body.en:
The West African nation's military government wants to amend the constitution to give more powers to the president. The junta, which seized power last year, says it will hold elections in December.

Guinea-Bissau voted on Sunday in a referendum on whether to give the president new powers as the country prepares to transition from military to democratic rule.

According to the Associated Press, many polling stations had low turnout after the opposition urged voters to boycott the referendum.

The tiny West African nation of around 2.2 million people has been under army rule since last November following a disputed election.

Guinea-Bissau's junta has unanimously approved a constitutional amendment to switch the country from what it frames as a parliamentary to a presidential system.

This means abandoning the old system where the prime minister came from the parliamentary majority. 

The amendment would allow the president to appoint and dismiss the prime minister and dissolve parliament.

If passed, the new constitution will cut the number of seats in parliament from 102 to 65.

The junta says the change seeks to stabilize institutions before new presidential and parliamentary elections, scheduled for December 6, which are meant to hand power back to civilians.

Opposition groups, however, have urged the public to boycott the vote, saying it will allow the junta leader to cement power and calling it a "source of political instability at all levels."

Polls close at 1700 GMT on Sunday, with the first provisional results due from Tuesday.

One of the world's poorest countries, Guinea-Bissau has experienced five coups and a series of attempted coups since 1974.

A military government seized power in November following a disputed election in which former President Umaro Sissoco Embalo and opposition candidate Fernando Dias both claimed victory.

After legislative elections in 2023, Embalo himself dissolved the opposition-dominated parliament in response to what he described as an attempted coup.

body.zh: 这个西非国家的军政府希望修改宪法，赋予总统更多权力。去年掌权的军政府表示将于 12 月举行选举。 几内亚比绍周日举行全民公投，决定是否赋予总统新权力，因为该国准备从军事统治过渡到民主统治。 据美联社报道，在反对派敦促选民抵制公投后，许多投票站的投票率很低。 这个拥有约 220 万人口的西非小国自去年 11 月一场有争议的选举以来一直处于军队统治之下。 几内亚比绍军政府一致批准了一项宪法修正案，将该国从议会制转变为总统制。 这意味着放弃总理来自议会多数的旧制度。 该修正案将允许总统任命和罢免总理以及解散议会。 如果新宪法获得通过，议会席位将从 102 个削减至 65 个。 军政府表示，这一变化旨在在定于 12 月 6 日举行的新总统和议会选举之前稳定机构，选举的目的是将权力交还给平民。 然而，反对派团体敦促公众抵制这次投票，称这将使军政府领导人巩固权力，并称其为“各级政治不稳定的根源”。 投票于周日格林威治标准时间 1700 点结束，第一个临时结果将于周二公布。 几内亚比绍是世界上最贫穷的国家之一，自 1974 年以来经历了五次政变和一系列未遂政变。 11 月，在一场有争议的选举中，前总统乌马罗·西索科·恩巴洛和反对派候选人费尔南多·迪亚斯双双宣布获胜，军政府夺取了权力。 2023 年立法选举后，恩巴洛本人解散了反对派主导的议会，以回应他所说的未遂政变。 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，以便您始终能够首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

Yahweh's word warns against rulers who, like roaring lions, prey on their helpless people. As the nation prepares for elections, the low voter turnout in the referendum suggests a...
reflection.zh: 几内亚比绍军政府寻求修宪以赋予总统更多权力，这则新闻凸显了权力平衡的微妙。雅伟的话语警告那些像咆哮的狮子一样捕食无助人民的统治者。随着该国准备举行选举，公投的低投票率表明民众对不受约束的权力持谨慎态度。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Greece, Turkey clash over protected Aegean marine areas
title.zh: 希腊和土耳其就受保护的爱琴海海洋区域发生冲突

summary.en: Turkey's announcement of two protected zones in a disputed Aegean Sea area has sparked an angry reaction from Greece, potentially marking a new chapter in their long-running dispute after a brief period of improved relations.
summary.zh: 土耳其宣布在爱琴海争议区域设立两个保护区，引发希腊强烈反应，这可能标志着两国在短暂改善关系后，长期争端进入新篇章。

body.en:
Turkey has announced the creation of two protected zones in a disputed area of the Aegean Sea, sparking an angry reaction from Greece. Does this mark a new chapter in a long-running dispute between the two countries?

A stint of unfamiliar calm between Greece and Turkey lasted less than three years.

After a devastating earthquake struck Turkey in February 2023 and Greece provided substantial aid, the two countries came closer together. They then signed the Athens Declaration on Friendly Relations and Good-Neighbourliness in December 2023, a further step to improved relations.

During this unusual time of calm, neither government moved to resolve long-lasting Greek-Turkish disputes, which mostly involve  marking maritime boundaries . As a result, even a measure ostensibly aimed at protecting the environment has reignited regional tensions.

The latest dispute was triggered by Turkey's designation of two marine parks in the Aegean Sea and eastern Mediterranean earlier this month. The park in the northeastern Aegean includes a protected area in the waters between the Greek islands of Lemnos and Samothrace. The southern park lies east of Rhodes and surrounds the Greek island of Kastellorizo.

For decades, Greece and Turkey have been at odds over the delineation of their maritime borders in the Aegean and the related economic rights, such as claims to natural resources like oil .

Greece's Foreign Ministry was quick to react to the announcement, calling the establishment of the parks "illegal." In a statement, it said the designation of Turkish marine parks in areas outside Turkey's territorial waters has no legal validity.

Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis  said at a Cabinet meeting earlier this week that he wanted to maintain good relations with neighboring countries. However, he stressed that "areas under Greek sovereignty are determined by international law" and that Greece is "always ready to defend them."

For its part, Greece also announced two marine parks in 2025 — in the Ionian Islands and the southern Cyclades, both within Greek territorial waters. At the time, Turkey reacted in a clearly worded statement: "Unilateral actions should be avoided in closed or semi-closed seas such as the Aegean and the Mediterranean."

But Turkey has now declared its own marine parks — and without consulting Greece. Environmental protection appears to have been, at most, a secondary concern for the two countries in announcing their respective conservation parks. Instead, the move appears to be a new tactic for asserting dominance in the disputed maritime area — the latest chapter in a decades-long regional spat.

Greece believes Turkey sees the marine...
body.zh: 土耳其宣布在爱琴海争议海域设立两个保护区，引发希腊愤怒反应。这是否标志着两国之间长期争端翻开了新的篇章？ 希腊和土耳其之间一段不寻常的平静持续了不到三年。 2023 年 2 月土耳其发生毁灭性地震，希腊提供了大量援助后，两国关系更加紧密。随后，他们于 2023 年 12 月签署了《雅典友好关系和睦邻宣言》，为改善关系又迈出了一步。 在这段不同寻常的平静时期，两国政府都没有采取行动解决长期存在的希腊与土耳其争端，这些争端主要涉及划定海上边界。结果，即使是表面上旨在保护环境的措施也重新引发了地区紧张局势。 最新的争端是由土耳其本月早些时候指定爱琴海和东地中海的两个海洋公园引发的。该公园位于爱琴海东北部，包括希腊利姆诺斯岛和萨莫色雷斯岛之间水域的保护区。南部公园位于罗德岛东部，环绕希腊卡斯特洛里佐岛。 几十年来，希腊和土耳其在爱琴海海上边界的划定以及相关经济权利（例如对石油等自然资源的主张）方面一直存在分歧。 希腊外交部迅速对此公告做出反应，称建立公园是“非法的”。它在一份声明中表示，在土耳其领海以外地区指定土耳其海洋公园没有法律效力。 希腊总理基里亚科斯·米佐塔基斯在本周早些时候的内阁会议上表示，他希望与邻国保持良好关系。不过，他强调，“希腊主权范围是由国际法决定的”，希腊“随时准备保卫这些地区”。 希腊还宣布将于 2025 年在爱奥尼亚群岛和基克拉泽斯群岛南部建立两个海洋公园，两者均位于希腊领海内。当时，土耳其在一份措辞明确的声明中做出回应：“应避免在爱琴海和地中海等封闭或半封闭海域采取单方面行动。” 但土耳其现在已经宣布建立自己的海洋公园，而且没有咨询希腊。在两国宣布各自的保护公园时，环境保护似乎最多只是次要问题。相反，此举似乎是在有争议的海域主张主导地位的新策略——这是长达数十年的地区争端的最新篇章。 希腊相信土耳其看到了海洋...

reflection.en: The recent clash between Greece and Turkey over protected marine areas in the Aegean Sea reminds us how quickly old divisions can resurface, even after a period of calm and declarations of friendly relations. Ephesians 2:14 speaks of Yahweh breaking down 'the dividing wall of hostility' between groups, a profound hope for nations with long-running disputes....
reflection.zh: 希腊和土耳其最近在爱琴海有争议海域设立保护区而引发的冲突，提醒我们即使在一段平静期和友好关系声明之后，旧有的分歧也可能迅速重现。以弗所书2:14谈到雅伟拆毁了群体之间“仇恨的隔墙”，这对于长期存在争端的国家来说，是一个深刻的盼望。这一事件凸显了人类在拆除这些隔墙并真正睦邻友好方面所面临的持续挑战。

verse.textEn: For he himself is our peace, who has made the two groups one and has destroyed the barrier, the dividing wall of hostility.
verse.textZh: 因他使我们和睦，将两下合而为一，拆毁了中间隔断的墙。

title.en: India's citizen-led school audits test limits of activism
title.zh: 印度学生发起的“蟑螂”运动审计学校，测试行动主义的边界

summary.en: The student-led 'Cockroach' movement is expanding its campaign for accountability to government schools across India, following a successful protest that led to the Education Minister's resignation in July. Activists are organizing volunteer visits to classrooms to document conditions, though their methods are now...
summary.zh: 由学生发起的“蟑螂”运动正将其问责行动扩展至印度各地的政府学校。该运动此前因抗议考试丑闻导致教育部长于7月辞职而声名大噪。目前，活动人士正组织志愿者访问教室并记录教学条件，但他们的做法正面临政府当局日益增加的阻力。

body.en:
The student-led "Cockroach" movement is taking its campaign for accountability to government schools, but the activists' methods are encountering growing resistance from authorities.

The Indian activist movement dubbing itself the "Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)"  shot to national prominence in May by leading weeks-long protests over a scandal involving highly competitive entrance exams.

The student-led campaign put the government under intense political pressure and ended with the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan in July.

Now, the CJP is taking aim at India's government schools , organizing volunteer visits to classrooms, documenting conditions and demanding accountability for problems.

Launched on August 15, Independence Day in  India , the campaign asks parents, students and volunteers to inspect schools and record basic facilities including toilets, drinking water, electricity, classroom furniture and school buildings. The CJP has said the findings will be used to pressure authorities to make improvements.

The initial target is to audit 100 rural government schools over two months. It has also proposed giving recognition to village leaders who improve their schools.

Unlike the first campaign, which was based on street protests, the school audits require a more sustained form of local activism . Volunteers are expected to work consistently at the local level, document conditions and follow up with officials, parents and communities.

The organization is dealing with different layers of the Indian administration. Responsibility for government schools is divided between state governments, local administrations and elected village bodies. The CJP is therefore set to tackle different rules and political interests across the country.

India has over a million government schools, according to Education Ministry data. They make up nearly 70% of all schools in the country but serve less than half of its 247 million schoolchildren.

That scale has given CJP a vast field for its campaign. But it has also brought a new set of challenges.

The authorities are raising questions regarding rules and locations for the CJP scrutiny, as well as safeguards when children are present.

The response is already varying from state to state. Some authorities have ordered their own inspections, while others have restricted access or taken police action against CJP volunteers.

Authorities in Maharashtra and Rajasthan states have objected to school visits carried out without permission.

In one case, a complaint by school authorities resulted in police action against CJP members after they entered the premises to conduct an audit.

In Rajasthan, restrictions have been imposed on outsiders entering government...
body.zh: 学生领导的“蟑螂”运动正在向公立学校追究责任，但活动人士的方法正遭遇当局越来越大的阻力。 自称为“蟑螂简塔党 (CJP)” 的印度激进运动在 5 月份因涉及竞争激烈的入学考试丑闻而领导了长达数周的抗议活动，从而在全国引起了关注。 学生主导的运动给政府带来了巨大的政治压力，并以教育部长 Dharmendra Pradhan 于 7 月辞职而告终。 现在，CJP 正瞄准印度的公立学校，组织志愿者参观教室，记录情况并要求对问题负责。 该活动于 8 月 15 日印度独立日发起，要求家长、学生和志愿者检查学校并记录厕所、饮用水、电力、教室家具和校舍等基本设施。 CJP 表示，调查结果将用于向当局施压，要求其做出改进。 初步目标是在两个月内对 100 所农村公立学校进行审计。它还提议表彰改善学校的村领导。 与基于街头抗议的第一次活动不同，学校审计需要更持久的当地活动形式。 志愿者应在当地持续开展工作，记录情况并与官员、家长和社区进行跟进。 该组织正在与印度政府的不同层面打交道。公立学校的职责由州政府、地方行政部门和民选村庄机构负责。因此，CJP 将解决全国各地不同的规则和政治利​​益问题。 根据教育部的数据，印度有超过一百万所公立学校。它们占该国所有学校的近 70%，但为全国 2.47 亿学童中的不到一半提供服务。 这种规模为人民党提供了广阔的竞选空间。但它也带来了一系列新的挑战。 当局对 CJP 审查的规则和地点以及儿童在场时的保障措施提出质疑。 各州的反应已经有所不同。一些当局已下令自行检查，而另一些当局则对 CJP 志愿者实施限制或采取警方行动。 马哈拉施特拉邦和拉贾斯坦邦当局反对未经许可进行学校参观。 在一个案例中，学校当局提出投诉，导致警方在 CJP 成员进入校舍进行审核后对他们采取行动。 在拉贾斯坦邦，对外人进入政府施加了限制......

reflection.en: The 'Cockroach' movement’s insistence on auditing classrooms reminds us that education is not merely a bureaucratic service, but a sacred commitment to the next generation. When students themselves demand transparency in the face of institutional resistance, they echo the prophetic call for justice to flow unhindered like a river. True accountability...
reflection.zh: “蟑螂”运动对教室进行审计的坚持提醒我们，教育不仅仅是一项行政服务，更是对下一代的神圣承诺。当学生们在机构阻力面前要求透明度时，他们呼应了先知关于正义应如江河滚滚、不舍昼夜的要求。真正的问责需要有勇气记录那些令人不安的现实，以便为了弱势群体的利益，恢复公共服务的正直与诚信。愿雅伟赐予这些年轻人智慧，使他们在追求公义时既有热诚又有节制。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Nepal issues fresh flood warning as 3,000 still missing
title.zh: 尼泊尔发布新洪水预警，仍有3000人失踪

summary.en: Nepal has issued a new flood warning as river levels rise again following devastating floods that have killed at least 750 people in Nepal and Tibet, with over 3,000 still missing. Rescuers are facing challenges reaching dozens of hydropower workers trapped in flooded tunnels due to ongoing rainfall, and a new barrier...
summary.zh: 尼泊尔再次发布洪水预警，河流水位再次上涨，此前该国和西藏发生的毁灭性洪水已造成至少750人死亡，仍有3000多人失踪。由于持续降雨，救援人员难以抵达被困在洪水隧道中的数十名水电站工人，同时西藏方面警告称，滑坡碎片后面正在形成一个新的堰塞湖。

body.en:
Rescuers are trying to reach dozens of hydropower workers trapped in flooded tunnels, but have been hampered by further rainfall.

The combined death toll from the devastating floods in Nepal  and Tibet rose to 750 on Sunday, with more than 3,000 people still missing, authorities said.

A fresh flood alert was issued after river levels rose again, while Tibetan authorities warned of a new barrier lake forming behind landslide debris.

Several scientists believe a glacier collapse in the Himalayas may have triggered Wednesday's disaster, sending huge volumes of water down a river valley.

Nepal's disaster authority put the number killed on its side of the border at 734, while Chinese state media confirmed 16 dead in Tibet, an autonomous region of China .

Chinese authorities said the dead included over a hundred Nepalis and people from more than a dozen countries.

The Nepalese disaster agency issued a warning for fresh floods on Sunday and told residents around the Bhotekoshi River to remain on high alert as water levels rose.

Flood warning notices were sent to residents' phones, advising them to move to higher ground.

On the Tibet side, Chinese state media said monitoring drones on Saturday night had picked up a new lake forming from a barrier created by a landslide near the Gyirong border port.

Rescue teams near the Gyirong border port were moved because of the risk of the barrier bursting.

Meanwhile, Nepalese rescuers are trying to reach more than 100 hydropower workers believed trapped and still alive in tunnels swamped by flood debris.

Rescue teams are focusing on several hydropower projects on the Trishuli River, where more than 900 workers went missing during the floods.

At one of the sites on Saturday night, army teams used drills to break into the upper part of a mud-swamped tunnel to pump oxygen and deliver a camera inside.

Nepal's prime minister's office said that teams faced "continuous rainfall and difficult conditions" but had worked nonstop overnight, "making tireless efforts to search for and rescue those who may be trapped."

Specialized teams from India and China have joined the rescue effort, along with Nepal's mountain rescue squad, which helps climbers on the world's highest peaks, including Everest.

Nepalese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lok Bahadur Chhetri said the country needed assistance in such areas as tunnel rescue, DNA testing and identifying the victims.

The US State Department wrote on X that it would provide $3.6 million (€3.1 million) in "life-saving humanitarian assistance" to Nepal, including up to three months of emergency food aid for up to 10,000 flood-affected households.

body.zh: 救援人员正试图营救被困在被淹没的隧道中的数十名水电工人，但因进一步降雨而受阻。 当局称，周日尼泊尔和西藏特大洪水造成的死亡人数总计上升至 750 人，仍有 3,000 多人失踪。 河流水位再次上涨后，西藏当局发布了新的洪水警报，同时西藏当局警告说，山体滑坡残骸后面会形成新的堰塞湖。 一些科学家认为，喜马拉雅山的冰川崩塌可能引发了周三的灾难，大量的水流入河谷。 尼泊尔救灾当局称其边境一侧的死亡人数为 734 人，而中国官方媒体则证实中国自治区西藏有 16 人死亡。 中国当局表示，死者包括一百多名尼泊尔人和来自十多个国家的人。 尼泊尔救灾机构周日发布新洪水警告，并告诉博特科希河周围的居民，随着水位上涨，保持高度警惕。 洪水警告通知已发送到居民的手机上，建议他们转移到地势较高的地方。 在西藏方面，中国官方媒体称，周六晚上，监测无人机发现了一个新的湖泊，该湖泊是由吉隆边境口岸附近的山体滑坡形成的屏障形成的。 由于隔离墙有破裂的危险，吉隆口岸附近的救援队被转移。 与此同时，尼泊尔救援人员正试图救助 100 多名水电工人，据信他们被困在被洪水碎片淹没的隧道中，但仍然活着。 救援队正在重点关注Trishuli河上的几个水电项目，洪水期间该项目有900多名工人失踪。 周六晚上，在其中一个地点，军队使用钻头闯入一条泥泞的隧道上部，泵入氧气并在里面运送一台相机。 尼泊尔总理办公室表示，救援队面临“持续降雨和困难条件”，但连夜马不停蹄地工作，“不懈努力搜寻和营救可能被困的人员”。 来自印度和中国的专业团队以及尼泊尔山地救援队也加入了救援工作，该救援队为珠穆朗玛峰等世界最高峰的登山者提供帮助。 尼泊尔外交部发言人 Lok Bahadur Chhetri 表示，该国在隧道救援、DNA 检测和识别遇难者身份等方面需要援助。 美国国务院于 X 日写道，将向尼泊尔提供 360 万美元（310 万欧元）的“救生人道主义援助”，其中包括为最多 10,000 个受洪灾影响的家庭提供长达三个月的紧急粮食援助。 红十字会估计...

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet have brought immense suffering, with hundreds dead and thousands still missing. In times of such sustained loss, the prophet Jeremiah's words offer a profound anchor: "The steadfast love of Yahweh never ceases; his mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness." As communities...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏毁灭性的洪水带来了巨大的苦难，数百人死亡，数千人仍下落不明。在如此持续的损失面前，先知耶利米的话语提供了一个深刻的锚点：“雅伟的慈爱永不枯竭，他的怜悯永不穷尽，每日每早都是新的；你的诚实何其广大！” 当社区应对这场持续的危机时，雅伟的信实是希望的源泉。他每日每早更新的怜悯，能够支撑那些失去许多的人，并为救援和恢复的艰巨工作提供力量。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.

title.en: China is concealing scale of flood disaster, say Tibet campaigners

summary.en: A Tibetan advocacy group claims that hundreds of homes were destroyed and the number of missing people is significantly higher than officially reported by Beijing following recent deadly floods in Tibet. The group alleges that public discussion of the disaster has been restricted, with authorities penalizing...

body.en: Rights group claims 300 homes were destroyed in Tibet and number of missing people is ‘far higher’ than Beijing admits A Tibetan advocacy group says hundreds of homes were destroyed on the Tibetan side of the border in last week’s deadly floods, raising questions about Beijing’s official account of the scale of the disaster. Public discussion about the flash floods has been restricted, with security officials in Tibet announcing on Sunday that it had penalised at least 10 people for sharing “false disaster information”. There was no further information on the nature of the penalties. Continue reading...
body.zh: 人权组织声称西藏有 300 所房屋被毁，失踪人数“远远高于”北京承认的数字 一个西藏权益组织表示，在上周的致命洪水中，西藏边境一侧有数百所房屋被毁，这引发了人们对北京官方对灾难规模的描述的质疑。有关山洪的公开讨论受到限制，西藏安全官员周日宣布，已对至少 10 名分享“虚假灾害信息”的人进行处罚。目前还没有关于处罚性质的进一步信息。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of disaster, the truth about its scale and impact is vital for accountability and aid. This Tibetan advocacy group is speaking out, acting as a voice for those whose stories might otherwise be silenced. Their efforts echo the call to speak up for the voiceless, ensuring that the full reality of suffering is acknowledged.
reflection.zh: 在灾难面前，关于其规模和影响的真相对于问责和援助至关重要。这个藏族倡导团体正在发声，为那些可能被压制的声音代言。他们的努力呼应了为无声者发声的呼召，确保苦难的全部现实得到承认。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

reflection.en: The unprecedented flash floods in Nepal have unleashed a torrent of destruction, leaving hundreds of people trapped and thousands missing. In the face of such overwhelming natural disaster, the human spirit is tested, and the instinct to help and rescue emerges. This situation calls us to remember that even in the darkest moments of devastation, the...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔前所未有的山洪爆发，带来了毁灭性的灾难，数百人被困，数千人失踪。面对如此巨大的自然灾害，人类的精神受到考验，救援和帮助的本能油然而生。在这种毁灭性的黑暗时刻，雅伟所教导的以善胜恶的原则，仍然是人类应对之道的光辉指引。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

title.en: Why China is censoring footage of the Nepal-Tibet disaster
title.zh: 中国为何审查尼泊尔-西藏灾难的视频

summary.en: A catastrophic flood in Tibet, bordering Nepal, has brought attention to China's strict controls on information from the region. While videos of the disaster circulated internationally, they were notably absent from Chinese media, underscoring the sensitivity and tight regulation surrounding Tibet.
summary.zh: 一场发生在尼泊尔边境的西藏的灾难性洪水事件，引起了人们对中国对该地区信息传播的严格控制的关注。尽管灾难视频在国际上广泛传播，但在中国媒体上却鲜有报道，这凸显了西藏问题的敏感性和严格的监管。

body.en:
A natural disaster may not seem inherently political. But in Tibet, even footage of a flood can be sensitive.

As videos circulated widely on social media and in news reports last week, showing a devastating torrent of mud, water and debris tearing through a border post between Tibet and Nepal, correspondents in Beijing began to point out a striking absence: in China, the footage was nowhere to be seen.

The apparent censorship highlights the extraordinary sensitivity surrounding Tibet, one of the most tightly controlled regions under Chinese control, and the long and highly contested history stretching back hundreds of years.

Tsering Yangzom, a member of the Tibetan community in Newcastle, NSW, told SBS News her uncle works in the flood-affected region of Tibet, but she's been unable to contact him since the disaster and appears to have been blocked.

She suspects he may be concerned their communications are being monitored, but she's also "really, really worried" about whether he was affected by the deadly floods.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Normally, she says they speak briefly and intermittently on the Chinese messaging app WeChat, sometimes using coded language to protect her uncle.

"If he says the weather is good, then we can talk a little bit more about the normal life," she said. "But if he says the weather is not good and rainy or something ... that means that I can't talk much."

Human Rights Watch's Australia director, Daniela Gavshon, told SBS News censorship and self-censorship are pervasive in Tibetan areas.

"These information controls make it even harder to get accurate information, for families to locate loved ones, or to develop a good understanding of the disaster, its scale, its impact, and the response."

Tibet, isolated both geographically and diplomatically, sits atop a vast area of mountains and plateaus and is often referred to as the "roof of the world".

For centuries, it has had a complicated relationship with China. Beijing maintains that Tibet has been part of China since ancient times, while Tibetans say it had long been independent with its own unique culture, religion and language.

In 1950, troops from China's newly established communist government invaded Tibet and defeated Tibetan forces, in a move the Chinese government described as part of the "peaceful liberation" of the region.

The following year, Tibetan representatives signed an agreement recognising Chinese sovereignty over Tibet, while promising the region autonomy. Tibetan leaders say they were forced into this agreement.

Tensions over Chinese rule grew in the following years, leading to an uprising in 1959 in the Tibetan capital, Lhasa....
body.zh: 自然灾害似乎本质上并不具有政治性。但在西藏，即使是洪水的镜头也可能很敏感。 上周，视频在社交媒体和新闻报道中广泛传播，视频显示泥浆、水和碎片席卷了西藏和尼泊尔之间的边境哨所，造成毁灭性的洪流，北京的记者开始指出一个惊人的缺席：在中国，这段视频无处可见。 明显的审查制度突显了西藏的非凡敏感性，西藏是中国控制下控制最严格的地区之一，而且其历史可以追溯到数百年前，历史悠久且充满争议。 新南威尔士州纽卡斯尔藏族社区成员次仁央宗 (Tsering Yangzom) 告诉 SBS 新闻，她的叔叔在西藏受洪水影响的地区工作，但自灾难发生以来，她一直无法联系到他，而且似乎已被封锁。 她怀疑他可能担心他们的通讯受到监控，但她也“非常非常担心”他是否受到致命洪水的影响。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 她说，通常情况下，他们会在中国通讯应用微信上断断续续地简短交谈，有时会使用密码语言来保护她的叔叔。 “如果他说天气好，那么我们就可以多谈谈正常的生活，”她说。 “但如果他说天气不好，下雨什么的……那就意味着我不能说太多。” 人权观察组织澳大利亚主任丹妮拉·加夫尚 (Daniela Gavshon) 告诉 SBS 新闻，审查和自我审查在藏族地区十分普遍。 “这些信息控制使得家人更难获得准确的信息、找到亲人，或更好地了解灾难、其规模、影响和应对措施。” 西藏地处广阔的山脉和高原之上，在地理和外交上与世隔绝，通常被称为“世界屋脊”。 几个世纪以来，它与中国有着复杂的关系。北京坚称西藏自古以来就是中国的一部分，而藏人则表示西藏早已独立，拥有自己独特的文化、宗教和语言。 1950年，中国新成立的共产党政府的军队入侵西藏并击败了西藏军队，中国政府称此举是该地区“和平解放”的一部分。 次年，西藏代表签署了一项协议，承认中国对西藏拥有主权，同时承诺实行区域自治。西藏领导人表示，他们是被迫签署这项协议的。 接下来的几年里，围绕中国统治的紧张局势加剧，导致 1959 年西藏首府拉萨发生起义。

reflection.en: The news from Tibet reveals how even natural disasters can become entangled with political sensitivities, leading to censorship. Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that when rulers suppress information and ignore the people's cries, the nation suffers. May leaders learn to govern with justice and transparency, allowing truth to flow freely, even in times of crisis.
reflection.zh: 来自西藏的新闻揭示了即使是自然灾害也可能因政治敏感性而受到审查。箴言29:2提醒我们，当统治者压制信息并忽视人民的呼声时，国家就会遭受苦难。愿领导者学会以公正和透明的方式执政，让真理自由流淌，即使在危机时刻。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Number of missing Australians in Nepal rises, as China links disaster to climate change
title.zh: 澳大利亚人在尼泊尔失踪人数增加，中国将灾难归咎于气候变化

summary.en: Australians are raising millions for Nepal disaster survivors as the death toll rises and thousands remain missing.
summary.zh: 随着死亡人数的增加和数千人失踪，澳大利亚人正在为尼泊尔灾难幸存者筹集数百万美元的援助。

body.en:
Australians have raised millions of dollars to assist survivors of the Nepal disaster, with many forced into temporary shelters amid mud and chaos.

Authorities said the death toll rose to nearly 800 on Sunday, with more than 3,000 people missing on both sides of the Nepal-China border after a torrent of ice, rock, mud and debris swept through mountain valleys and rivers on Wednesday, causing widespread devastation.

The federal government has announced a further $3 million in humanitarian support for Nepal, including supplies transported by the Australian Defence Force. It brings Australia's total assistance to $8 million.

The survivors remain in desperate need of basic amenities like clean drinking water and medical supplies.

Among them, Rabindra Hamal told the Australian Associated Press (AAP) news agency he and his colleagues working at a dam site were told to flee just minutes before the flood hit their area on Wednesday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They made their escape by car, but as they later tried to reach higher ground by foot, two of the group were swept away.

The group continued to scramble to safety but were forced to wait until the following day to be rescued.

They were flown by helicopter to a nearby army barracks and then evacuated to Kathmandu.

Hamal said that of the several thousand people working on the hydro project, about 500 were still missing.

As of Sunday evening, the number of missing Australians rose to 43, with the federal government continuing to do everything possible to confirm their welfare.

A public candlelight vigil will be held at Melbourne's Federation Square on Monday evening, in memory of those lost in the disaster.

A joint call for aid from the Emergency Action Alliance (EAA), made up of 15 prominent charities, has raised more than $3.5 million, including $2 million in contributions from the federal government.

The funding is going towards providing much-needed emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water, healthcare, hygiene and sanitation services, and supporting longer-term recovery assistance.

Save the Children is one of the organisations participating in the alliance, with the group's global media manager Amy Lefevre, visiting the affected Nuwakot district on Saturday.

"It's just mud everywhere, there's also a lot of confusion and chaos," she told AAP.

"It's just incredibly sad when you look around and you see someone's shoes stuck in the mud, or people's belongings strewn everywhere.

"It's very much still a rescue operation but of course, today is day five, and I think the chance of finding people alive is slowly dimming."

For those who did survive, many families have been ripped...
body.zh: 澳大利亚人筹集了数百万美元来援助尼泊尔灾难的幸存者，许多人在泥泞和混乱中被迫进入临时避难所。 当局表示，周三冰块、岩石、泥浆和碎片席卷山谷和河流，造成大范围破坏，周日死亡人数上升至近800人，中尼边境两侧有3000多人失踪。 联邦政府宣布向尼泊尔再提供300万美元的人道主义支持，其中包括澳大利亚国防军运送的物资。这使得澳大利亚的援助总额达到 800 万美元。 幸存者仍然迫切需要清洁饮用水和医疗用品等基本设施。 其中，拉宾德拉·哈马尔 (Rabindra Hamal) 告诉澳大利亚美联社 (AAP)，周三洪水袭击他们所在地区的几分钟前，他和在水坝工地工作的同事被告知逃离。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们乘汽车逃跑，但当他们后来试图步行到达更高的地方时，其中两人被卷走了。 这群人继续爬向安全地带，但被迫等到第二天才获救。 他们乘坐直升机飞往附近的军营，然后疏散到加德满都。 哈马尔表示，在水电项目上工作的数千人中，仍有约 500 人失踪。 截至周日晚上，失踪的澳大利亚人人数上升至43人，联邦政府继续尽一切可能确认他们的福利。 周一晚上，墨尔本联邦广场将举行公众烛光守夜活动，以纪念在灾难中丧生的人们。 由 15 个知名慈善机构组成的紧急行动联盟 (EAA) 联合呼吁提供援助，已筹集了超过 350 万美元，其中包括联邦政府的 200 万美元捐款。 这笔资金将用于提供急需的紧急住所、食品、安全饮用水、医疗保健、卫生和环境卫生服务，并支持长期恢复援助。 救助儿童会是参与该联盟的组织之一，该组织的全球媒体经理 Amy Lefevre 于周六访问了受影响的努瓦科特地区。 她告诉澳联社：“到处都是泥巴，还有很多混乱和混乱。” “当你环顾四周，看到有人的鞋子陷在泥里，或者人们的财物散落各处时，真是令人难以置信的悲伤。 “这仍然是一次救援行动，但当然，今天已经是第五天了，我认为找到生还者的机会正在慢慢变小。” 对于那些幸存下来的人来说，许多家庭都被撕裂了……

reflection.en: In the wake of the devastating Nepal disaster, Australians have rallied, raising millions to aid survivors. This outpouring of generosity, particularly towards those displaced and suffering, echoes Jesus' teaching to care for the least among us. It is a powerful reminder that even in the face of immense tragedy, human kindness and solidarity can shine...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔发生毁灭性灾难之后，澳大利亚人团结起来，筹集了数百万美元援助幸存者。这种慷慨的涌现，特别是对那些流离失所和遭受苦难的人们，呼应了耶稣关于要照顾我们中间最小之人的教导。这有力地提醒我们，即使面对巨大的悲剧，人性的善良和团结也能闪耀。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Nepal flood relief vehicles trapped as heavy rain turns roads to mud
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪灾救援车辆被困，暴雨将道路变成泥泞

summary.en: Heavy rain has hampered relief efforts in Nepal where thousands remain missing after flash floods hit its border with Tibet.
summary.zh: 暴雨阻碍了尼泊尔的救援工作，此前洪水袭击了其与西藏的边境，导致数千人失踪。

reflection.en: The devastating flash floods in Nepal have created a dire situation, with thousands missing and relief efforts severely hindered by the relentless rain turning roads into impassable mud. In moments of such overwhelming natural disaster, when human efforts are stalled and despair can easily set in, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔毁灭性的山洪暴发造成了严峻的局面，数千人失踪，而连绵的暴雨将道路变成泥泞，严重阻碍了救援工作。在如此压倒性的自然灾害面前，当人类的努力受阻，绝望很容易滋生时，我们被提醒雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。愿受影响的人们找到安慰和力量，愿援助能迅速抵达。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

Authorities have dug ⁠hundreds of graves in the district’s Devghat forest, with the forest trials serving as a temporary burial ground for bodies too badly decomposed to be identified. body.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏边境发生山洪和山体滑坡，搜救工作仍在继续。新的洪水恐惧和营救被困在隧道中的人群，导致死亡人数上升。女儿通过 TikTok 视频追踪母亲和姑妈在尼泊尔最后的已知位置。尼泊尔救援人员试图救助被洪水碎片淹没的隧道中的水电工人，周日，降雨和上涨的河水阻碍了早期的救援工作，他们部署了重型机械。尼泊尔能源部在最新消息中表示：“四个洞的钻探已经完成……现在正在准备直接进入隧道……并进行搜救行动。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The devastating floods and landslides along the Nepal-Tibet border have left over 3,000 people missing and a rising death toll, bringing immense sorrow to countless families. In moments of such profound loss, the shortest verse in the Bible reminds us that Yahweh, too, feels the weight of human suffering. As rescuers race against time to free those trapped...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏边境地区发生的毁灭性洪水和山体滑坡，已导致逾3000人失踪，死亡人数不断上升，给无数家庭带来了巨大的悲痛。在如此深重的损失面前，圣经中最短的经文提醒我们，雅伟也感受人类苦难的重压。当救援人员争分夺秒解救被困在隧道中的人们时，我们为一位女儿追踪母亲和姨妈最后已知位置的深切悲伤，以及所有哀悼的人们留出空间。
