title.en: Nepal-Tibet deaths from flash flooding rise amid race to free workers in tunnel
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪灾死亡人数上升，新一轮洪水威胁和隧道被困人员救援竞赛持续

summary.en: Combined toll of at least 750 dead and more than 3,000 people missing in Nepal and Tibet after devastating flood ‘Their whole village has disappeared’: frantic hunt for survivors in Kathmandu hospital Thousands of people remain missing after the catastrophic flash flood that has killed more than 700 people in Nepal...
summary.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏发生毁灭性洪水后，死亡人数至少达到750人，超过3000人失踪。加德满都医院“整个村庄都消失了”：幸存者搜寻工作仍在紧张进行。在尼泊尔和西藏，这场灾难性山洪已造成700多人死亡，数千人失踪，当局警告搜救队注意水位上涨。

body.en: Total of 804 confirmed dead and more than 3,000 missing amid threat of fresh inundation ‘Their whole village has disappeared’: frantic hunt for survivors in Kathmandu hospital Rescuers in Nepal and Tibet have battled through leg-sucking mud amid the threat of fresh flooding to search for thousands of people still missing after a deadly wall of water swept through the Himalayan border zone, engulfing entire villages. The latest updates on Sunday put the number of missing at 3,048, including hundreds of foreigners. There was a total of 804 confirmed deaths across Nepal and Tibet, and reports of some bodies swept downstream possibly as far as India. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏发生特大洪灾，造成至少 750 人死亡、3,000 多人失踪 “他们的整个村庄都消失了”：加德满都医院疯狂搜寻幸存者 尼泊尔和西藏发生灾难性山洪，造成 700 多人死亡，当局警告搜救队水位上涨，仍有数千人失踪。尼泊尔和西藏的死亡人数合计已攀升至750人，失踪人数超过3000人。中国当局周日报告称，有 16 人死亡、546 人失踪，其中 261 人是外国人，而尼泊尔官员则确认有 734 人死亡、2,498 人失踪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The catastrophic floods in Nepal and Tibet have brought immense sorrow, with at least 750 lives lost and thousands still missing, leaving entire villages vanished. In the face of such overwhelming devastation and the profound grief it brings, Yahweh's promise in Revelation 21:4 offers a future hope where "death shall be no more, neither shall there be...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏的灾难性洪水带来了巨大的悲痛，至少750人丧生，数千人失踪，整个村庄不复存在。面对如此巨大的破坏和由此带来的深切悲伤，雅伟在启示录21:4中的应许提供了一个未来的希望，那时“不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛”。这个异象提醒我们，当我们与加德满都和受灾地区的人们一同哀悼时，有一个神圣的保证，即所有眼泪都将被擦干。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: In Nepal's flood-ravaged towns, excavators drown out the sound of grief
title.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏近3000人失踪搜救重启；悉尼女子安全获救

summary.en: Nepal has requested specialized foreign assistance as the search for survivors resumes following devastating flash floods that killed hundreds and left thousands missing in a region bordering Tibet. Amidst the disaster, a missing Sydney woman, Cara Severino, was safely located after contacting her parents.
summary.zh: 在造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪的毁灭性洪水过后，尼泊尔已请求外国援助，搜救幸存者。在灾难中，一名失踪的悉尼女子卡拉·塞韦里诺在与父母取得联系后被安全找到。

body.en:
In Bidur, Nepal, the sound of people crying is drowned out by the constant hum of excavators.

This town sits more than 45 kilometres from the site of Wednesday's glacial collapse, which triggered mudslides and flash flooding, killing nearly 700 people.

More than 3,000 remain missing, including 42 Australians in Nepal. Chinese state media on Sunday reported six Australians were also missing on the Tibetan side of the border.

In Bidur, the torrent of water was so powerful that it destroyed the winding road that once ran through it, as well as most of the buildings lining it.

Sticking out of the mud are the ruins of what were once homes and businesses; now nothing more than concrete shells covered in brown sludge.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Menuka Manandhar struggles down a ladder leaning against one of the buildings after searching the ruins of her home.

The layers of mud surrounding it are so thick, two men have to help lift her back to safety.

"All my things were inside the house. I could only take some important documents.

"I was here when the disaster struck, we escaped it by only a minute. We had barely crossed the road when it hit."

Other families emerge with a few small bags of belongings they were able to salvage from the higher floors of their buildings.

"Five people in our family were downstairs at the time of the flood," Ramji Lamsa, who was sheltering in a nearby school, said.

"I had a shop, a storehouse, and some vehicles. Everything was swept away. We don't have any resources to rebuild. We don’t know how the authorities are going to handle this."

Everything north of Bidur remains cut off by land. Nepali rescue crews are sending helicopters back and forth throughout the day, bringing back the injured and the dead they find on the other side.

Gaurav Thapa Magar was working in his bank at Timure, just three kilometres from the Tibetan border, when everything around him started shaking.

"In that moment, I just ran with everyone. And after I had taken five or six steps, I saw a big wall of water, almost three of four storeys of water, coming right after me.

"I felt like I was dead, to be honest. I was panicking, everyone was panicking, but I was really thinking 'I’m gone, I have to run, I’m gone'.

Gaurav spent most of the day waiting at the top of the hill he had climbed to, looking down on the wasteland that once was his town, until a helicopter arrived and evacuated him.

"When I looked down the whole village were swept away. And people were saying: 'There’s a body, there's a body'.

"There were so many people crying, who had lost their families. And there were so many people who were...
body.zh: 尼泊尔当局在因天气原因短暂暂停后恢复搜救工作，在一场造成数百人死亡并席卷西藏边境地区的毁灭性洪水之后，寻找近 3,000 名失踪人员。 周六，一名下落不明的悉尼女子，26 岁的卡拉·塞维里诺 (Cara Severino) 与她的父母取得了联系，随后澳大利亚领事官员安全找到了她。 外交部长黄英贤表示，这是“在一场带来巨大损失和不确定性的灾难中罕见的积极消息”。 “我对那些仍然失踪的人的家人感到同情——我知道我的家人和朋友经历了多少，”她说。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我很幸运来自澳大利亚，并得到大使馆和澳大利亚政府的大力支持。” 周三，冰川崩塌引发岩石、冰块、泥浆和碎片涌入山区河流系统，造成尼泊尔至少 669 人死亡、中国西藏至少 7 人死亡，造成 41 名澳大利亚人下落不明。 目前仍有近3000人失踪，其中尼泊尔约2426人，西藏吉隆县约554人，其中至少有540名外国人，其中许多是来自印度的印度教朝圣者。 尼泊尔已呼吁提供专门的外国援助，其财政部长表示，重建需要高达 50 亿美元（70 亿美元）的资金。 受灾严重的拉苏瓦地区一名警官表示，搜救行动因雨和雾而暂时停止，并于周日下午恢复。 “直升机正在飞行，天气有所好转后，行动也恢复了，”他不愿透露姓名，因为他无权接受媒体采访。 周五，洪水发生后，尼泊尔和中国边境形成的一个湖泊开始溢出，流入尼泊尔的伦德科拉河和特里苏利河，当局还暂停了救援工作。 中国当局和中央电视台表示，到周六，风险已经缓解，部分湖床清晰可见。据中央电视台报道，卫星图像显示湖水正在慢慢流失，湖面逐渐缩小。 该湖是尼泊尔正在监测的洪水区上游的两个湖之一。一位官员警告说，在两者完全排干之前，洪水风险将持续存在。 灾难发生三天后，当局表示，一些被打捞出来的尸体已经腐烂得面目全非。由于健康风险和对疾病爆发的恐惧，他们将在办理法律手续后被埋葬。 奇特旺地区政府在一份通知中表示，“将收集 DNA 样本，并将尸体埋在露天场所。” 失踪澳大利亚人的几名家人和朋友已飞往尼泊尔......

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet, the news of Cara Severino's safe return offers a glimmer of hope. This story reminds us of the profound uncertainty faced by families during disasters, and the importance of advocating for the vulnerable, ensuring no one is forgotten in the chaos.
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔和西藏毁灭性洪水肆虐之际，卡拉·塞韦里诺安全获救的消息带来了一线希望。这个故事提醒我们，在灾难中，家属们面临着巨大的不确定性，以及为弱势群体发声、确保混乱中无人被遗忘的重要性。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Death toll from Nepal-Tibet floods rises to over 600
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪灾死亡人数升至600多人

summary.en: Heavy rain is complicating an already difficult rescue effort, as hundreds remain missing three days after deadly flash floods hit the Nepal-Tibet border region. The latest death toll from the devastating flash flood along the Nepal-Tibet border was reported on Saturday to be over 600, as frantic rescue operations to...
summary.zh: 致命的山洪袭击尼泊尔-西藏边境地区三天后，大雨使本已艰难的救援工作更加复杂，仍有数百人失踪。据报道，周六尼泊尔-西藏边境地区毁灭性山洪的最新死亡人数已超过600人，搜寻数百名失踪人员的紧急救援行动进入第四天。根据尼泊尔灾害机构的数据，尼泊尔的死亡人数现已达到626人，包括外国人在内的2,426人仍然失踪。在边境另一侧的...

body.en:
Heavy rain is complicating an already difficult rescue effort, as hundreds remain missing three days after deadly flash floods hit the Nepal-Tibet border region.

The latest death toll from the devastating flash flood along the Nepal-Tibet border was reported on Saturday to be over 600, as frantic rescue operations to search for hundreds of missing people entered a fourth day.

Figures from both countries put the number of missing close to 3,000, with 682 bodies recovered and reports of corpses swept as far downstream as India.

According to Nepal 's disaster agency, the death toll there now stands at 675, with 2,426 people — including foreigners — still missing.

Across the border in Tibet, China's state news agency, Xinhua, has confirmed seven deaths and reported 554 missing individuals.

A glacial collapse on Wednesday sent rock, ice, mud and debris surging through the Himalayan mountain river systems below.

The flood swept through areas near the Chinese border, ravaging entire towns and damaging hydropower plants.

Nepal army spokesperson Raja Ram Basnet told the media on Saturday that helicopter operations were on hold until the weather improved.

Rescuers are battling thick layers of mud in the affected areas, which is making it difficult for helicopters to land and take off.

The army has located people trapped in a tunnel of the Trishuli 3A hydropower project in Nepal's Rasuwa District. Over 100 people are believed to be inside the tunnel filled with mud.

Basnet said that rescuers were struggling to locate the entry points of the tunnel and had made use of  baskets and ropes to reach some people. There are also limited places for helicopters to land in the area.

On Friday, Nepal's Army shared visuals of some people being rescued from the tunnel. The survivors were seen stuck in the mud, while officials crawled through the sludge and held out their hands to them.

On Saturday, Foreign Minister Shishir Khanal said a specialized tunnel rescue team had arrived from neighboring India and was ready to start work.

Nepalese authorities said the bodies of many flood victims have also been found dozens of kilometers from the disaster zone in Chitwan District in southern Nepal, which borders India.

Meanwhile, Indian authorities said they recovered the bodies of seven people who were swept downstream from Nepal and believe them to be flood victims.

Late on Friday, Nepal's Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal told the Reuters news agency that his country needed equipment, along with technical knowledge in tunnel rescue operations.

Khanal also told Reuters that Nepal did not need help with search and rescue operations but needed assistance in opening transport and communication lines in places...
body.zh: 大雨使本已困难的救援工作变得更加复杂，在致命的山洪袭击尼泊尔和西藏边境地区三天后，仍有数百人失踪。 周六，据报道尼泊尔-西藏边境毁灭性山洪造成的最新死亡人数已超过 600 人，搜寻数百名失踪人员的疯狂救援行动已进入第四天。 据尼泊尔救灾机构称，尼泊尔目前死亡人数为 626 人，仍有 2,426 人失踪，其中包括外国人。 在边境另一边的西藏，中国官方通讯社新华社已确认 7 人死亡，并报告了 554 人失踪。 周三的冰川崩塌使岩石、冰、泥土和碎片涌入下面的喜马拉雅山区河流系统。 洪水席卷了中国边境附近的地区，摧毁了整个城镇并损坏了水电站。 尼泊尔陆军发言人拉贾·拉姆·巴斯内特 (Raja Ram Basnet) 周六对媒体表示，直升机行动暂停，直至天气好转。 救援人员正在受影响地区与厚厚的泥浆作斗争，这使得直升机难以着陆和起飞。 尼泊尔拉苏瓦地区Trishuli 3A水电项目隧道内，军队已找到被困人员。据信，隧道内有超过 100 人，里面充满了泥土。 巴斯内特说，救援人员正在努力找到隧道的入口点，并使用篮子和绳索来救助一些人。该地区直升机的降落地点也有限。 周五，尼泊尔军队分享了一些人从隧道中被救出的画面。人们看到幸存者被困在泥里，而官员们则爬过污泥并向他们伸出双手。 尼泊尔当局表示，在与印度接壤的尼泊尔南部奇旺地区，距离灾区数十公里的地方也发现了许多洪水遇难者的尸体。 与此同时，印度当局表示，他们找到了从尼泊尔下游被冲走的七人的尸体，并认为他们是洪水受害者。 周五晚些时候，尼泊尔外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔告诉路透社，尼泊尔需要设备以及隧道救援行动的技术知识。 卡纳尔还告诉路透社，尼泊尔不需要搜救行动方面的帮助，但需要援助来开通桥梁被毁地区的交通和通讯线路、尸体身份识别、DNA测试以及尸体的长期储存。 路透社援引卡纳尔的话称：“我们已经在我们没有足够专业知识和技术知识的领域提出了此类专业服务和技术援助的请求。”

reflection.en: The devastating flash floods along the Nepal-Tibet border, leaving over 600 dead and hundreds missing, bring immense sorrow. In moments of such profound loss, the shortest verse in the Bible, "Jesus wept," reminds us that grief is a deeply human and even divine response to suffering and death. Our hearts go out to the families in the Nepal-Tibet border...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏边境地区毁灭性的山洪造成600多人死亡，数百人失踪，带来了巨大的悲痛。在如此深重的损失面前，圣经中最短的经文“雅伟哭了”提醒我们，悲伤是对苦难和死亡的一种深刻的人性甚至神性的回应。我们的心与尼泊尔-西藏边境地区那些正在应对这场悲剧的家庭同在。

verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: How Australians can help those impacted by devastating Nepal floods
title.zh: 澳大利亚人如何帮助受尼泊尔毁灭性洪水影响的人们

summary.en: Australian charities have launched a joint appeal to aid communities devastated by floods and landslides along the Nepal-China border. Thousands are in urgent need of shelter, food, clean water, and medical care after their homes and infrastructure were destroyed.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚慈善机构已发起联合募捐，以援助尼泊尔-中国边境受洪水和山体滑坡摧毁的社区。在房屋和基础设施被毁后，成千上万的人迫切需要住所、食物、清洁饮用水和医疗援助。

body.en:
Entire communities have been devastated by severe flooding and landslides along the Nepal-Tibet border, with homes, roads, bridges and critical infrastructure destroyed.

Search and rescue operations remain underway, while thousands of people are in urgent need of shelter, food, clean drinking water and medical assistance.

In response, 14 Australian charities have joined forces to launch a national appeal.

The Emergency Action Alliance (EAA) has launched the Nepal Flood Disaster Appeal, bringing together a variety of charities to support communities affected by the disaster.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The alliance says donations will help provide immediate humanitarian assistance, including emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water, hygiene supplies and medical care.

Access to some affected communities remains difficult, with damaged roads and ongoing weather conditions hampering efforts to reach people in need.

Australians are encouraged to donate through the EAA website or by calling 1300 939 000.

The charities participating in the appeal are Save the Children Australia, Plan International Australia, Oxfam Australia, Australia for UNHCR, ActionAid Australia, CARE Australia, Caritas Australia, ADRA, Act for Peace, Anglican Overseas Aid, Australian Lutheran World Service, Baptist World Aid Australia, CBM Australia and Tearfund Australia.

EAA executive director Kerren Morris said the appeal provided Australians with a trusted way to support people affected by the disaster.

"Emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water and medical support are urgently needed now, while longer-term recovery efforts will continue for many months," she said in a statement.

The charities involved bring different areas of humanitarian expertise to the response, with organisations and their local partners working to provide immediate assistance to affected communities.

Save the Children is focusing on supporting children and families affected by humanitarian emergencies.

Oxfam Australia's humanitarian work includes support for essential services such as clean water, sanitation and emergency assistance.

Australia for UNHCR is the UN refugee agency's national partner in Australia, and is supporting humanitarian assistance through the UNHCR network.

The charities involved are continuing to assess the scale of the disaster and humanitarian needs in affected communities.

The EAA says its members are working to determine where support is most urgently needed as search and rescue operations continue.

The appeal has been endorsed by the Australian Council for International Development (ACFID), the peak body for Australian non-government organisations...
body.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏边境沿线的严重洪水和山体滑坡摧毁了整个社区，房屋、道路、桥梁和重要基础设施被毁。 搜救行动仍在进行中，数千人迫切需要住所、食物、清洁饮用水和医疗援助。 作为回应，14家澳大利亚慈善机构联手发起全国呼吁。 紧急行动联盟（EAA）发起了尼泊尔洪灾呼吁，汇集了各种慈善机构来支持受灾社区。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 该联盟表示，捐款将有助于提供紧急人道主义援助，包括紧急住所、食品、安全饮用水、卫生用品和医疗服务。 进入一些受影响的社区仍然很困难，道路受损和持续的天气状况阻碍了援助有需要的人的努力。 我们鼓励澳大利亚人通过 EAA 网站或致电 1300 939 000 进行捐款。 参与呼吁的慈善机构包括澳大利亚救助儿童会、澳大利亚国际计划、澳大利亚乐施会、澳大利亚难民署、澳大利亚行动援助组织、澳大利亚援外社、澳大利亚明爱、ADRA、和平行动、圣公会海外援助、澳大利亚路德会世界服务社、澳大利亚浸信会世界援助组织、澳大利亚 CBM 和澳大利亚泪基金。 EAA 执行董事 Kerren Morris 表示，这一呼吁为澳大利亚人提供了一种值得信赖的方式来支持受灾难影响的人们。 她在一份声明中说：“现在迫切需要紧急住所、食物、安全饮用水和医疗支持，而长期恢复工作将持续数月。” 参与其中的慈善机构将不同领域的人道主义专业知识融入到应对工作中，组织及其当地合作伙伴致力于为受影响的社区提供即时援助。 救助儿童会的重点是支持受人道主义紧急情况影响的儿童和家庭。 澳大利亚乐施会的人道主义工作包括支持清洁水、卫生设施和紧急援助等基本服务。 联合国难民署澳大利亚办事处是联合国难民署在澳大利亚的国家合作伙伴，并通过难民署网络支持人道主义援助。 相关慈善机构正在继续评估灾难的规模和受影响社区的人道主义需求。 EAA 表示，随着搜救行动的继续，其成员正在努力确定哪里最需要支持。 该呼吁得到了澳大利亚非政府组织最高机构澳大利亚国际发展委员会（ACFID）的认可......

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal have left entire communities in urgent need of basic necessities. This situation calls us to action, reminding us of our responsibility to advocate for the vulnerable and provide tangible support to those facing such immense hardship. Proverbs 31:8-9 urges us to 'Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水使整个社区迫切需要基本生活必需品。这种情况呼唤我们采取行动，提醒我们有责任为弱势群体发声，并为那些面临巨大困难的人提供切实的支持。《箴言》31:8-9 敦促我们：“你们要为不能说话的辩护，为所有孤苦者伸张正义。你们要开口说话，公正地审判，为困苦和贫穷的人伸张正义。”

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Australians missing in the Nepal floods: what we know so far
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水中失踪的澳大利亚人：迄今所知情况

summary.en: Forty-three Australians are among thousands missing as rescue operations continue following deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border. Most of the missing Australians were pilgrims trekking to a holy site in Tibet.
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏边境发生致命的山洪暴发后，搜救行动仍在继续，失踪的数千人中有43名澳大利亚人。失踪的澳大利亚人大多是前往西藏一圣地朝圣的朝圣者。

body.en: There are 43 Australians among the thousands of people missing as rescue efforts continue after deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Pilgrims trekking to a holy site in Tibet make up the majority of Australians who have been reported missing after deadly flash floods and landslides tore through valleys on the Nepal-Tibet border on Wednesday. The total number of Australians missing in the disaster rose to 43 on Monday, with most travelling with Himalayan Glacier Adventures, Kailash Journeys, and the Isha Foundation. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏边境发生致命山洪后，救援工作仍在继续，数千人失踪，其中有 43 名澳大利亚人失踪 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 周三尼泊尔-西藏边境发生致命山洪和山体滑坡后，据报道失踪的澳大利亚人中，大部分是徒步前往西藏圣地的朝圣者。周一，在这场灾难中失踪的澳大利亚人总数增至 43 人，其中大多数是与 Himalayan Glacier Adventures、Kailash Journeys 和 Isha Foundation 一起旅行的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of devastating floods in Nepal, 43 Australians are among the missing, many of them pilgrims on a spiritual journey. This tragedy reminds us of the vulnerability of travelers and the profound interconnectedness of humanity when disaster strikes. Matthew 25:40 calls us to see Christ in the stranger and to offer aid. May we extend compassion and...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔发生毁灭性洪水之际，有43名澳大利亚人失踪，其中许多人是在进行精神之旅的朝圣者。这场悲剧提醒我们旅行者的脆弱性，以及灾难发生时人类深刻的相互联系。 马太福音25:40呼吁我们在陌生人身上看到基督，并施以援手。愿我们向受这场灾难影响的人们伸出同情和支持之手，认识到我们共同的人性以及雅伟即使在危机时刻也与我们同在。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

Speaking to ABC news breakfast, the assistant minister for foreign affairs declined to answer whether a prisoner swap was on the table. Obviously, we try and negotiate as best we can on behalf of all Australians who find themselves in difficulties such as this. We obviously have to abide by international laws and we always uphold them. But the Australian officials on the ground will work with their counterparts to ensure that, hopefully he’s returned to Australia safely. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The news reports that Australian officials are working to secure the release of Oscar Jenkins, who is in difficulty abroad. This effort to advocate for an individual facing hardship reflects the biblical call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves. It is a reminder that even in complex international relations, the dignity and well-being of...
reflection.zh: 新闻报道称，澳大利亚官员正努力争取在国外身处困境的奥斯卡·詹金斯获释。这种为身处困境的个人争取权益的努力，体现了圣经中为那些不能为自己发声的人发声的呼召。它提醒我们，即使在复杂的外交关系中，每个人的尊严和福祉都至关重要。

title.en: Newborn baby’s body found in Sydney rubbish bin as police hold ‘serious concerns’ for mother
title.zh: 悉尼垃圾箱发现新生儿遗体，警方对母亲表示“严重关切”

summary.en: Police are appealing for information to find the mother of a newborn baby boy whose body was discovered in a rubbish bin in Auburn, Sydney, on Monday morning. Emergency services found the body after responding to reports at a unit block on Harrow Road.
summary.zh: 警方呼吁公众提供线索，寻找一名新生男婴的母亲。该男婴的遗体于周一早上在悉尼奥本（Auburn）的一个垃圾箱内被发现。急救人员在接到哈罗路（Harrow Road）一栋公寓楼的报告后，发现了这具婴儿遗体。

Police said emergency services responded to reports of the body of a baby located in a rubbish bin at a unit block along Harrow Road in Auburn at 11.20am, with officers from the Auburn police area command finding the body of a newborn boy. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The discovery of a newborn's body in a rubbish bin is a profound tragedy, pointing to immense suffering and desperation. It calls us to remember the most vulnerable, those who cannot speak for themselves, and to advocate for their well-being. May we, like the prophet Isaiah urged, learn to do good, seek justice, and defend the defenseless, especially the...
reflection.zh: 在垃圾箱中发现新生儿遗体是一场巨大的悲剧，它指向了巨大的痛苦和绝望。这提醒我们要关注最脆弱的群体，那些无法为自己发声的人，并为他们的福祉而倡导。愿我们效法先知以赛亚的劝勉，学习行善，寻求公义，并为被遗弃和被遗忘的无助者辩护。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Man who murdered Molly Ticehurst unlikely to face life in jail, court hears
title.zh: 谋杀莫莉·蒂塞赫斯特的男子不太可能面临终身监禁，法院称

summary.en: Justice Natalie Adams expressed concern over expert testimony regarding rape allegations in the victim's police statement. Molly Ticehurst, a 28-year-old childcare educator, was found dead in her Forbes home on April 22, 2024. Her ex-boyfriend is unlikely to receive a life sentence for her murder, a crime that has...

Ticehurst, a 28-year-old childcare educator, was found dead in her home at Forbes, in the New South Wales central-west, in the early hours of 22 April 2024. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The news that Molly Ticehurst's alleged murderer may not face a life sentence is deeply troubling, especially given the galvanizing effect her death has had on the movement against gendered violence. The call in Micah 6:8 for justice, mercy, and walking humbly with God speaks to the profound need for accountability and compassion in our legal systems.
reflection.zh: 莫莉·蒂塞赫斯特的被指控杀人者可能不会面临终身监禁的消息令人深感不安，尤其是考虑到她的死亡对反对性别暴力的运动产生了如此大的推动作用。弥迦书6章8节呼吁施行公义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑行走，这说明了我们的法律体系迫切需要问责和同情。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.

title.en: Australians missing in Nepal targeted by ‘heartbreaking’ and ‘abhorrent’ racist slurs

summary.en: As families await news following the Nepal-Tibet floods, community members are appealing for compassion amidst a rise in racist social media comments directed at missing Australians. Authorities report 43 Australians are missing and the overall death toll has reached at least 810.
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏洪水灾难发生后，家属们仍在焦急等待消息，社区成员们呼吁在针对失踪澳大利亚人的种族主义社交媒体评论激增的背景下给予同情。当局报告称，有43名澳大利亚人失踪，总死亡人数已至少达到810人。

body.en: As families await news after the catastrophe, community members appeal for compassion in the face of hateful rhetoric Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A slew of racist social media comments have been made towards Australians missing in the catastrophic Nepal-Tibet floods , prompting calls for greater accountability of major platforms to remove hateful rhetoric. On Monday, the total number of Australians missing after flash floods triggered by a massive glacier collapse in the Himalayas rose to 43, and the overall death toll was at least 810 people. Continue reading...
body.zh: 灾难发生后，当家人等待消息时，社区成员在面对仇恨言论时呼吁同情关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客以获取最新动态获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客社交媒体上出现了大量针对在尼泊尔西藏灾难性洪水中失踪的澳大利亚人的种族主义评论，促使人们呼吁主要平台承担更大责任，以消除仇恨言论。周一，喜马拉雅山大规模冰川崩塌引发山洪爆发后失踪的澳大利亚人总数增至43人，总死亡人数至少为810人。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the wake of the Nepal-Tibet floods, the news reports that Australians missing in the disaster have become targets of racist slurs online. This hateful rhetoric stands in stark contrast to the biblical call to treat the foreigner as one of your own. In times of crisis, compassion and empathy should extend to all, regardless of nationality or background.
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏洪水灾难之后，新闻报道称在灾难中失踪的澳大利亚人已成为网络种族诽谤的目标。这种仇恨言论与圣经中呼吁“待客如本地人”的教导形成了鲜明对比。在危机时刻，同情心和共情心应该扩展到所有人，无论其国籍或背景如何。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: A new proposal to limit our scrolling has a precedent. But would it work?
title.zh: 一项限制我们滚动的新提案有先例。但它会奏效吗？

summary.en: Australia is considering copying Europe's playbook on limiting addictive social media feeds, but the results are mixed.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚正在考虑效仿欧洲限制成瘾性社交媒体推送内容的做法，但效果好坏参半。

body.en:
For years, social media companies have relied on powerful algorithms to decide what Australians see in their feeds, using their personal data and behaviour to keep them scrolling.

The federal government is drafting "digital duty of care" legislation that would require social media companies to identify risks and take steps to reduce online harm.

Among the proposals is a push to "Fix Our Feeds", which would give Australians greater control over whether algorithms personalise the content they see.

But Australia would not be the first jurisdiction to try to rein in the algorithms that determine what users see.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The European Union has already introduced rules requiring the largest social media platforms to give users an alternative to personalised recommendations.

The experience offers a warning for Australia: giving people more control over their feeds does not necessarily mean they will use it.

The EU's Digital Services Act, which began applying to the largest online platforms in 2023, was designed to strengthen users' rights and give them greater control over their online experiences.

"Europe is now effectively the first jurisdiction in the world where online platforms no longer benefit from a 'free pass' and set their own rules," then EU commissioner Thierry Breton said in 2023.

Under the rules, the largest platforms — those with more than 45 million monthly users in the EU — must offer at least one recommendation option that is not based on users' personal profiling.

Instagram and Facebook users now have feeds that show content in the order it was posted and more closely resemble how social media worked before personalised feeds became central to the platforms.

Proponents argue chronological feeds may be less addictive because users can feel they have "caught up", rather than being drawn into endless scrolling.

But Patrik Wikström, a professor of computational communication at Queensland University of Technology, said the European regulations had shortcomings.

"Even if we say 'We don't want the platforms to know an awful lot about us, we don't want this to be personalised, and we don't want these rabbit holes and echo chambers', at the end of the day, when we're sitting there and scrolling, we like it," he told SBS News.

"People still stick to the personalised platform because it is there for a reason. It's tuned perfectly to our brains and to make us stay as long as possible on the platform, and it's hard to escape."

Research cited by Australia's eSafety Commissioner found users often found chronological feeds less engaging and switched back to personalised algorithms, raising...

reflection.en: Social media platforms often employ sophisticated algorithms designed to capture and hold our attention, sometimes to our detriment. This news prompts reflection on our own consumption habits and the need to intentionally direct our minds toward what is beneficial and true, rather than being passively swept along by endless scrolling. As we navigate the...
reflection.zh: 社交媒体平台常常采用复杂的算法来吸引并留住我们的注意力，有时甚至对我们造成损害。这则新闻促使我们反思自身的媒介消费习惯，以及有意识地将心思引导至有益和真实事物上的必要性，而不是被无休止的滚动所裹挟。当我们穿梭于数字世界时，培养一颗专注的心，正如腓立比书4:8所鼓励的那样，对于身心健康至关重要。

title.en: Should smart glasses blur your face by default? Australia's tech watchdog thinks so
title.zh: 智能眼镜是否应该默认模糊你的脸？澳大利亚科技监管机构认为应该

summary.en: Australia's eSafety Commissioner has recommended that smart glasses should automatically blur the faces of people being filmed unless consent is given, as part of broader privacy reforms concerning AI and social media.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的电子安全专员建议，作为围绕人工智能和社交媒体的更广泛隐私改革的一部分，智能眼镜拍摄的对象的面部应在未经同意的情况下自动模糊。

body.en:
People's faces should automatically be blurred when being filmed by smart glasses as part of greater privacy measures, the online safety watchdog has urged.

In advice to industry, the eSafety Commissioner has called for extra protections to be put in place for smart glasses, or glasses with cameras attached to them.

The growing uptake of the technology, prompted by cheap versions of the products being sold in outlets such as Kmart, has increased concerns about privacy and people being filmed without their consent.

The commissioner said faces of people being filmed should be blurred by default if they have not given consent, with clearer indicators being given for when the glasses are recording video.

"Companies selling smart glasses must balance the benefits of the technology with the need to protect users and the public," the commissioner said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"As smart glasses become more common, they may create new ways to perpetrate harms."

The eSafety Commissioner said the rapid evolution of the technology meant there was still a chance for extra safety features to be baked into the products before harms became more widespread.

"They may become increasingly interconnected with and create new ways to perpetrate different types of harms, such as image-based abuse, adult cyber abuse, cyberbullying of children, or the livestreaming of violent or other harmful content," the advice said.

"The harms linked to covert recording are not hypothetical. They are real and already occurring."

Among the concerns listed by the commissioner was how the glasses could be used by "pick-up artists" who use the glasses to film women without their knowledge.

"Most of the women do not realise they are being filmed. These posts often attract misogynistic comments, compounding the harm," the commissioner said.

"Used in this way, smart glasses can reinforce and normalise watching, recording and controlling women in public without their knowledge."

The commissioner has also called for livestreaming from the glasses to operate on a delay, as well as for recording to be disabled when the glasses are not being worn.

Attorney-General Michelle Rowland wrote to the privacy commission earlier this month to investigate whether extra regulations for smart glasses were needed.

Under changes the minor party will bring to parliament, the filming, storing or sharing of footage from the glasses without consent would be a breach of privacy laws.

Rowland is also set to outline further changes to privacy laws, including the right to erasure, on Monday.

The policy would mean social media users can ask tech companies to delete their personal information...

Genesis 1:27 reminds us that each individual is made in the image of Yahweh, deserving of respect and privacy. This principle calls us to develop and use technology in ways that honor this...

summary.en: Tony Mundine, a prominent Australian boxer and father of former boxer Anthony Mundine, passed away on Sunday at the age of 75 due to a heart attack. He was the first Australian to compete in four weight divisions and challenged for a world middleweight title in 1974. His son Anthony became a world champion, and his...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚著名拳击手、前拳击手安东尼·蒙迪内（Anthony Mundine）的父亲托尼·蒙迪内（Tony Mundine）于周日因心脏病去世，享年75岁。他是第一位参加四个级别比赛的澳大利亚拳击手，并曾于1974年挑战世界中量级拳王。他的儿子安东尼曾是世界拳王，孙子拉希姆（Rahim）也是一名职业拳击手。

body.en:
The father of former boxer and NRL star Anthony Mundine succumbed to a heart attack on Sunday.

Born in Baryulgil, near Grafton in northern NSW, Tony Mundine was the first Australian to fight in four different weight divisions, challenging for the world middleweight title against Argentina's Carlos Monzon in 1974, in a bout stopped in the seventh round.

Mundine leaves a significant boxing legacy. Anthony was an IBO middleweight and WBA super-middleweight world champion, whose son Rahim won his fourth career fight from as many professional bouts on the Gold Coast only last week.

Anthony Mundine posted a tribute to his father on social media, saying he was returning home for his funeral after travelling to Saudi Arabia.

"Thanks for doing all you did for me and supporting me in every moment, showing love and strength gonna miss you Tonza, there's only one Tony Mundine."

Through a career in the middleweight, light-heavyweight, cruiserweight and heavyweight divisions, Tony Mundine recorded 80 wins — 64 from knockouts, 15 losses, and one draw.

body.zh: 前拳击手、NRL 球星安东尼·蒙丁 (Anthony Mundine) 的父亲于周日因心脏病去世。 托尼·蒙丁（Tony Mundine）出生于新南威尔士州北部格拉夫顿附近的巴留吉尔（Baryulgil），是第一个参加四个不同体重级别比赛的澳大利亚人，他于 1974 年挑​​战了阿根廷选手卡洛斯·蒙松（Carlos Monzon）的世界中量级冠军头衔，比赛在第七轮停止。 蒙丁留下了重要的拳击遗产。安东尼是 IBO 中量级和 WBA 超中量级世界冠军，他的儿子拉希姆上周在黄金海岸举行的职业比赛中赢得了他职业生涯的第四场比赛。 安东尼·蒙丁在社交媒体上向他的父亲致敬，称他在前往沙特阿拉伯后将回家参加父亲的葬礼。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “谢谢你为我所做的一切，每时每刻都支持我，展现出爱和力量，我会想念你的，Tonza，只有一个托尼·蒙丁。” 托尼·蒙丁在中量级、轻重量级、轻量级和重量级的职业生涯中取得了 80 场胜利，其中 64 场被淘汰，15 场失利，1 场平局。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

title.en: What a man with psychopathic traits wants people to understand about empathy
title.zh: 有精神病态特征的男人希望人们理解共情

summary.en: While some individuals may be predisposed to or develop certain traits, experts suggest this does not inevitably lead to harmful behavior. The story features a man diagnosed with psychopathic traits who describes viewing people as 'rocks' and having difficulty understanding emotions from a young age, contrasting with...
summary.zh: 虽然有些人可能天生具有或后天发展出某些特征，但专家表示这并不意味着他们注定会做出有害行为。故事讲述了一名被诊断出具有精神病态特征的男子，他形容自己从小就将人视为“石头”，并且难以理解他人的情绪，这与有害行为并非命中注定的观点形成对比。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

A man diagnosed with psychopathic traits, parents concerned about their children's violent behaviour, and guests who grew up believing they were bad. Are some of us born bad, or is harmful behaviour shaped by experience? How do nature and nurture influence our choices and morals? Watch Insight episode Born Bad? at 8.30PM Tuesday 1 September on SBS or SBS On Demand.

Loïc De Marie says he views a human as "a rock" and has struggled to understand other people's emotions from a young age.

"A little classmate died in a dramatic car accident when I was six years old … everybody was crying," the 26-year-old told Insight.

"This [was] the first time I understood that emotions are different with me [because] the look that the teacher gave me was, 'Why is this kid not crying?'"

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Growing up in Belgium, in that same year, Loïc and his little sister were playing near their backyard pool when she fell in.

"She was drowning, and I looked at her, and that was kind of troubling," he said.

He then saved her by holding out a plastic golf club for her to grab as he dragged her back to the ladder.

As he grew older, Loïc became increasingly involved in fights and would have angry outbursts.

"A guy was looking me in the eyes, some rivalry between men… and one day, I came to school with a baseball bat," he said.

Loïc says the police arrested him on the school grounds over the incident but says he never faced serious legal consequences.

Three years ago, Loïc began seeing a new psychologist — having grown tired of masking his thought processes.

The psychologist diagnosed him with antisocial personality disorder (ASPD) and documented traits associated with psychopathy — including manipulation and lying, a reckless disregard for other people's safety, and a lack of remorse and empathy.

"Everybody in the room can understand the words of the music and the melody ... I don't hear the melody — I don't understand it."

Loïc's father, Philippe, says he used to worry his son would go down the wrong path, but receiving a diagnosis was helpful.

"It [was] good to put a name on a disorder, and then you understand a lot of things.

title.en: Fears of Israeli ‘waiting game’ with Australia over Zomi Frankcom’s death
title.zh: 澳大利亚对佐米·弗兰科姆之死感到担忧，以色列关闭调查

summary.en: Israel's military justice system has closed its investigation into the death of Australian aid worker Zomi Frankcom and six World Central Kitchen colleagues, stating there is no reasonable suspicion of criminal misconduct. Israel's ambassador to Australia called the incident a 'reasonable mistake' and denied any...
summary.zh: 以色列军方司法系统已关闭对澳大利亚援助工作者佐米·弗兰科姆及其世界中央厨房同事（共七人）死亡事件的调查，并表示没有合理的犯罪不当行为嫌疑。以色列驻澳大利亚大使称此事件为“合理的错误”，并否认有任何意图袭击援助工作者。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

In the case of Zomi Frankcom , an Australian killed in a drone strike while delivering humanitarian aid to the Gaza Strip in 2024, Israel's military justice system has concluded there is no reasonable suspicion of criminal misconduct.

It announced this month its decision to close the investigation into the death of Frankcom and six other World Central Kitchen (WCK) colleagues.

Israel's ambassador to Australia, Hillel Newman, said there had been no intention to attack the aid workers and a "reasonable mistake" was made.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"There are tragic circumstances in a war zone and we're very sorry for the family, but that does not always mean that there's criminal liability," Newman told ABC Radio National.

Two Israel Defense Forces (IDF) officers were removed from their positions over the incident and another three were formally reprimanded.

But Foreign Minister Penny Wong has criticised the decision, noting "there are still many unanswered questions".

The Frankcom family and WCK are demanding an independent investigation into the airstrikes, saying "the IDF cannot credibly investigate its own conduct".

The case raises questions about whether Israel's military justice system is capable of delivering fair outcomes when its forces are accused of killing civilians, and where the line lies between a tragic operational error and conduct that warrants criminal investigation.

Michelle Burgis-Kasthala, professor of international law at La Trobe University, says there is "very compelling documentation" from many human rights organisations to suggest a "pattern of impunity" when it comes to the investigation of war crimes in Israel.

"A lot of the time they simply lapse and very rarely do they ever result in any form of criminal investigation, and even less likely [to result in] criminal conviction."

Last year, Action on Armed Violence (AOAV) looked at 52 publicly reported incidents in English-language media between October 2023 and June 2025, in which the Israeli media either reported an investigation was underway, or serious allegations of civilian harm.

The London-based charity found 88 per cent were either still under review or had been closed without any finding of wrongdoing.

So far, according to the cases examined by AOAV, only one case has resulted in a prison sentence against the accused.

IDF reservist soldier Israel Hajabi was convicted on 7 February 2025 for repeatedly beating bound Palestinian detainees with his fists, a baton and an assault rifle at the Sde Teiman military detention centre. Some of these attacks...

title.en: 'Unsafe': Why Barnaby Joyce invoked Nepal to explain One Nation's refugee policy
title.zh: “不安全”：巴纳比·乔伊斯援引受灾的尼泊尔解释“一国党”的难民政策

summary.en: One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce suggested that Australia should not accept refugees from countries deemed unsafe for Australians to visit, citing flood-hit Nepal as an example.
summary.zh: “一国党”议员巴纳比·乔伊斯建议，澳大利亚不应接收来自政府认为对澳大利亚人来说不安全的国家的难民，并以遭受洪灾的尼泊尔为例。

body.en:
One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce has suggested that Australia should not accept refugees from countries that the government deems unsafe for Australians to visit, invoking flood-hit Nepal as an example.

Appearing on News24 (formerly Sky News) on Sunday morning, Joyce was asked whether Australia's current humanitarian intake should be cut.

Joyce brought up Nepal, which is reeling from catastrophic mudslides and flash flooding that have killed nearly 700 people. More than 3,000 more are missing, including 43 Australians.

"The refugee program has got to work within a policy structure we've got," Joyce said.

"Remember, we've clearly stated that if an area, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFAT) says it's too unsafe to go there, then it's unsafe to bring people from there and away from there, such as places in Nepal.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I presume that the Department of Foreign Affairs says it's not unsafe to go to Nepal, but I wouldn't be going there at the moment."

Asked whether One Nation would stop accepting people from Nepal if DFAT were to advise against travel there, Joyce said he wasn't clear on DFAT's current position on the country, but "I know the Nepalese community have a huge say in sections of our country in the workforce, but they do it within the visa category."

"If they do come in, they'll be within the NOM," he added, referring to net overseas migration.

People who arrive on humanitarian visas currently contribute to net overseas migration figures.

While natural disasters can make a country unsafe to visit, people displaced by disasters do not generally qualify as refugees on that basis alone.

DFAT's latest travel advice for Nepal encourages a "high degree of caution due to the risk of natural disasters and road accidents". For certain areas closer to the disaster-hit region, it advises Australians to reconsider their need to travel.

Pressed on whether One Nation was happy with the current annual humanitarian intake level of 20,000, Joyce repeated that "it fits within the NOM".

"That is our policy, and the refugee policy — it's not that it's dispensed — but you can't come from countries which are dangerous. Like if you can't go there, you shouldn't be coming here."

Reporting suggested this week that the government intended to slash Australia's humanitarian intake by a third, however, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Thursday that humanitarian placements would remain at 20,000.

On Sunday, Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek said that was a "permanent commitment".

There has been ongoing confusion over the specifics of One Nation's broader immigration policy.

title.en: Australia should look 'very seriously' at UK-style ban on strangulation porn: minister
title.zh: 澳大利亚部长：应“非常认真地”考虑效仿英国禁止勒颈色情内容

summary.en: Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek says the government is considering further reforms around online safety and should be looking "very seriously" at following the United Kingdom's lead by outlawing depictions of strangulation in pornography. Her comments follow the recent death of a 16-year-old girl after a...
summary.zh: 社会服务部长坦尼娅·普利伯塞克表示，政府正在考虑进一步改革网络安全，并应“非常认真地”考虑效仿英国，将色情内容中描绘勒颈的行为定为非法。她的评论是在一名16岁女孩因涉嫌性勒颈行为死亡后发表的。这起死亡事件重新引发了人们对年轻人性暴力发生率上升的担忧。

body.en:
Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek says the government is considering further reforms around online safety and should be looking "very seriously" at following the United Kingdom's lead by outlawing depictions of strangulation in pornography.

Her comments follow the recent death of a 16-year-old girl after a suspected sexual strangulation act.

The death has sparked renewed concern over the rising rate of sexual violence among young people.

According to the Breathless campaign, strangulation — often referred to as "choking" — has become a common sexual practice for young Australians.

The campaign found 57 per cent of young Australians reported being strangled by a partner during sex, while 51 per cent said they had strangled a partner during sex. Among women, 61 per cent said they had experienced strangulation during sex.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Last year, the UK government moved to criminalise porn featuring strangulation or suffocating, introducing a bill that would make it illegal to create or share any such content.

It was recommended in a UK government-commissioned review of online pornography, which found that dangerous practices were being normalised, particularly for young people, through porn.

New South Wales Liberal leader Kellie Sloane has written to Prime Minister Anthony Albanese to call for a similar ban in Australia.

"When pornography depicts an act capable of causing brain injury, unconsciousness or death, it should not be treated as just another form of adult entertainment," she said in a statement on Sunday.

Speaking on ABC's Insiders, Plibersek said the government should look seriously at such a ban.

"There is something wrong with a situation where 60 per cent of young people say they've experienced strangulation during sexual encounters," the federal minister said.

Plibersek said it would be crucial to educate young people that pornography is not real life.

"We know that children as young as 10 are seeing pornography before they've had their first kiss; they're getting their sex education from pornography," she said.

The government has already introduced age restrictions for social media and pornography in a bid to limit what young people view online, though concerns have been raised about loopholes .

Federal Education Minister Jason Clare announced on Sunday that the federal government would review the existing consent and respectful relationships program in schools to determine whether it needs strengthening.

body.zh: 社会服务部长坦尼娅·普利伯塞克表示，政府正在考虑围绕网络安全进行进一步改革，并应该“非常认真地”考虑效仿英国，将色情作品中的勒杀描述定为非法。 在她发表上述言论之前，一名 16 岁女孩最近因涉嫌性勒颈而死亡。 这起死亡事件再次引发了人们对年轻人性暴力发生率上升的担忧。 据“气喘吁吁”运动称，勒颈——通常被称为“窒息”——已成为澳大利亚年轻人的常见性行为。 该活动发现，57% 的澳大利亚年轻人表示在性行为中被伴侣勒死，而 51% 的人表示他们在性行为中勒死过伴侣。在女性中，61% 的人表示她们在性行为中经历过勒颈。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 去年，英国政府将勒死或窒息的色情内容定为犯罪，并提出一项法案，规定创建或分享任何此类内容均为非法。 英国政府委托对网络色情内容进行的一项审查中建议了这一做法，该审查发现，通过色情内容，危险的做法正在正常化，尤其是对年轻人而言。 新南威尔士州自由党领袖凯利·斯隆（Kelly Sloane）已写信给总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞（Anthony Albanese），呼吁在澳大利亚实施类似的禁令。 她在周日的一份声明中表示：“当色情作品描绘一种能够导致脑损伤、失去知觉或死亡的行为时，它不应被视为成人娱乐的另一种形式。” 普利伯塞克在接受美国广播公司 (ABC) 的 Insiders 采访时表示，政府应该认真考虑这样的禁令。 这位联邦部长表示：“60% 的年轻人表示，他们在性接触中经历过勒颈，这种情况是有问题的。” 普利伯塞克表示，教育年轻人色情内容不是现实生活至关重要。 “我们知道，年仅 10 岁的孩子在初吻之前就会看到色情内容；他们从色情内容中接受性教育，”她说。 政府已经对社交媒体和色情内容实行了年龄限制，以限制年轻人在网上观看的内容，尽管有人担心存在漏洞。 联邦教育部长贾森·克莱尔周日宣布，联邦政府将审查学校现有的同意和尊重关系计划，以确定是否需要加强。 上周，邦迪三名青少年学生被指控性侵犯一名 14 岁女孩，三名男孩被指控在邦迪性侵犯一名 17 岁女孩。

title.en: China penalises 10 people for misinformation over deadly mudslide near Nepal border
title.zh: 中国因尼泊尔边境泥石流事件中的虚假信息处罚10人

summary.en: Chinese authorities have penalized 10 individuals accused of spreading misinformation online regarding a deadly mudslide near the Nepal border. Police stated that the penalties could range from fines to 10 days of detention. This action comes as rescue operations continue for hundreds missing after the mudslide...
summary.zh: 中国当局已处罚10名涉嫌在尼泊尔边境附近发生的致命泥石流事件中散布虚假信息的个人。警方表示，处罚范围可能从罚款到10天拘留不等。此前，上周泥石流横扫尼泊尔和中国西藏部分地区，冲毁了整个村庄，造成数百人失踪，搜救行动仍在进行中。据称，被处罚的个人传播了暗示死亡或失踪人数远超官方报告数字的谣言。

body.en: Chinese authorities penalised 10 people accused of spreading misinformation online about a deadly mudslide along the Nepal border, police said Monday, as rescuers scour for hundreds missing at a border crossing on the Tibetan side. Close-up of the Chinese national emblem. Photo: J. D. Brooks, via Pexels. The penalties, which could range from fines to 10 days in detention, come as rescuers on both sides of the border pressed on with search operations after a devastating wall of water tore through parts of Nepal and Tibet in China last week, sweeping away entire villages. Rumours shared by the 10 individuals suggested the number of missing or dead was vastly more than officially reported figures, according to a statement by the cybersecurity bureau of China’s Ministry of Public Security. One individual, surnamed Qiu, had shared online that “the news reports 1,400 fatalities, but in reality 3,000 people had previously been reported missing”, while another surnamed Liu had said more than 3,000 people died in China as a result of the mudslide, the statement added. Authorities did not specify what punishment each person received. The floods have killed at least 903 people in Nepal, where 4,247 people are missing, according to the country’s disaster authority. Another 16 have died and 546 people are missing in Chinese-administered Tibet, where the mudslide flattened an area of “about 0.7 square kilometres” — the equivalent of 98 football pitches, Chinese state media reported. ‘Malicious smearing and sensationalism’ Asked about international reports that China was censoring images of the floods and underreporting deaths, Beijing’s foreign ministry said on Monday that the “release of information has been open, transparent and timely”. The principle of speaking truth, as emphasized in Ephesians 4:25, calls for honesty and integrity in all...
