title.en: 50 arrested in crackdown on bid-rigging
title.zh: 打击围标活动逮捕50人

summary.en: Fifty individuals have been arrested in a coordinated operation targeting a syndicate accused of bribery and bid-rigging in major building maintenance and renovation projects. The operation, involving the Competition Commission, ICAC, and police, also seized project documents and financial records from 39 locations....
summary.zh: 五十人在一次联合行动中被捕，该行动针对一个涉嫌在主要楼宇维修和翻新项目中进行贿赂和围标的犯罪集团。此次行动由竞争事务委员会、廉政公署和警方联合进行，并搜查了39个地点，包括项目承包商和顾问的办公室，同时扣押了项目文件和会计记录。据称，这些非法活动涉及27个项目，总价值约合5亿港元。

body.en: Fifty people have been arrested in a joint operation against a syndicate alleged to be engaged in bribery and bid-rigging for major building maintenance and renovation projects. The arrests, which took in the suspected mastermind and core members of the syndicate, were in relation to 27 projects at housing estates and buildings. They are estimated to be worth approximately HK$500 million in total. In the joint operation by the Competition Commission, the Independent Commission Against Corruption and the police on August 26 and 27, project documents and accounting records were also seized in raids on 39 premises, which included the offices of project contractors and consultants. Illegal gambling premises, alleged to be controlled by people with triad backgrounds who were among those nabbed, were also raided. These raids resulted in the arrests of 25 men and 12 women aged between 24 and 62. The operation came following separate investigations carried out by the Competition Commission and the ICAC. The Competition Commission alleged that the syndicate was suspected of engaging in anti-competitive practices, including bid-rigging, market-sharing, price fixing and exchange of competitively sensitive information during tendering for multiple projects. The syndicate is alleged to have offered pricing instructions as well as worked with another bid-rigging syndicate to increase its chance of winning tenders, the watchdog said. The ICAC, meanwhile, launched the probe after receiving complaints that a contractor is believed to have obtained multiple contracts through corruption and bribery. The anti-graft agency alleged that the contractor, who is said to be the mastermind of the syndicate, bribed project consultants and some members of owners' corporations to secure contracts. The contractor had allegedly concealed the company's conviction records to win the bid as well as split up major renovation project into smaller parcels so as to circumvent procedures that require homeowners’ approval. The ICAC also suspects that some registered inspectors had failed to carry out their duties and has referred the case to the Buildings Department for follow-up action. Three of the suspects were arrested by the police for alleged conspiracy to use false instruments. They are suspected to have submitted 13 forged work-completion certificates to the Buildings Department that a registered inspector was said to have signed on to after the inspector had died. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 在针对一个涉嫌在大型建筑维护和翻修项目中进行贿赂和串通投标的犯罪集团的联合行动中，已有 50 人被捕。此次拘捕行动涉及该团伙的27个项目，涉及该团伙的主谋和核心成员。据估计，它们的总价值约为5亿港元。竞争事务委员会、廉政公署和警方在8月26日至27日的联合行动中，突击搜查了39个处所，包括工程承建商和顾问的办公室，检获项目文件和会计记录。据称由有黑社会背景的人控制的非法赌博场所也遭到突击搜查。这些突击行动逮捕了 25 名男性和 12 名女性，年龄在 24 岁至 62 岁之间。这次行动是在竞争委员会和廉政公署分别进行调查后进行的。竞争委员会指控该集团涉嫌参与反竞争行为，包括串通投标、分享市场、操纵价格以及在多个项目招标期间交换竞争敏感信息。该监管机构表示，该集团据称提供了定价指令，并与另一个串通投标集团合作，以增加中标的机会。与此同时，廉政公署在收到投诉后启动了调查，称一名承包商据信通过腐败和贿赂获得了多份合同。反贪机构指控，据称是该集团主谋的承包商向项目顾问和业主立案法团的一些成员行贿，以获得合同。据称，该承包商隐瞒了该公司的定罪记录以赢得投标，并将大型翻修项目分成较小的地块，以规避需要业主批准的程序。廉署亦怀疑部分注册督察没有履行职责，已将案件转介屋宇署跟进。其中三名嫌疑人因涉嫌串谋使用假仪器而被警方逮捕。他们涉嫌向屋宇署提交了13份伪造的竣工证明书，据称这些证明书是在一名注册检验员去世后签署的。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The news of 50 arrests for alleged bribery and bid-rigging in building projects underscores a persistent human struggle with greed and dishonesty. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.' This passage reminds us that true righteousness involves integrity in our dealings, compassion for those affected by...
reflection.zh: 关于楼宇工程中涉及贿赂和围标的50人被捕的消息，凸显了人类在贪婪和不诚实方面持续存在的挣扎。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的雅伟同行”。这段经文提醒我们，真正的公义包括在我们的交易中秉持诚信，对受腐败影响的人怀有怜悯之心，并在我们所有的行为中，尤其是在商业活动中，谦卑地承认雅伟的监督。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Court rejects appeal on Fanling Golf Course assessment
title.zh: 法院驳回粉岭高尔夫球场评估上诉

summary.en: The Court of Appeal has dismissed the government’s appeal against a High Court ruling that quashed the environmental approval for a public housing development on part of the Fanling Golf Course. The original ruling found that the Director of Environmental Protection had not acted in accordance with the law in...
summary.zh: 上诉法院驳回了政府针对高等法院一项裁决提出的上诉，该裁决取消了在粉岭高尔夫球场部分场地进行公共房屋开发的环保批准。原判认定环境保护主任在批准该项目环境影响评估时未依法行事。

body.en: The Court of Appeal has dismissed the government’s appeal against a High Court ruling in 2024 that quashed the environmental approval for a public housing development on part of the Fanling Golf Course. Back in 2023, the government had taken back 32 hectares of the 172-hectare golf course upon expiry of a land lease. It had planned to develop 9.5 hectares of the resumed site for into 12,000 public flats. Handing down the verdict on Monday, a three-judge panel led by Chief Judge Jeremy Poon upheld the Court of First Instance's decision, which concluded that the Director of Environmental Protection had not acted in accordance with the law in approving the project's environmental impact assessment (EIA) report. The government had contended that the judicial review had become "academic", pointing to its June 2023 amendment to the Environmental Impact Assessment Ordinance which removed the project from the list of designated developments requiring such assessments. The judges, however, determined that the approval remained a live issue, as the EIA report could still be relied upon for other purposes under the ordinance. In upholding the lower court's findings, the judges observed that the consultation process did not adequately cover supplementary information added to the EIA report, and that responses submitted by the golf club were not taken into consideration. The judges also found that the conditions attached to the approval were worded in a manner that effectively required a substantial redesign, which it ruled had fallen outside the permissible scope of conditional approval. The judgment further addressed the EIA report's treatment of protected trees, as well as the cultural heritage impact on the "Old Course," recognised as the oldest golf course in China. The lower court had previously described the classification of the impact on the Old Course as "undetermined" and "irrational", noting that the impact was, in its words, "blindingly obvious". Regarding the conditions imposed by the Environment Protection Department (EPD) on the Civil Engineering and Development Department (CEDD) — which included revising layout plans, preserving woodland, and submitting new designs for approval — the appellate court ruled that these requirements were not within the permissible limits of conditional approval, effectively deferring key decisions to a later stage. The DEP and CEDD were ordered to pay the golf club's costs for the dismissed appeal. Edited by Raymond Yeung
body.zh: 上诉法院驳回了政府针对高等法院 2024 年一项裁决提出的上诉，该裁决撤销了粉岭高尔夫球场部分公共房屋开发项目的环境批准。早在2023年，政府就在土地租约到期后收回了172公顷高尔夫球场中的32公顷。政府原计划将9.5公顷的收回土地发展为12,000个公营单位。周一，由首席法官潘杰里米率领的三名法官组成的合议庭作出裁决，维持原讼法庭的裁决，裁定环境保护署署长在批准该项目的环境影响评估报告时没有依法行事。政府声称司法审查已成为“学术性”，并指出其 2023 年 6 月对《环境影响评估条例》的修正案将该项目从需要进行此类评估的指定开发项目清单中删除。然而，法官们认为该批准仍然是一个现实问题，因为根据该法令，环评报告仍可用于其他目的。在维持下级法院的调查结果时，法官们指出，咨询过程没有充分涵盖环境影响评估报告中添加的补充信息，并且没有考虑高尔夫俱乐部提交的答复。法官还发现，批准所附条件的措辞实际上需要进行实质性重新设计，因此裁定这超出了有条件批准的允许范围。该判决进一步讨论了环评报告对受保护树木的处理，以及对被认为是中国最古老的高尔夫球场的“老球场”的文化遗产的影响。下级法院此前将对老球场的影响分类为“不确定”和“非理性”，并指出，用其话说，这种影响“非常明显”。关于环境保护署（环保署）对土木工程拓展署（土木工程拓展署）提出的条件，包括修改布局图、保护林地以及提交新设计供批准，上诉法院裁定这些要求不在有条件批准的允许范围内，实际上将关键决定推迟到稍后阶段。环境保护署和土木工程拓展署被责令支付该高尔夫球俱乐部因上诉被驳回而产生的费用。杨雷蒙编辑

reflection.en: This case underscores the importance of procedural justice and accountability in governance. When public officials fail to act lawfully, as the court found here, it erodes trust and can have significant consequences for both the environment and the public good. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true leadership requires acting justly, loving mercy, and walking...
reflection.zh: 此案凸显了治理中程序公正和问责制的重要性。当法院认定公职人员未能依法行事时，就会侵蚀信任，并可能对环境和公共利益产生重大影响。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，真正的领导力需要秉公行义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Hot property: Big banks, fashion stores seek ‘cheaper’, eye-catching Hong Kong retail
title.zh: 抢手房产：大银行、时尚店瞄准香港零售业的“便宜”且引人注目的地点

summary.en: Major banks and fashion retailers are taking advantage of potentially lower rents in Hong Kong's prime retail areas to secure eye-catching locations that enhance customer visibility. For instance, HSBC is opening its first flagship branch at the Capitol Centre, a space formerly occupied by luxury fashion brands, as it...
summary.zh: 从大银行到时尚品牌，租户正利用香港黄金地段零售空间的潜在较低租金，并利用引人注目的地点来提高客户可见度。例如，汇丰银行正将其首家旗舰分行设在国泰中心，这里此前曾是香奈儿等时尚零售商的所在地，同时该银行计划关闭在该市黄金购物区之一的铜锣湾的两个分行。

body.en: From big banks to fashion brands, tenants are taking advantage of potential lower rents for retail space in Hong Kong’s prime areas as they utilise eye-catching locations to boost visibility towards customers, according to agents. HSBC is unveiling its first flagship branch at the Capitol Centre, which was previously occupied by fashion retailers such as Chanel, Victoria’s Secret and Forever 21, as the bank prepares to close two branches in one of the city’s top shopping areas, Causeway Bay. The...
body.zh: 代理商表示，从大型银行到时尚品牌，租户正在利用香港黄金地段零售空间潜在的较低租金，利用引人注目的位置来提高对客户的知名度。汇丰银行在首都中心开设了第一家旗舰分行，该分行此前被香奈儿、维多利亚的秘密和 Forever 21 等时尚零售商占据，同时该银行准备关闭该市顶级购物区之一铜锣湾的两家分行。这...

reflection.en: In a dynamic market, businesses like HSBC and fashion brands are strategically repositioning themselves, seeking prominent locations to connect with customers. This pursuit of visibility and adaptation reflects a commitment to their work, aiming to thrive in changing economic landscapes. May all our endeavors, whether in finance or fashion, be undertaken...
reflection.zh: 在充满活力的市场中，汇丰银行和时尚品牌等企业正进行战略性重新定位，寻求显眼的位置与客户建立联系。这种对可见度的追求和适应反映了他们对工作的投入，旨在不断变化的经济格局中蓬勃发展。愿我们所有的努力，无论是在金融还是时尚领域，都能以勤奋和目标去完成，如同为更高的使命而服务。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: T1 to be issued at 6.10pm
title.zh: 一号戒备信号将于下午6时10分发出

summary.en: The Observatory announced it will issue Standby Signal No. 1 at 6:10 PM on Monday, as the remnant of Typhoon Saudel is expected to strengthen into a tropical depression. Saudel is currently near the southeastern coast of Hainan and is forecast to move across the northern South China Sea from Tuesday to Wednesday...
summary.zh: 天文台表示，将于周一下午6时10分发出预警信号一号，因为台风“沙德尔”的残余部分预计将加强为热带低气压。沙德尔目前正横过海南省东南海岸附近，并预测将于周二至周三横过南海北部，随后逐渐移向广东东部海岸。天文台将根据沙德尔的移动路径和本地风力变化，评估是否需要发出更高级别的警告信号。受沙德尔和东北季候风的共同影响，周二下午...

body.en: The Observatory said it will issue the Standby Signal No. 1 at 6.10pm on Monday, with the remnant of typhoon Saudel expected to intensify into a tropical depression. Saudel is moving across the vicinity of the southeastern coast of Hainan, and is forecast to move across the northern part of the South China Sea from Tuesday to Wednesday. It will then gradually move towards the coast of eastern Guangdong. The weather forecaster said it will assess the need for issuing higher warning signals depending on Saudel’s movement and changes in local wind strength. With the combined effect of Saudel and the northeast monsoon, winds will strengthen from Tuesday afternoon. Showers will also be heavier in parts of the city on Tuesday. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 天文台表示将于周一下午6时10分发出一号待命信号，预计台风“沙德尔”余波将增强为热带低气压。萨德尔正在海南东南沿海附近地区移动，预计周二至周三将穿越南海北部地区。随后将逐渐向粤东沿海移动。天气预报员表示，将根据萨德尔的动向和当地风力的变化，评估是否需要发布更高的警报信号。在萨德尔和东北季风的共同影响下，周二下午起风力将增强。周二该市部分地区的阵雨也将更大。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: As Hong Kong prepares for the potential impact of Typhoon Saudel, issuing a Standby Signal No. 1, the news reminds us of the unpredictable power of nature. In times of uncertainty and potential disruption, Psalm 46:1 offers a profound assurance: 'God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.' This ancient verse calls us to anchor our hope...
reflection.zh: 随着香港为台风“沙德尔”可能带来的影响做好准备，并发出了一号戒备信号，这则新闻提醒我们大自然不可预测的力量。在充满不确定性和潜在混乱的时刻，《诗篇》46:1...

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Hong Kong retail sales rise 4.5% in July, marking 15th straight month of growth
title.zh: 香港7月零售额增长4.5%，连续15个月增长

summary.en: Hong Kong's retail sector experienced its 15th consecutive month of growth in July, with a year-on-year increase of 4.5%. This expansion, reaching HK$31 billion for the month and 8.9% for the first seven months, was somewhat tempered by adverse weather and residents traveling abroad.
summary.zh: 香港零售业在7月份实现了连续第15个月的增长，同比增长4.5%。当月零售额达到310亿港元，前七个月的销售额增长了8.9%。然而，恶劣天气和居民出境旅游在一定程度上减缓了增长步伐。

body.en: Hong Kong’s retail sector recorded growth for a 15th consecutive month in July, with the government reporting a 4.5 per cent increase year on year, although the pace of expansion slowed amid adverse weather and continued outbound travel by residents. Retail sales value for the month reached HK$31 billion (US$4 billion), while sales in the first seven months of the year grew by 8.9 per cent compared with the same period in 2025, according to provisional figures released by the Census and...
body.zh: 香港零售业7月份连续第15个月录得增长，政府报告同比增长4.5%，但由于恶劣天气和居民持续出境旅游，扩张步伐放缓。根据人口普查和统计局发布的临时数据，本月零售额达到 310 亿港元（40 亿美元），而今年前 7 个月的销售额与 2025 年同期相比增长 8.9%。

reflection.en: The sustained growth in Hong Kong's retail sector, reaching HK$31 billion in July, is a testament to economic resilience. Deuteronomy 8:18 reminds us that it is Yahweh who gives us the ability to produce wealth, urging gratitude and remembrance of the source of prosperity even amidst success.
reflection.zh: 香港零售业在7月份录得310亿港元的销售额，持续增长的势头彰显了经济的韧性。申命记8:18提醒我们，是雅伟赐予我们获取财富的能力，这呼吁我们在成功之时也要心存感恩，并铭记繁荣的源头。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Hong Kong and Singapore property shrug off fund tax breaks
title.zh: 香港和新加坡的房地产在基金税收减免方面表现强劲

summary.en: Hong Kong and Singapore are intensifying their competition for investment talent, with tax incentives for fund managers becoming a key area of focus. Hong Kong is considering legislative changes to its tax rules on carried interest, aiming to offer preferential tax treatment to a wider range of alternative investments.
summary.zh: 香港和新加坡在争夺投资人才方面正加剧竞争，基金经理的税收优惠已成为一个关键焦点。香港正考虑修改其对附带权益的税收规则的立法，旨在为更广泛的另类投资提供优惠税收待遇。

body.en: The long-standing rivalry between Asia’s two leading financial centres is heating up. As Hong Kong and Singapore compete harder for investment talent, tax incentives for fund managers have emerged as the new battleground. A government bill working its way through Hong Kong’s Legislative Council would result in sweeping changes to tax rules on carried interest. The legislation, which is expected to be approved later this year, would offer preferential tax treatment to a wider range of alternative...
body.zh: 亚洲两大金融中心之间的长期竞争正在升温。随着香港和新加坡对投资人才的竞争更加激烈，针对基金经理的税收优惠已成为新的战场。香港立法会正在审议的一项政府法案将导致附带权益税收规则发生彻底改变。该立法预计将于今年晚些时候获得批准，将为更广泛的替代方案提供优惠税收待遇......

reflection.en: As financial centers like Hong Kong and Singapore strategize to attract investment talent, their efforts can be seen as a form of planning and work. The ancient wisdom reminds us to commit our endeavors, including economic and policy decisions, to Yahweh, trusting in His guidance for success and well-being. May leaders seek wisdom in their pursuit of...
reflection.zh: 当香港和新加坡等金融中心为吸引投资人才而制定策略时，它们的努力可以被视为一种规划和工作。古老的智慧提醒我们，要将我们的努力，包括经济和政策决策，都交托给雅伟，并信靠祂的指引以获得成功和福祉。愿领导者在追求繁荣时寻求智慧，确保他们的策略不仅服务于经济增长，也服务于更广泛的人类福祉。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: High-risk groups to get free flu jabs starting Sept 17
title.zh: 高危人群将于9月17日起免费接种流感疫苗

summary.en: Hong Kong health officials announced that eligible individuals, particularly children, the elderly, and those with chronic medical conditions, will be able to receive free or subsidized influenza vaccinations starting September 17. This initiative is part of the government's annual effort to prevent seasonal flu...
summary.zh: 香港卫生官员宣布，符合资格的市民，特别是儿童、长者及长期病患者，将于9月17日起免费或获资助接种流感疫苗。这是政府每年为遏制季节性流感爆发所做的努力的一部分，今年已采购约130万剂疫苗。

body.en: Health officials announced that eligible people will be able to receive free or subsidised influenza vaccinations starting September 17 as part of the government’s annual effort to curb seasonal flu outbreaks. The Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Programmes, coordinated by the Centre for Health Protection, will once again prioritise high-risk groups, especially children, the elderly and people with chronic medical conditions. The centre's controller, Edwin Tsui, confirmed that the government has procured around 1.3 million vaccine doses for this year’s campaign. The supply has been contracted to two licensed pharmaceutical wholesalers and includes four vaccine types across three platforms: injectable inactivated vaccines, nasal spray live-attenuated vaccines and injectable recombinant vaccines. Tsui emphasised the importance of immunisation in protecting the most vulnerable. "The seasonal influenza vaccine is very useful to reduce the mortality and morbidity and hospitalisation for both children and also elders," he said. "From our analysis of previous influenza seasons, those elders and also children are more vulnerable to the influenza attack. So having the influenza vaccine will definitely safeguard the health of the children and the elders." In the previous season, more than 2.03 million doses were administered under various government vaccination programmes. Overall coverage rates for target groups remained comparable to the previous year, though some age brackets saw notable improvements. Vaccination coverage for youngsters aged six months to 18 years hit 64.8 percent – 13 percentage points higher than the three-season average for the same period. Among those aged between 12 and 18, the rate reached 61.4 percent, marking an increase of 22.6 percentage points. The School Outreach Programme also expanded its reach, with more than 2,300 schools – representing 99 percent of all schools – completing vaccination activities by the end of December 2025, up from 91 percent the previous year. However, Tsui acknowledged that vaccination rates remained low in certain groups. Only 27 percent of infants aged six months to two years and 8.3 percent of adults aged 18 to 49 with chronic illnesses have been vaccinated. "In the future, we have to continue to promote the vaccination coverage to these target groups," he said. Reassuring the public, Tsui said this season’s vaccines are well matched to those influenza strains currently circulating. He added that health officials would continue to collaborate with the World Health Organization to monitor viral evolution and adjust strategies as needed. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 卫生官员宣布，作为政府遏制季节性流感爆发的年度努力的一部分，从 9 月 17 日开始，符合条件的人将能够接受免费或有补贴的流感疫苗接种。由卫生防护中心统筹的季节性流感疫苗计划将再次优先考虑高危人群，特别是儿童、长者和慢性病患者。该中心的控制员 Edwin Tsui 证实，政府已为今年的活动采购了约 130 万剂疫苗。供应已与两家持牌药品批发商签订合同，包括三个平台的四种疫苗类型：注射用灭活疫苗、鼻喷雾减毒活疫苗和注射用重组疫苗。徐强调了免疫接种对于保护最弱势群体的重要性。他说：“季节性流感疫苗对于降低儿童和老年人的死亡率、发病率和住院率非常有用。” “从往年流感季节的分析来看，那些长辈和小孩都比较容易受到流感的侵袭，因此接种流感疫苗绝对可以保障小孩和长辈的健康。”上一季，政府各种疫苗接种计划接种了超过 203 万剂疫苗。目标群体的总体覆盖率与上一年持平，但某些年龄段的覆盖率出现显着改善。 6个月至18岁青少年的疫苗接种率达到64.8%，比同期三个赛季的平均水平高出13个百分点。 12岁至18岁人群中，这一比例达到61.4%，同比增长22.6个百分点。学校外展计划还扩大了覆盖范围，到 2025 年 12 月底，已有 2,300 多所学校（占所有学校的 99%）完成了疫苗接种活动，高于上一年的 91%。然而，徐承认，某些群体的疫苗接种率仍然很低。只有 27% 的 6 个月至 2 岁婴儿和 8.3% 的 18 至 49 岁患有慢性病的成年人接种了疫苗。他说：“未来，我们要继续提高这些目标人群的疫苗接种覆盖率。”徐向公众保证，本季的疫苗与目前流行的流感病毒株非常匹配。他补充说，卫生官员将继续与世界卫生组织合作，监测病毒演变并根据需要调整策略。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: As Hong Kong launches its annual flu vaccination program, prioritizing vulnerable groups like children and the elderly, we are reminded of the importance of caring for the sick. This proactive public health measure reflects a societal commitment to well-being, echoing the biblical instruction to pray for those afflicted by illness. May this effort bring...
reflection.zh: 随着香港启动年度流感疫苗接种计划，优先为儿童和长者等弱势群体提供保护，我们被提醒要关怀病患的重要性。这项积极的公共卫生措施反映了社会对福祉的承诺，呼应了圣经中为病者祷告的教导。 愿此举措为社区带来保护和健康，特别是为那些风险最高的人群。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Student admits forging reference letter for PhD place at Education University
title.zh: 学生承认伪造推荐信以获得教育大学博士学位资格

summary.en: A 31-year-old student has pleaded guilty to obtaining services by deception after admitting to forging a reference letter to secure a PhD place at Hong Kong's Education University. The student commissioned an agent to rewrite the letter, falsely claiming it was from an academic.
summary.zh: 一名31岁的学生承认通过欺骗手段获取服务，并承认伪造推荐信以获得香港教育大学的博士学位资格。该学生委托一名代理重写了推荐信，并谎称信件来自一位学术界人士。

body.en: A student has admitted forging a reference letter to secure admission to a doctoral programme at a university in Hong Kong, after repeatedly failing to secure a place despite high hopes for her academic career. Fanling Court heard on Monday that 31-year-old Li Zuer from mainland China pleaded guilty to one count of obtaining services by deception. She commissioned a Shenzhen-based agent to rewrite a reference letter endorsing her academic performance and falsely claimed it had been submitted by...
body.zh: 一名学生承认，尽管对自己的学术生涯寄予厚望，但多次未能获得学位后，她伪造了一封推荐信以确保进入香港一所大学的博士课程。粉岭法院周一开庭审理，来自中国大陆的 31 岁李祖儿承认一项以欺骗手段获取服务的罪名。她委托深圳的一名代理人重写了一封推荐信，以支持她的学业表现，并谎称该推荐信是由……提交的。

reflection.en: The pursuit of academic advancement can sometimes lead individuals down paths of dishonesty. This case highlights the temptation to cut corners when faced with perceived obstacles, even when one has high hopes for their future. True success is built on integrity, not deception.
reflection.zh: 追求学术成就有时会使人走上不诚实的道路。此案凸显了在面对看似障碍时，即使对未来抱有厚望，也可能诱使人走捷径。真正的成功建立在诚信之上，而非欺骗。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Tai Po fire victim and petition organiser Jason Kong and wife charged with fraud and money laundering
title.zh: 大埔火灾幸存者、请愿组织者孔令晖及其妻子被控欺诈和洗钱

summary.en: A resident of Wang Fuk Court who advocated for the rights of fellow fire victims has been charged with fraud and money laundering along with his wife, more than three months after the couple were arrested. Police said on Sunday that Jason Kong and his wife, Rosanna Cheung, will appear at Sha Tin Magistrates' Courts on...
summary.zh: 一名倡导大埔火灾幸存者权利的王福庭苑居民及其妻子被控欺诈和洗钱，此前两人已被捕三个多月。警方周日表示，孔令晖及其妻子张女士将于周二在沙田裁判法院出庭。这对夫妇面临两项串谋欺诈罪和一项处理已知或相信为可起诉罪行的收益的罪名——即洗钱。

body.en: A Wang Fuk Court resident who advocated for the rights of fellow fire victims has been charged with fraud and money laundering along with his wife, more than three months after the couple were arrested. Wang Fuk Court resident Jason Kong in his new temporary housing unit in Hung Shui Kiu following the deadly Tai Po Fire. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Police said on Sunday that Jason Kong and his wife, Rosanna Cheung, will appear at Sha Tin Magistrates’ Courts on Tuesday. The pair face two counts of conspiracy to defraud and one count of dealing with property known or believed to represent proceeds of an indictable offence – known commonly as money laundering. They were arrested for alleged government loan fraud in May, two weeks after Kong delivered a petition urging the estate’s administrator to meet with homeowners. The couple, both directors of an interior design company, are alleged to have used fraudulent means to obtain several hundred thousand dollars in loans under the government’s Special 100% Loan Guarantee scheme. The scheme was launched by the Hong Kong government in early 2020 to help companies amid the Covid-19 pandemic. Shatin Magistrates’ Courts. Photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. Following their release from Tsuen Wan Police Station two days after their arrest, Kong said he would no longer be speaking to the press . An outspoken victim The couple are both survivors of the blaze that tore through Wang Fuk Court in November last year, claiming 168 lives and displacing thousands from the Tai Po estate. Kong, who was a member of the Wang Fuk Court owners’ corporation management committee at the time of the inferno, was initially outspoken about the tragedy. He urged the government to investigate the fire’s causes and to consider on-site redevelopment, a proposal supported by some residents but rejected by authorities . Kong also testified before an independent committee investigating the blaze in April, saying that government agencies had “failed in their duties” despite receiving complaints about the renovation project at the estate. Wang Fuk Court resident Jason Kong (left), one of the petition organisers, delivers their demands and the handwritten signatures to Hop On Management, a subsidiary of real estate giant Chinachem Group, on April 29, 2026. Photo: Supplied. On April 29, Kong delivered a petition with 247 signatories to the government-appointed administrator of Wang Fuk Court, Hop On Management, calling on the firm to hold a general meeting with homeowners to discuss long-term resettlement and related financial matters. Hop On later applied to extend the statutory deadline for holding an owners’ meeting, citing the need for more time to verify owners’ signatures and find a suitable venue. The Lands Tribunal, which...
body.zh: 宏福苑的一名居民为其他火灾受害者的权利发声，在夫妇俩被捕三个多月后，与他的妻子一起被指控欺诈和洗钱。致命的大埔火灾后，宏福苑居民江志强在他位于洪水桥的新临时住宅单位中。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。警方周日表示，江志强和他的妻子张丽珊将于周二在沙田裁判法院出庭。两人面临两项共谋诈骗罪和一项处理已知或据信代表可起诉犯罪（通常称为洗钱）所得财产的罪名。五月，孔提交请愿书敦促庄园管理员与房主会面两周后，他们因涉嫌政府贷款欺诈而被捕。这对夫妇都是一家室内设计公司的董事，他们被指控使用欺诈手段根据政府的100%特别贷款担保计划获得了数十万美元的贷款。该计划由香港政府于 2020 年初推出，旨在帮助企业应对 Covid-19 大流行。沙田裁判法院。照片：何凯莉/HKFP。被捕两天后，他们从荃湾警署获释，孔说他将不再向媒体发表讲话。直言不讳的受害者 这对夫妇都是去年 11 月横福苑大火的幸存者，这场大火夺去了 168 人的生命，并导致数千人流离失所。火灾发生时，康是宏福苑业主立案法团管理委员会的成员，他最初对这场悲剧直言不讳。他敦促政府调查火灾原因并考虑现场重建，这一提议得到了一些居民的支持，但遭到当局拒绝。孔还在四月份调查火灾的独立委员会作证时表示，尽管收到了有关该庄园翻修工程的投诉，但政府机构“未能履行职责”。 2026 年 4 月 29 日，请愿组织者之一、宏福苑居民江志强（左）向房地产巨头华懋集团旗下合安管理公司递交诉求和手写签名。照片：提供。 4月29日，江向政府指定的宏福苑管理人合安管理公司递交了一份有247名签署人的请愿书，呼吁该公司与业主召开股东大会，讨论长期安置和相关财务事宜。合安后来申请延长举行业主大会的法定期限，理由是需要更多时间核实业主签名并寻找合适的地点。土地法庭，...

reflection.en: The news of Jason Kong and his wife facing charges of fraud and money laundering is a somber reminder of how easily the pursuit of wealth can lead to ruin. The Bible warns that the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil, and these charges suggest a path taken that strayed far from integrity. May this serve as a caution against greed and a call to...
reflection.zh: 孔令晖及其妻子被控欺诈和洗钱的消息，令人警惕地提醒我们，对财富的追求很容易导致毁灭。圣经警告说，贪财是万恶之根，这些指控表明他们走上了一条偏离诚信的道路。愿这成为对贪婪的警示，并呼吁在所有交易中坚守诚实。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: HK 'can become hub for embodied AI robot development'
title.zh: 香港可成为实体人工智能机器人开发的中心

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan stated on Monday that Hong Kong is well-positioned to play a significant role in the development of embodied artificial intelligence. He cited the city's international application scenarios for robots, its robust research and development ecosystem, and available financial support as key...
summary.zh: 财政司司长陈茂波周一表示，香港有潜力成为实体人工智能（AI）发展的重要枢纽。他指出，香港拥有机器人应用的国际化场景、蓬勃的研发生态系统以及财政支持等优势。陈茂波是在一家内地公司Galbot推出首批配备人形机器人的无人零售店的启动仪式上发表此番言论的，并强调香港应为新技术腾出空间以推动创新。

body.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said on Monday Hong Kong can play a unique and important role in the development of embodied artificial intelligence. He said the city offers an international application scenario for robots, a thriving research and development ecosystem, as well as financial support. Chan made the remarks at a launch ceremony for the first batch of autonomous retail stores that feature humanoid robots made by mainland firm Galbot. He said the SAR should make room for new technologies to drive innovation. “Hong Kong's dense population provides efficient and diverse scenarios, and there is a high degree of internationalisation,” he said. “Galbot, one of the frontrunners in the field of embodied AI, has chosen to demonstrate its most advanced technologies in Hong Kong. “This marks a key step for the firm to expand its international business and take its technology overseas. We welcome and fully support the application of embodied AI in Hong Kong.” Chan also said Hong Kong has the capabilities to become a hub for research and development, as well as manufacturing, for next-generation embodied AI robots, thanks to its close connections with the Greater Bay Area (GBA) The SAR, he stressed, is equipped with intellectual property protective mechanisms, international data and talent nurtured by world-class universities, while neighbouring GBA cities possess world-leading capabilities in advanced manufacturing. Clara Chan, chief executive of Hong Kong Investment Corporation, said the two-year investment in Galbot by the government-owned company has led to fruitful results. She hopes the advent of embodied AI can empower Hong Kong’s industrial, economic and social development. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 财政司司长陈茂波周一表示，香港可以在实体人工智能的发展中发挥独特而重要的作用。他说，这座城市为机器人提供了国际化的应用场景、蓬勃发展的研发生态系统以及金融支持。陈在首批自主零售店启动仪式上发表上述言论，该零售店配备了大陆公司高博特制造的人形机器人。他表示，特区应为新技术腾出空间，以推动创新。 “香港人口稠密，提供了高效、多样化的场景，而且国际化程度很高，”他说。 “Galbot是实体人工智能领域的领跑者之一，选择在香港展示其最先进的技术。“这标志着该公司拓展国际业务并将其技术带到海外的关键一步。我们欢迎并全力支持实体人工智能在香港的应用。”陈茂波还表示，香港与大湾区联系紧密，有能力成为下一代实体人工智能机器人的研发和制造中心。他强调，香港特别行政区拥有知识产权保护机制、国际数据和世界一流大学培养的人才，而邻近的大湾区城市则拥有世界领先的先进制造能力。香港投资有限公司行政总裁陈嘉敏表示，政府企业对高博特的两年投资已取得丰硕成果。她希望实体人工智能的出现能够为香港的工业、经济和社会发展赋能。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, particularly in embodied forms like humanoid robots, presents both opportunities and challenges. As Hong Kong aims to become a hub for this technology, it's a reminder of Daniel's prophecy that in the end times, 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This surge in knowledge calls for...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展，特别是具身智能（如人形机器人）的进步，带来了机遇和挑战。香港正致力于成为这一技术发展的中心，这恰恰印证了但以理的预言：在末世，“必有多人来往奔走，知识必增长”。知识的激增呼唤着智慧和伦理考量来指导其应用。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Canada ends Hong Kong ‘lifeboat’ immigration scheme launched in the wake of national security law
title.zh: 加拿大结束为香港人设立的“救生艇”移民计划

summary.en: Canada has stopped accepting new applications for a special immigration program designed to help Hongkongers gain permanent residency. The 'lifeboat' scheme, introduced after the national security law was imposed, will close to new applicants on August 31, though existing applications will still be processed.
summary.zh: 加拿大已停止接受一项旨在帮助香港人获得永久居留权的特别移民计划的新申请。“救生艇”计划是在实施国安法后推出的，将于8月31日停止接受新申请，但现有申请仍将继续处理。

body.en: Canada has ceased accepting applicants for a “lifeboat” immigration scheme introduced for Hongkongers in the wake of the national security law. A Canadian flag flutters over Giant’s Head Mountain in Summerland, British Columbia. Photo: Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP. Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada, the government department responsible for immigration to the country, said in a statement on Friday that the scheme – which allows Hongkongers to gain permanent residency in Canada – would close to new applicants from August 31. “We continue to process applications received on or before that date,” the department said. Ottawa had earlier announced that the scheme would expire at the end of August 2026. Hongkongers who have already applied can still live and work in Canada while their application is being processed, the department said. They are able to do so under an extended open work permit programme, which will remain in place until May 2029. 13,000 granted permanent residence Canada launched the immigration scheme in 2021, a response to the Beijing-imposed national security law passed in June 2020 following the anti-extradition protests and unrest. A national security law poster. Photo: GovHK. While Hong Kong authorities said the law was needed to restore stability, Western governments and international organisations raised concerns about its impact on the city’s freedoms. Canada’s scheme provided two pathways for Hongkongers to gain permanent residence. Scheme A was for those who graduated from a post-secondary institution in Canada in the three years prior to applying, while Stream B was for those who – under the work permit programme – had one year of work experience in the country. Announcing the scheme five years ago, Canada’s then-immigration minister said the programme was a “landmark initiative” that would “deepen the strong ties between Canada and the people of Hong Kong.” See also: ‘Hanging halfway’: In wake of Canada’s immigration delay, Hong Kong emigrants ponder whether to stay or return home In the Friday statement, Canada’s immigration department said it had received applications from around 48,560 people. Among them, 13,370 have been granted permanent residence. Hongkongers who applied have spoken of longer than expected wait times, with some deciding to return home while waiting for the outcome.
body.zh: 加拿大已停止接受国家安全法实施后为香港人推出的“救生艇”移民计划的申请人。一面加拿大国旗飘扬在不列颠哥伦比亚省萨默兰的巨人头山上。照片：Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP。负责加拿大移民事务的政府部门加拿大移民、难民和公民部周五在一份声明中表示，该计划（允许香港人获得加拿大永久居留权）将从 8 月 31 日起停止接受新申请人。“我们将继续处理该日期或之前收到的申请，”该部门表示。渥太华早前宣布该计划将于2026年8月底到期。该部门表示，已经申请的香港人在申请处理期间仍可以在加拿大生活和工作。他们可以根据延长的开放工作许可证计划做到这一点，该计划将持续到 2029 年 5 月。13,000 名获得加拿大永久居留权的人于 2021 年启动了移民计划，这是对北京在反引渡抗议和骚乱后于 2020 年 6 月通过的国家安全法的回应。国家安全法海报。照片：香港政府一站通。尽管香港当局表示需要该法律来恢复稳定，但西方政府和国际组织对其对香港自由的影响表示担忧。加拿大的计划为香港人获得永久居留权提供了两种途径。计划A适用于申请前三年内从加拿大高等教育机构毕业的人，而流B则适用于根据工作许可计划在该国拥有一年工作经验的人。五年前宣布该计划时，加拿大时任移民部长表示，该计划是一项“具有里程碑意义的举措”，将“加深加拿大与香港人民之间的牢固联系”。另请参阅：“半途而废”：加拿大移民延误后，香港移民考虑是留下还是回国 在周五的声明中，加拿大移民部门表示已收到约 48,560 人的申请。其中，13,370人获得永久居留权。申请的香港人表示，等待时间比预期要长，一些人决定在等待结果期间回国。

reflection.en: Canada's 'lifeboat' immigration scheme for Hongkongers is closing to new applicants. This news highlights the vulnerability of those seeking refuge or a new start when pathways are closed. The principle of Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," reminding us to consider the plight of those left without such...
reflection.zh: 加拿大为香港人设立的“救生艇”移民计划已停止接受新申请。这一消息凸显了那些寻求庇护或新开始的人在通道关闭时的脆弱性。《箴言》31:8-9的原则呼吁我们“为不能说话的人说话”，提醒我们要顾念那些失去这些救生索的人的困境。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Tai Po fire: To sell or not to sell? As gov’t deadline looms, some owners still hope their homes can rise from the ashes
title.zh: 大埔火灾：卖还是不卖？政府最后期限临近，一些业主仍希望他们的家园能从灰烬中重生

summary.en: Betty Ho is determined not to sell her flat in Wang Fuk Court under a government buyout scheme that expires Monday afternoon. Nine months have passed since the blaze that killed 168 people and displaced thousands from the Tai Po housing estate. An independent committee is still preparing its final report on the fire's...
summary.zh: 在政府收购计划的最后期限（周一下午）临近之际，何女士坚决不愿出售她在宏福苑的公寓。自那场夺走168人生命并导致大埔邨数千人流离失所的大火已过去九个月。一个独立委员会仍在准备关于火灾原因及其暴露出的系统性失误的最终报告，而1984户家庭必须在周一前接受政府的收购要约，大多数业主已同意了条款。

body.en: Betty Ho is adamant that she will not sell her flat in Wang Fuk Court under a government buyout scheme that is due to expire on Monday afternoon. Betty Ho says she will not sell her Wang Fuk Court flat under a government buyout scheme. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Nine months have passed since the blaze that killed 168 people and displaced thousands from the Tai Po housing estate . An independent committee is still preparing its final report on what caused the fire and how the systemic failures it exposed can be addressed. Meanwhile, 1,984 households have until 5pm on Monday to accept the government’s acquisition offer. Most homeowners have already accepted their terms. By last Thursday, 96.5 per cent of homeowners had signed a letter indicating that they were willing to sell their flat under the official plan, either for a cash pay-out or in return for a new unit in another government-subsidised development, according to official data. A little more than three-quarters have also taken the next step in the process, signing a formal sales agreement. But Ho, who bought a flat in Wang Shing House under her mother’s name in 1991, is one of those insisting that the government rebuild the estate on its original site for those who wish to return – a demand firmly rejected by the authorities, on the grounds that it would take a decade to rebuild. The government’s letter of acquisition addressed to Wang Fuk Court owners. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “We have always demanded on-site redevelopment, but we also know they won’t do it,” Ho said in Cantonese. The government has said that the August 31 deadline will not be extended, and it has not ruled out using “legislative means” to deal with remaining unsold flats in the future. As the deadline approached, some residents felt forced into submission. They said they were worried about their future housing, and feared that they would be forced to surrender their property by law if they declined to sell. “I feel helpless. I know that many of us don’t want to sign [the agreement],” Woo, a Wang Yan House resident who asked to be identified only by her surname, told HKFP in Cantonese. “We don’t know what we can do.” Wang Fuk Court resident Woo said she felt “helpless” in the face of the government’s acquisition offer. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. With the buyout deadline looming, unsold properties now risk becoming “nail houses” – a Chinese term for holdouts who refuse to make way for development, often ending up isolated, cut off from utilities, and subjected to legal battles and harassment. Anthony Cheung, a public administration scholar who served as secretary for transport and housing from 2012 to 2017, said legislation for compulsory acquisition could be challenged in court...
body.zh: 何贝蒂坚决表示，根据将于周一下午到期的政府买断计划，她不会出售宏福苑的公寓。何贝蒂表示，她不会根据政府买断计划出售宏福苑的公寓。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。大埔住宅区大火造成 168 人死亡，数千人流离失所，距今已过去九个月了。一个独立委员会仍在准备关于火灾原因以及如何解决火灾所暴露的系统性故障的最终报告。与此同时，1,984户家庭必须在周一下午5点之前接受政府的收购要约。大多数房主已经接受了他们的条款。官方数据显示，截至上周四，96.5%的房主签署了一封信，表明他们愿意根据官方计划出售自己的公寓，要么获得现金支付，要么换取另一个政府补贴开发项目中的新单元。超过四分之三的人还采取了下一步，签署了正式的销售协议。但何女士于1991年以母亲的名义在宏盛楼购买了一套公寓，她是坚持要求政府在原址为那些希望返回的人重建该住宅的人之一——这一要求遭到当局坚决拒绝，理由是重建需要十年时间。政府向宏福苑业主发出的收购函。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “我们一直要求现场重建，但我们也知道他们不会这么做，”何先生用广东话说道。政府表示不会延长8月31日的期限，也不排除未来以“立法手段”处理剩余未售单位。随着最后期限的临近，一些居民感到被迫屈服。他们表示，他们对未来的住房感到担忧，并担心如果拒绝出售，他们将被迫依法交出房产。 “我感到很无助。我知道我们很多人都不想签署（协议），”一位不愿透露姓名的王燕楼居民吴用粤语告诉《香港新闻社》。 “我们不知道我们能做什么。”宏福苑居民胡表示，面对政府的收购要约，她感到“无助”。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。随着买断期限的临近，未售出的房产现在面临着成为“钉子户”的风险——这是一个中文术语，指那些拒绝为开发让路的人，往往最终会被孤立、与公用事业断绝联系，并遭受法律诉讼和骚扰。 2012年至2017年担任运输及房屋局局长的公共行政学者张永明表示，强制收购的立法可能会在法庭上受到质疑……

reflection.en: The devastating fire at Tai Po's Wang Fuk Court, which claimed 168 lives and displaced thousands, leaves a deep scar of grief and loss. For those like Betty Ho, the trauma lingers, compounded by the uncertainty of rebuilding and the government's buyout deadline. Yet, Revelation 21:4 offers a profound hope: a future where 'death shall be no more, neither...
reflection.zh: 大埔宏福苑那场夺走168条生命、导致数千人流离失所的毁灭性火灾，留下了深刻的悲伤和失落的创伤。对于像何女士这样的居民来说，创伤挥之不去，又因重建的不确定性和政府的收购最后期限而倍感压力。然而，《启示录》21:4 提供了一个深刻的盼望：未来“不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭泣、疼痛”。这一异象提醒我们，即使在巨大的苦难中，雅伟也应许了最终的修复与和平。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Rescuers dig into tunnel as missing toll from Nepal, China flood tops 3,000
title.zh: 救援人员挖掘隧道，尼泊尔、中国洪水失踪人数超3000

summary.en: Rescuers in Nepal and China battled Sunday through leg-sucking mud and the threat of rising rivers and a newly formed lake to search for thousands missing after a deadly wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayas, engulfing entire villages. Latest figures from both countries put the number of missing at...
summary.zh: 周日，尼泊尔和中国的救援人员在吸腿的泥泞中，冒着河流上涨和新形成的湖泊的威胁，搜寻在喜马拉雅山脉被致命的水墙和碎片吞噬、吞没整个村庄后失踪的数千人。两国公布的最新数字显示，失踪人数为3044人，另有750人确认死亡。

body.en: Rescuers in Nepal and China battled Sunday through leg-sucking mud and the threat of rising rivers and a newly formed lake to search for thousands missing after a deadly wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayas, engulfing entire villages. A team of Nepal police and National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) retrieves money and documents from a bank covered in sludge in the aftermath of flash floods at Trishuli in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on August 30, 2026. Photo: Arun Sankar/AFP. Latest figures from both countries put the number of missing at 3,044 , with a further 750 confirmed deaths — and reports of some bodies possibly swept downstream as far away as India. The disaster, which struck the China-Nepal border Wednesday morning, was caused by a glacial collapse, sending a wall of water and debris downstream, the US Geological Survey said. Chinese rescuers near the Tibet border port that was hit by a deadly mudslide were “moved to a safe location” Sunday, after a new lake was formed by a landslide, state media reported. Nepali army troops and engineers were working on Sunday to rescue workers believed trapped in a tunnel at the Trishuli 3A hydroelectric site after they successfully inserted a pipe into the passage. They have “started sending air through the small opening”, Nepali Home Minister Sudan Gurung said in a statement. Embed from Getty Images Overnight rain and rising river waters hampered efforts early Sunday, filling the excavation area with water before conditions eased and teams resumed efforts, the Nepal army said. In an area home to vast energy infrastructure projects, Nepal’s disaster authority listed 933 hydropower workers among the missing. China’s state news agency Xinhua reported on Sunday that experts had said “a glacier on the southern slope of Lirung Peak in Nepal” fractured, triggering an ice-rock avalanche. It said the torrent plummeted rapidly, forming a massive debris flow that travelled more than 20 kilometres before crashing into Gyirong Port. “The sudden glacial collapse and flash flood is a devastating reminder of how fragile these mountain environments can be,” UN climate chief Simon Steill said in a statement. ‘Nothing left’ Survivors face an agonising wait to learn the fate of missing relatives and the prospect of rebuilding their lives from nothing. “All the settlements near the river were swept away,” Buddhi Ram Dangol told AFP in Nepal’s Nuwakot district. “There is nothing left.” At an army base serving as a rescue hub in Bidur, relatives crowded around lists of rescued people pasted on a wall. “I have come here looking for my son,” said Kalka Sharda,...
body.zh: 周日，一道致命的水墙和碎片席卷喜马拉雅山，吞没了整个村庄，尼泊尔和中国的救援人员在泥泞、河流上涨和新形成的湖泊的威胁下奋力搜寻数千名失踪人员。 2026 年 8 月 30 日，尼泊尔努瓦科特地区 Trishuli 发生山洪，尼泊尔警察和国家减少灾害风险管理局 (NDRRMA) 组成的团队从一家被污泥覆盖的银行取回资金和文件。照片：Arun Sankar/法新社。两国的最新数据显示，失踪人数为 3,044 人，另有 750 人确诊死亡，据报道，一些尸体可能被冲到下游，远至印度。美国地质调查局表示，周三上午发生在中国和尼泊尔边境的这场灾难是由冰川崩塌引起的，导致水墙和碎片向下游流动。据官方媒体报道，西藏边境口岸附近遭受致命泥石流袭击的中国救援人员周日“被转移到安全地点”，山体滑坡形成了一个新的湖泊。周日，尼泊尔军队和工程师正在努力营救据信被困在 Trishuli 3A 水电站隧道中的工人，他们成功地将一根管道插入通道。尼泊尔内政部长苏丹古隆在一份声明中表示，他们已经“开始通过小开口输送空气”。尼泊尔军方表示，夜间降雨和不断上涨的河水阻碍了周日早些时候的工作，在情况缓解且工作人员恢复工作之前，挖掘区域已被水淹没。在一个拥有大型能源基础设施项目的地区，尼泊尔救灾当局将 933 名水电工人列为失踪人员。中国官方通讯社新华社周日报道称，专家表示，“尼泊尔利隆峰南坡的一座冰川”破裂，引发了冰岩雪崩。据称，洪流急速下降，形成巨大泥石流，行程20多公里，冲入吉隆口岸。联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯泰尔在一份声明中表示：“突然的冰川崩塌和山洪爆发毁灭性地提醒人们，这些山区环境是多么脆弱。” “一无所有”幸存者面临着痛苦的等待，他们想了解失踪亲人的命运，以及从一无所有中重建生活的前景。尼泊尔努瓦科特地区的布迪·拉姆·丹戈尔（Buddhi Ram Dangol）告诉法新社：“河流附近的所有定居点都被冲走了。” “什么都没有剩下了。”在比杜尔的一个作为救援中心的军事基地，亲属们围在墙上贴着的获救人员名单周围。 “我来这里是为了寻找我的儿子，”卡尔卡·沙达说……

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal and China have left thousands missing and hundreds dead, engulfing entire villages in a wall of water and debris. In these moments of profound loss and uncertainty, we are called to see the face of Christ in the suffering. Our efforts to rescue, comfort, and provide aid are acts of service to Him who said, 'whatever you did...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和中国的毁灭性洪水已导致数千人失踪，数百人死亡，整个村庄被水墙和碎片吞没。在这些深刻的失落和不确定时刻，我们被呼召在苦难中看见基督的面容。我们救援、安慰和提供援助的努力，都是在服侍祂，因为祂说：“凡你们对我这些最小的弟兄所做的，就是对我做的。”

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 伦敦股市避开了 Shein 这颗“子弹”

summary.en: Shein, the Chinese fast-fashion giant, is set to list in Hong Kong with a reduced valuation after a potential London IPO stalled. Despite intense wooing by UK politicians seeking to revitalize the local market with 'tech adrenalin,' significant concerns regarding Shein's business model and ethical practices led to a...
summary.zh: 中国快时尚巨头 Shein 在伦敦上市计划搁置后，将转往香港上市，但估值有所缩水。尽管英国政界此前为了振兴当地市场而积极拉拢，希望注入“技术兴奋剂”，但由于对其商业模式和伦理实践存在重大疑虑，伦敦金融界对于未能成事反而感到一种解脱。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大质疑在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。从 2024 年到去年，随着两大主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of rapid economic growth often tempts leaders to overlook the long-term health and ethical foundations of their institutions. While the 'tech adrenalin' of a massive IPO is attractive, true prudence involves recognizing when a short-term gain carries risks that outweigh the benefits. Yahweh values the wisdom that looks beyond the surface of a...
reflection.zh: 对经济快速增长的追求往往诱使领导者忽视机构的长期健康和伦理基础。虽然大规模 IPO 带来的“技术兴奋剂”极具吸引力，但真正的谨慎在于识别短期利益何时携带了超过收益的风险。雅伟看重那种能看透“缩水的价格标签”表面、审视内在工作诚信的智慧。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of two Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen vigil highlights the silencing of memory and dissent. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...
reflection.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织天安门守夜活动而被定罪，这凸显了记忆和异议被压制的情况。箴言31:8呼吁我们“为不能自辩的人开口”，这正是那些努力让1989年真相得以存留的人所体现的原则。随着香港自由的被扼杀，这个故事提醒我们，其他人有道德义务为那些被噤声的人发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists
title.zh: “她无所畏惧”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动家狱中笔迹

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021 and has written about various topics, including her personal struggles with maintaining dignity in prison, such as worrying about her hairstyle before court appearances due to lack of amenities. She emphasizes the importance of holding onto personal expression to resist...
summary.zh: 邹幸彤自2021年起被拘留，她写过各种话题，包括她在狱中努力维持个人尊严的挣扎，例如因缺乏便利设施而担心出庭前的发型。她强调了坚持个人表达方式以抵制统一规则和日程安排造成的非人化待遇的重要性。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the stark confines of her prison cell, Chow Hang-tung finds profound meaning in the small act of caring for her appearance, recognizing it as a vital means of preserving her identity. Her writings remind us that even in the most oppressive circumstances, the human spirit's need for self-expression and dignity endures, echoing the call to be a voice for...
reflection.zh: 在监狱的严酷环境中，邹幸彤在梳理仪容这个小小的举动中找到了深刻的意义，认识到这是维护她身份的重要方式。她的文字提醒我们，即使在最压抑的环境下，人类精神对自我表达和尊严的需求依然存在，这呼应了为无声者发声并维护每个人内在价值的呼召。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’
title.zh: 香港“六四”维权人士被判“煽动颠覆国家政权”罪

summary.en: Two Hong Kong activists, Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, have been convicted of "incitement to subversion" for organizing annual vigils commemorating the 1989 Tiananmen crackdown. This is a significant case under Beijing's national security law imposed in 2020. The UK Foreign Office has condemned the use of the law...
summary.zh: 香港两名活动人士李卓人（69岁）和邹幸彤（41岁）因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的年度守夜活动，被判犯有“煽动颠覆国家政权”罪。这是自2020年北京实施国家安全法以来，香港最引人注目的案件之一。英国外交部谴责了在此案中使用该法律。被告最高可判处10年监禁。

body.en: UK Foreign Office condemns use of national security law to convict activists Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung Two Hong Kong activists who organised annual vigils marking China’s deadly Tiananmen crackdown in 1989 have been found guilty of “incitement to subversion” in one of the most high-profile cases in Hong Kong since Beijing imposed its national security law in 2020. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”, a press summary handed out to reporters said. The defendants each face a maximum penalty of 10 years in jail, with sentencing expected at a later date. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国外交部谴责利用国家安全法对活动人士李卓人和周恒东定罪 两名香港活动人士组织了年度守夜活动，纪念中国 1989 年致命的天安门镇压，他们被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”，这是自北京于 2020 年实施国家安全法以来香港最引人注目的案件之一。李卓人，69 岁和周恒东，41 岁，一份发给记者的新闻摘要称，“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。被告每人将面临最高 10 年监禁的刑罚，预计稍后宣判。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung for organizing vigils to remember the Tiananmen crackdown highlights the struggle for remembrance and justice. The prophet Amos declared, "Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!" These activists sought to keep a historical memory alive, a form of demanding justice for...
reflection.zh: 李卓人与邹幸彤因组织守夜活动以纪念天安门镇压而被定罪，这凸显了为记忆与公义而进行的斗争。先知阿摩司宣告：“惟愿公平如大水滚滚， योग्य如江河滔滔。” 这两位活动人士试图让历史的记忆得以延续，这是一种为过去的错误伸张正义的方式。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.zh: 自然科学

title.en: Space junk punched a new hole in the moon. It’s not ours to abuse | Moriba Jah
title.zh: 太空垃圾在月球上打了个新洞。我们无权滥用它

summary.en: A piece of defunct SpaceX rocket debris impacted the Moon on August 5th, creating a new crater near Einstein Crater. While astronomers observed the resulting plume of sodium and lithium, the incident highlights the growing problem of space junk and the lack of accountability within the space industry for discarding...
summary.zh: 8月5日，一块报废的SpaceX火箭残骸撞击了月球，在爱因斯坦陨石坑附近形成了一个新陨石坑。天文学家观测到了由此产生的钠和锂的羽状物，但这一事件凸显了太空垃圾日益增长的问题，以及太空行业在轨道上随意丢弃废弃物而缺乏问责制的情况。

body.en: The space industry treats the sky as a place to dump what it no longer wants. We must develop a new model of accountability On 5 August, a piece of a derelict SpaceX rocket traveling at 5,400 miles an hour met with the moon and punched a fresh hole into it near Einstein Crater . Astronomers were thrilled. The European Southern Observatory caught sodium and lithium flaring in the debris plume and called it a bonus. The media called it a light show. Nobody was physically hurt, so nobody is responsible, and within a week the story was gone. I have spent 20 years tracking the junk humanity leaves behind in space for a living, and I want to tell you plainly what that crater actually is: a receipt. It’s what you get when an entire industry treats the sky, and now the moon, as a place to dump what it no longer wants, and calls the dumping “normal operations” or “space exploration”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 航天工业将天空视为倾倒不再想要的东西的地方。我们必须制定新的问责模式 8 月 5 日，一枚废弃 SpaceX 火箭的一块碎片以每小时 5,400 英里的速度与月球相遇，并在爱因斯坦陨石坑附近的月球上砸出了一个新的洞。天文学家们兴奋不已。欧洲南方天文台在碎片羽流中发现了钠和锂的燃烧，并将其称为额外奖励。媒体称其为灯光秀。没有人受到身体伤害，所以没有人负责，一周之内这个故事就消失了。我花了 20 年的时间追踪人类在太空中留下的垃圾为生，我想清楚地告诉你那个陨石坑实际上是什么：一张收据。当整个行业将天空和现在的月球视为倾倒不再想要的东西的地方，并将倾倒称为“正常操作”或“太空探索”时，你就会得到这样的结果。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of a rocket fragment creating a new crater on the Moon serves as a stark reminder of our stewardship over creation, both on Earth and beyond. Psalm 24:1 reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' This includes the vastness of space and the celestial bodies within it, which are not ours to defile with our waste.
reflection.zh: 火箭碎片在月球上造成新陨石坑的新闻，提醒我们对创造物的管家职分，无论是在地球上还是在地球之外。诗篇24:1提醒我们：“地和其中所充满的，都属于雅伟。”这包括浩瀚的太空及其中的天体，它们并非我们可随意用垃圾玷污之物。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Not tiger, not wolf: Australian thylacine skull reveals a far different hunting style
title.zh: 并非老虎，并非狼：澳大利亚袋狼头骨揭示截然不同的捕猎方式

summary.en: A new study analyzing the skull of the extinct thylacine, or 'Tasmanian tiger,' has revealed that this apex predator hunted very differently from wolves and wild dogs, challenging previous assumptions before its extinction.
summary.zh: 一项对已灭绝的袋狼（或称“塔斯马尼亚虎”）头骨进行分析的新研究表明，这种顶级掠食者在灭绝前的捕猎方式与狼和野狗截然不同，颠覆了此前的假设。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A new study led by Flinders University has flipped the historical narrative about Australia's thylacine, finding the native apex predator known as the "Tasmanian tiger" was significantly different from the wolves and wild dogs it was likened to before being hunted to extinction.

In-depth investigations of historical thylacine (Thylacinus cynocephalus) skull specimens indicate their jaws were probably unsuited to holding down large animals like sheep—instead, their long, deep jaws would have been able to subdue relatively small prey with powerful snapping bites.

"Our latest findings on their feeding adaptations counter the myths that drove the thylacine to extinction," says study lead Professor Vera Weisbecker, from the College of Science and Engineering at Flinders University.

"Thylacines were often compared to northern hemisphere predators such as wolves, jackals and foxes from the dog family Canidae. This resemblance gave them their species name 'cynocephalus,' meaning 'dog-head.'

"But thylacines were in fact more closely related to kangaroos than to dogs. They were marsupials, whose ancestors separated from the other mammals long before the dinosaurs went extinct."

In a major reinterpretation of the thylacine's biting behavior, published in Nature Communications , the research team from Flinders University and the University of Melbourne found that thylacine skulls sported a unique combination of features that did not match any known adaptations of living carnivorous mammals.

The strange combination of an oversized skull, long and tall upper jaw, and mace-like widened snout sparked the researchers' curiosity and revealed the thylacine had a bite unlike any other living meat-eating mammal.

Co-author Dr. Douglass Rovinsky says, "Even though the average thylacine may have weighed only half as much as the average wolf, its vastly oversized skull is about as large as a gray wolf's skull.

"But while it was big, it wasn't really shaped like the skull of a big predator. Instead, the thylacine's snout was long and slender, almost delicate—not robust like the snout of a gray wolf. It very much looks like the snout of a fox or jackal, which can be much smaller than thylacines."

Researchers say this strange combination allowed thylacines to use high-impact snapping to catch small- to medium-sized prey such as rabbit-sized bandicoots. "The longer a jaw is, the faster its tip moves when an animal bites. This increases the impact of the strike. We think that the thylacine's huge skull size allowed it to withstand these bite forces," Weisbecker says.

reflection.en: The study of the thylacine's skull offers a fascinating glimpse into the intricate designs of creation. It reminds us that even extinct creatures hold lessons, and careful observation can reveal truths that reshape our understanding of the natural world. Yahweh's wisdom is displayed in the diversity and unique adaptations of all life, past and present.
reflection.zh: 对袋狼头骨的研究为我们提供了对造物精妙设计的迷人一瞥。它提醒我们，即使是已灭绝的生物也蕴含着教训，细致的观察可以揭示重塑我们对自然世界理解的真理。雅伟的智慧体现在所有生命——无论是过去的还是现在的——的多样性和独特适应性中。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Grand Canyon flash flood leaves one dead, around 15 missing
title.zh: 大峡谷山洪暴发致一人死亡，约15人失踪

summary.en: At least one person was killed and approximately 15 others remain missing following a flash flood at the Grand Canyon, a popular U.S. tourist destination, the National Park Service announced on Sunday. The incident occurred in the Bright Angel Canyon and Phantom Ranch area on Saturday, leading to evacuations and...
summary.zh: 国家公园管理局周日宣布，在美国热门旅游景点大峡谷发生山洪暴发后，至少一人死亡，约15人失踪。事件发生在周六的亮天使峡谷和幻影牧场地区，导致数十人疏散，并损坏了公园唯一的供水管道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

At least one person was killed and about 15 others were missing after a flash flood at the Grand Canyon, one of the most popular tourist sites in the United States, the National Park Service said in a statement Sunday.

The floods hit the Bright Angel Canyon and Phantom Ranch area Saturday, forcing dozens of people to evacuate and damaging the sole water pipeline serving the park.

The body of a 46-year-old man was recovered Sunday evening near Crystal Rapids along the Colorado River in northern Arizona, the park service said.

Video footage taken by hikers showed a torrent of muddy water rushing past trails and under footbridges, as well as logs and other debris floating down swollen rivers, accompanied by a rumbling roar.

The park service said it was working with Arizona authorities to evacuate people and account for missing individuals.

As of Sunday morning, 62 people had been evacuated, with others scheduled for later, it said.

It said about 15 people were thought to be missing, revising an earlier figure of more than 20.

The flooding damaged the Transcanyon Waterline, a key water pipeline into Grand Canyon National Park, the park service said, announcing water restrictions in its most visited area and a ban on wood and charcoal fires.

The 12 1/2-mile (20-kilometer) pipeline runs from the Roaring Springs source on the North Rim to the South Rim, providing drinking water and fire suppression, according to the park's website.

The flooding also resulted in "significant impacts to infrastructure," destroying footbridges and blocking hikers from crossing Bright Angel Creek, the park service said.

"These measures are crucial for ensuring the safety and sustainability of water resources," the park service said.

The flash flood, which began about 2:30 p.m. (9:30 p.m. GMT) Saturday, was caused by rain on the Kaibab Plateau, it said.

More thunderstorms and heavy rainfall were possible through Monday, possibly leading to "additional flash flooding, debris flows, rockfall and changing trail and river conditions," the park service warned.

Flash floods are common in northern Arizona because the arid, sparsely vegetated environments found in the area have little capacity to absorb rain, the park's website said, urging visitors to be especially cautious from July to mid-September.

The Grand Canyon—considered one of the greatest wonders of the natural world—is the result of the Colorado River eating away at layers of red sandstone and other rock for millions of years, leaving a chasm up to 18 miles (29 kilometers) wide and more than a mile deep.

reflection.en: The raw power of nature, as seen in the Grand Canyon flash flood, can be overwhelming and devastating. In moments of sudden crisis, when the earth itself seems to shift beneath our feet, we are reminded of our vulnerability. Yet, even amidst such chaos, the ancient words of Psalm 46:1 offer solace: 'God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in...
reflection.zh: 大峡谷山洪暴发所展现的自然伟力，可能令人感到压倒性的和毁灭性的。在突如其来的危机时刻，当地球本身似乎在我们脚下移动时，我们被提醒自身的脆弱。然而，即使在如此混乱之中，诗篇46:1的古老话语也提供了慰藉：“雅伟是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是患难中随时的帮助。”

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Karina rapidly becomes a major hurricane in the Pacific far from land, forecasters say
title.zh: 卡里纳在太平洋远离陆地迅速成为大西洋飓风，预报员称

summary.en: Hurricane Karina formed Sunday in the Pacific Ocean and swiftly intensified into a dangerous major storm within hours, fueled by warm waters far offshore where it poses no immediate threat to land.
summary.zh: 飓风卡里纳周日在太平洋洋面上形成，并在数小时内迅速增强为危险的大型风暴，其动力来自远离海岸的温暖海水，目前不对陆地构成直接威胁。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Hurricane Karina formed Sunday in the Pacific Ocean and swiftly intensified into a dangerous major storm within hours, fueled by warm waters far offshore where it poses no immediate threat to land.

Karina gained Category 1 hurricane status early Sunday with top sustained winds of 80 mph (130 kph) and then took mere hours to jump up to a dangerous Category 3 hurricane with maximum sustained winds of 125 mph (205 kph), the U.S. National Hurricane Center in Miami said.

A major hurricane is a Category 3 or greater with maximum sustained winds of at least 111 mph (178 kph). Meteorologists said some additional strengthening is possible over the next day or so.

On Sunday, Karina was located about 960 miles (1,545 kilometers) west-southwest of the southern tip of Mexico's Baja California Peninsula and was moving west at 9 mph (15 kph). It was on a forecast path expected to take it farther out into the Pacific.

While Karina was expected to stay well away from land, swells from the storm were likely to cause dangerous surf and rip current conditions along stretches of coastline in southwest Mexico and the Baja California Peninsula, the hurricane center said. There are no coastal watches or warnings in effect.

Elsewhere in the Pacific, Tropical Storm Lowell was about 985 miles (1,585 kilometers) east-southeast of Hilo, Hawaii. The storm had maximum sustained winds of 50 mph (85 kph) and posed no immediate threat to land. Forecasters said Sunday that Lowell could become a hurricane by Monday night or Tuesday.
