body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 飓风卡琳娜周日在太平洋形成，并在几小时内迅速增强为一场危险的大风暴，远海温暖的海水助长了飓风卡琳娜，但对陆地没有构成直接威胁。 位于迈阿密的美国国家飓风中心表示，卡琳娜周日早些时候获得了 1 级飓风级别，最高持续风速为 80 英里/小时（130 公里/小时），然后仅用了几个小时就升级为危险的 3 级飓风，最高持续风速为 125 英里/小时（205 公里/小时）。 大型飓风为 3 级或以上，最大持续风速至少为 111 英里/小时（178 公里/小时）。气象学家表示，未来一天左右可能还会有进一步的加强。 周日，卡琳娜位于墨西哥下加利福尼亚半岛南端西南偏西约 960 英里（1,545 公里）处，并以 9 英里/小时（15 公里/小时）的速度向西移动。它按照预测的路线行驶，预计将进一步进入太平洋。 飓风中心表示，虽然卡琳娜预计将远离陆地，但风暴带来的海浪可能会在墨西哥西南部和下加利福尼亚半岛的海岸线沿线造成危险的海浪和撕裂流状况。没有有效的沿海监视或警告。 在太平洋其他地方，热带风暴洛厄尔位于夏威夷希洛东南偏东约 985 英里（1,585 公里）处。风暴的最大持续风速为 50 英里/小时（85 公里/小时），不会对陆地造成直接威胁。预报员周日表示，洛厄尔可能会在周一晚上或周二成为飓风。 物理学硕士，具有研究经验。长期科学新闻爱好者。在 Science X 的编辑成功中发挥着关键作用。完整档案 → © 2026 美联社。版权所有。未经许可，不得出版、广播、重写或重新分发本材料。

reflection.en: The rapid intensification of Hurricane Karina, fueled by the ocean's warmth, is a powerful reminder of the intricate and awe-inspiring systems within creation. Psalm 104:24 speaks of the earth being full of God's creations, each displaying His wisdom. Even in destructive forces, we can glimpse the Creator's hand at work, a testament to His vast and complex...
reflection.zh: 飓风卡里纳在海洋暖流的助推下迅速增强，这有力地提醒我们，造物中有多么精妙而令人敬畏的系统。诗篇104:24说，地满了雅伟的造物，各样都彰显祂的智慧。即使在毁灭性的力量中，我们也能瞥见造物主的作为，这是祂浩瀚而复杂设计的明证。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Can you solve it? The fin-tastic fish puzzle
title.zh: 你能解开它吗？鱼的奇妙谜题

summary.en: This puzzle challenges readers to visualize and draw the top view of a fish's shortest path in a tank, based on its front and side views. It suggests consulting architects for help with 3D visualization and celebrates the opening of a new maths school.
summary.zh: 这个谜题挑战读者根据鱼在鱼缸中游动的正面和侧面视图，绘制出其最短路径的俯视图。它建议读者在三维可视化方面可以向建筑师寻求帮助，并庆祝一所新数学学校的开学。

body.en:
Today’s puzzle concerns a fish swimming in a tank that is two metres high, one metre across and one metre deep.

Today’s two puzzles present front and side views of fish paths. Can you draw the top view of the shortest path that produced these front and side views?

If you find visualising shapes in three-dimensions difficult, ask an architect for help. I have set similar puzzles twice before, in 2015 and in 2017 , and on both occasions architects wrote in to say they are trained to think in this way.

Today’s puzzles were created by maths educator George Watkins to celebrate the opening of the 1729 Maths School , which welcomes its first pupils later this month.

The school – in Mill Hill, north London – is the first specialist maths secondary school to open in the UK. Its name comes from a famous anecdote about a London taxi cab with the licence plate 1729 .

I’ve been setting a puzzle here on alternate Mondays since 2015. I’m always on the look-out for great puzzles. If you would like to suggest one, email me .
body.zh: 今天的难题涉及一条鱼在一个两米高、一米宽、一米深的水箱中游泳。 今天的两个谜题展示了鱼道的正面和侧面视图。你能画出产生这些前视图和侧视图的最短路径的俯视图吗？ 如果您发现在三维空间中可视化形状很困难，请向建筑师寻求帮助。我之前曾在 2015 年和 2017 年两次设置过类似的谜题，两次建筑师都写信说他们接受过以这种方式思考的训练。 今天的谜题是由数学教育家乔治·沃特金斯 (George Watkins) 创建的，旨在庆祝 1729 年数学学校的开学，该学校将于本月晚些时候迎来第一批学生。 这所学校位于伦敦北部的米尔山，是英国第一所开设的专业数学中学。它的名字来源于关于伦敦一辆牌照为1729的出租车的著名轶事。 自 2015 年以来，我一直在每隔一个星期一在这里设置一个谜题。我总是在寻找很棒的谜题。如果您想推荐一个，请给我发电子邮件。

reflection.en: This puzzle invites us to consider how different perspectives reveal different truths. Just as a fish's path can be understood from multiple angles, so too can we gain deeper understanding by observing the intricate designs in creation. The Bible encourages us to learn from the natural world, recognizing the wisdom embedded within it.
reflection.zh: 这个谜题邀请我们思考不同的视角如何揭示不同的真相。正如鱼的游动路径可以从多个角度来理解一样，我们也可以通过观察受造界错综复杂的设计来获得更深的理解。圣经鼓励我们从自然界学习，认识其中蕴含的智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Starwatch: Sagitta’s arrow shape makes it easy to see against a dark sky
title.zh: 星空观测：猎户座的箭形使其在黑暗的天空中易于看见

summary.en: The third-smallest constellation, Sagitta, can be found along one of the imaginary lines of the summer triangle. Despite having only a few faint stars, its distinct arrow-like shape makes it easy to identify in a dark sky.
summary.zh: 猎户座是第三小的星座，位于夏季大三角的虚线之一上。尽管它只有几颗暗淡的星星，但其独特的箭形使其在黑暗的天空中易于辨认。

body.en: The third-smallest constellation can be found partway along one of the imaginary lines of the summer triangle We are on the hunt for another small, northern summer constellation this week: Sagitta, the arrow. Although it consists of just a handful of faint stars, Sagitta’s distinctive shape (it really does look like an arrow) makes it easy to identify against a dark sky. The chart shows the view looking up towards the zenith while facing south from London at 22.30 BST on Monday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 第三小的星座可以在夏季大三角的一条假想线的中间找到。本周我们正在寻找另一个小型的北方夏季星座：箭矢。尽管它只由少数微弱的恒星组成，但射手座独特的形状（它确实看起来像一支箭头）使其在黑暗的天空中很容易被识别。该图表显示了周一英国夏令时间 22.30 从伦敦向南仰望天顶的景象。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As we gaze upwards at the night sky, even faint constellations like Sagitta, the arrow, are visible against the vast darkness. The Psalmist reminds us that the heavens themselves are a testament to the Creator's glory, a silent declaration of His power and artistry. In the simple act of stargazing, we can encounter the wonder of Yahweh's handiwork.
reflection.zh: 当我们仰望夜空时，即使是像猎户座（箭）这样微弱的星座，在浩瀚的黑暗中也清晰可见。诗人提醒我们，诸天本身就是造物主荣耀的见证，是祂大能和艺术的无声宣告。在简单的观星活动中，我们可以遇见雅伟作品的奇妙。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Forbidden planet: was Pluto’s 2006 demotion a big mistake?
title.zh: 被禁止的行星：冥王星在2006年被降级是个大错误吗？

summary.en: Since it was stripped of planetary status, Pluto’s defenders have been fighting the decision – and they’re only getting more passionate. Twenty years ago, Pluto was demoted from major planet to dwarf planet status by the International Astronomical Union (IAU) in August 2006, reducing the solar system from nine planets...
summary.zh: 自被剥夺行星地位以来，冥王星的捍卫者一直在为推翻这一决定而斗争——并且他们的热情与日俱增。二十年前，冥王星在2006年8月被国际天文学联合会（IAU）投票从主要行星降级为矮行星，使太阳系中的行星从九颗减少到八颗。当时许多科学家对这一决定感到不满，而这场辩论至今仍呈两极分化状态。

body.en: Since it was stripped of planetary status, Pluto’s defenders have been fighting the decision – and they’re only getting more passionate Twenty years ago, Pluto got demoted. After a vote by the International Astronomical Union (IAU) in August 2006, Pluto was relegated from major planet to dwarf planet status. Our solar system dropped from nine planets to eight. At the time, many scientists were unhappy with the decision. Two decades on, the debate is, if anything, even more polarised. “The definition of a planet they created, you can’t use it at all,” says Philip Metzger, the director of the Stephen W Hawking Centre for Microgravity Research and Education at the University of Central Florida. “It makes the definition of a planet completely non-useful in science.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 自从冥王星被剥夺行星地位以来，冥王星的捍卫者们一直在反对这一决定——而且他们的热情只会变得更加强烈。二十年前，冥王星被降级了。 2006年8月，国际天文学联合会（IAU）投票后，冥王星从主行星降级为矮行星。我们的太阳系从九颗行星减少到八颗。当时，许多科学家对这一决定感到不满。二十年过去了，这场争论甚至变得更加两极分化。 “他们创造的行星的定义，你根本不能使用它，”中佛罗里达大学斯蒂芬·W·霍金微重力研究和教育中心主任菲利普·梅茨格说。 “这使得行星的定义在科学上完全没有用处。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The debate over Pluto's planetary status highlights how human understanding and classification systems evolve, especially in science. Daniel 12:4 speaks of knowledge increasing in the "time of the end," a period marked by rapid advancements and new discoveries that challenge established ideas. This ongoing discussion about Pluto shows how scientific...
reflection.zh: 关于冥王星行星地位的争论凸显了人类的理解和分类体系是如何不断演变的，尤其是在科学领域。但以理书12:4提到“末期”知识必增长，这是一个以快速进步和新发现为标志的时期，这些进步和发现挑战着既有的观念。这场关于冥王星的持续讨论表明，科学共识可能会发生变化，从而促使人们重新评估和进行更深入的探究。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: The SKA project: A model for dialogue between historical astronomical archives, local memory and modern science
title.zh: SKA项目：历史天文档案、地方记忆与现代科学对话的典范

summary.en: Humans have been observing the sky for thousands of years. Our ancestors were undoubtedly fascinated by it, but observing the heavens also had practical uses: It helped people measure time, both over the course of the day and through the changing seasons, and became especially important with the spread of agriculture....
summary.zh: 人类观察天空已有数千年历史。我们的祖先无疑对天空着迷，但观察天空也有实际用途：它帮助人们测量时间，无论是白天还是季节的变化，随着农业的传播尤其重要。如今被视为科学前沿的宇宙学和天体物理学，实际上只是观察和解释天空不断演变历史的最新篇章。

body.en: Humans have been observing the sky for thousands of years. Our ancestors were undoubtedly fascinated by it, but observing the heavens also had practical uses: It helped people measure time, both over the course of the day and through the changing seasons, and became especially important with the spread of agriculture. What is now seen as scientific frontiers, such as cosmology and astrophysics, are in fact only the latest chapter in an evolving history of observing and interpreting the sky.
body.zh: 数千年来，人类一直在观察天空。我们的祖先无疑对它着迷，但观察天空也有实际用途：它可以帮助人们测量一天中和季节变化的时间，并且随着农业的传播而变得尤为重要。现在被视为科学前沿的东西，例如宇宙学和天体物理学，实际上只是观测和解释天空不断发展的历史的最新篇章。

reflection.en: For millennia, humanity has looked to the stars, finding both wonder and practical wisdom. The SKA project's approach, weaving together ancient observations, local traditions, and cutting-edge science, echoes the ancient understanding that creation itself is a source of profound knowledge. It reminds us that Yahweh's wisdom is revealed not only in scripture...
reflection.zh: 数千年来，人类仰望星空，从中发现了奇迹和实用的智慧。SKA项目将古代观测、当地传统和尖端科学交织在一起，呼应了古老的理解：创造本身就是深刻知识的源泉。它提醒我们，雅伟的智慧不仅在经文中显现，也在宇宙的精妙运作中显现，可以通过耐心观察和谦卑的探究来获得。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Using data to help wheat growers adapt to unpredictable weather
title.zh: 利用数据帮助小麦种植者适应不可预测的天气

summary.en: Wheat planting has traditionally followed predictable seasonal patterns, but unseasonably warm weather followed by freezing temperatures has accelerated growth and pushed crops into vulnerable stages, making planting dates difficult to choose and threatening the survival of farmers operating on tight margins.
summary.zh: 小麦种植传统上遵循可预测的季节模式，但反常的温暖天气随后又遭遇霜冻，加速了小麦的生长，使其进入脆弱的生长阶段，这使得播种日期的选择变得困难，并威胁到利润微薄的农民的生存。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

For generations, wheat planting has followed predictable seasonal patterns. But this year, unseasonably warm weather in March and April accelerated wheat growth, pushing the crop into a vulnerable growth stage when widespread freezing temperatures hit .

As weather becomes less predictable, choosing the right planting date has become more difficult. For wheat growers in Virginia, where tight margins already make every decision count, getting the timing right is a matter of survival.

"Wheat's low market price and high input costs have meant that Virginia's wheat acreage has declined in recent years," said Joseph Oakes, Eastern Virginia Agricultural Research and Extension Center (AREC) superintendent and Extension specialist.

As historical weather data show a shifting climate, tools to determine ideal planting dates are vital for growers to ensure enough warm days for sufficient yield while minimizing the potential for late-spring freezes.

"Research shows that plant development in the fall contributes to almost 90% of grain yield," Oakes said. "Leaving time for that growth is one of the most important things you can do for high wheat yields."

Research led by Oakes and Virginia Cooperative Extension agents Robbie Longest and Turner Minx offers growers a clearer path forward.

Working with farmers in King William, New Kent, Richmond and Westmoreland counties, the team compared four planting dates, from mid-October through November, using drone-based remote sensing to monitor crop growth throughout the season.

The drone-based methods were developed and validated as part of a USDA multistate grant to help farmers optimize fertilizer application in winter wheat and efficiently collect crop and field data. In this project, the team applied these monitoring and management technologies to evaluate planting dates for regional wheat growers.

The research showed how planting date can influence both yield and vulnerability to spring freezes. Planting before Nov. 1 showed no reduction in yield, giving growers confidence to shift planting dates later into October without sacrificing production. That timing gives crops enough warm weather to establish before winter while reducing the chance they will mature too early and be damaged by spring freezes. By contrast, wheat planted in November had less time to develop before winter, resulting in reduced growth and lower yields.

"It's critical to plant early enough to be established before winter, but not so early that advanced crops risk a devastating spring freeze," Oakes said. "Growers are getting squeezed on both sides: Prices are...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 几代人以来，小麦种植都遵循可预测的季节模式。但今年，三月和四月反常的温暖天气加速了小麦的生长，当大范围的冰冻气温袭来时，使作物进入脆弱的生长阶段。 随着天气变得越来越不可预测，选择正确的种植日期变得更加困难。对于弗吉尼亚州的小麦种植者来说，利润微薄已经让每一个决定都变得至关重要，选择正确的时机关系到生存。 “小麦的低市场价格和高投入成本意味着弗吉尼亚州的小麦种植面积近年来有所下降，”东弗吉尼亚州农业研究和推广中心 (AREC) 负责人兼推广专家约瑟夫·奥克斯 (Joseph Oakes) 说。 由于历史天气数据显示气候正在变化，确定理想种植日期的工具对于种植者来说至关重要，以确保足够的温暖日子以获得足够的产量，同时最大限度地减少晚春结冰的可能性。 “研究表明，秋季植物的发育贡献了近 90% 的谷物产量，”奥克斯说。 “为小麦的生长留出时间是为小麦高产所做的最重要的事情之一。” 由奥克斯和弗吉尼亚合作推广代理商 Robbie Longest 和 Turner Minx 领导的研究为种植者提供了一条更清晰的前进道路。 该团队与威廉王县、新肯特县、里士满县和威斯特摩兰县的农民合作，比较了从 10 月中旬到 11 月的四个播种日期，使用基于无人机的遥感技术来监测整个季节的作物生长。 基于无人机的方法是作为美国农业部多州拨款的一部分开发和验证的，旨在帮助农民优化冬小麦的施肥并有效收集作物和田间数据。在该项目中，该团队应用这些监测和管理技术来评估区域小麦种植者的种植日期。 该研究表明播种日期如何影响产量和春季冰冻的脆弱性。 11 月 1 日之前的播种没有显示产量下降，这让种植者有信心将播种日期推迟到 10 月，而不会影响产量。这个时间为农作物提供了足够温暖的天气，让它们在冬季之前成熟，同时减少了它们过早成熟和因春季冰冻而受损的机会。相比之下，11 月份种植的小麦在冬季之前发育的时间较短，导致生长速度减慢和产量降低。 奥克斯说：“关键是要尽早播种，以便在冬季之前成熟，但也不能太早，以免晚期作物面临春季毁灭性的冰冻风险。” “种植者正受到双方的挤压：价格......

reflection.en: The unpredictable weather patterns described in this report directly impact the livelihoods of wheat farmers, pushing them into precarious economic situations. Habakkuk's words remind us that even when crops fail and abundance disappears, our hope can remain anchored in Yahweh, the source of strength and sustenance. Even in times of scarcity and hardship,...
reflection.zh: 本报道中描述的不可预测的天气模式直接影响了小麦农民的生计，使他们陷入经济困境。哈巴谷的话提醒我们，即使在庄稼歉收、丰衣足食的日子消失时，我们的希望仍可寄托在雅伟身上，祂是力量和供应的源泉。 即使在匮乏和艰难的时期，我们也蒙召信靠主。愿我们不仅在数据和计划中找到韧性和希望，也在我们创造主的持久信实中找到希望。

This proposal to explore evolutionary pressures on atoms invites us to see the deep order Yahweh has woven into the fabric of reality. May this scientific inquiry deepen our awe for the Creator's boundless ingenuity.

title.en: 'A giant leap forward': Nasa launches powerful new space telescope
title.zh: “巨大飞跃”：美国宇航局发射强大的新型太空望远镜

summary.en: NASA has launched the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, a next-generation observatory designed to map the universe and investigate the mysteries of dark energy and dark matter. With a field of view 100 times larger than its predecessors, the mission will also search for exoplanets from its vantage point one million...
summary.zh: 美国宇航局（NASA）发射了南希·格雷斯·罗曼太空望远镜，这是一台旨在绘制宇宙地图并研究暗能量和暗物质奥秘的新一代天文台。该望远镜的视野比其前身大100倍，其任务还包括在距离地球100万英里的观测点搜寻系外行星。

body.en:
Nasa's powerful next-generation telescope has blasted off into space from its launchpad in Florida, with a mission to explore dark energy, black holes and other mysteries of the Universe.

The Nancy Grace Roman telescope will capture vast panoramic views of space, with a field of vision 100 times larger than both the Hubble and James Webb space telescopes, Nasa says.

The mission begins with a 100-day journey to a vantage point roughly one million miles from Earth, where the telescope will then start charting planets outside our solar system, known as exoplanets.

"Roman is going to change the way we look at the Universe," said Nicky Fox, a Nasa administrator.

The successful launch of the telescope took place on Sunday morning local time from the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

Jackie Townsend, a project manager on Nasa's Roman telescope, described it as "glorious" at a news conference afterwards. "The ride was magnificent. It put us right where we wanted to be."

About 30 minutes after launch, Roman separated from its SpaceX rocket and is now heading towards its orbiting point around a million miles away.

Fox said Roman "is going to discover tens of thousands, maybe even 100,000 new exoplanets" - referring to planets located outside of our solar system.

"Why do we care so much about exoplanets? Because one of our main goals at Nasa is answering the question, 'Are we alone in the universe'?" she added.

US President Donald Trump dialled in to the space agency's news conference to congratulate the scientists working on the project.

"You're the hottest in space, and we have the hottest country anywhere in the world. So, let's keep it all going. You're a big part of it," Trump said.

Astronomer Jenifer Millard said the telescope will be four times further from Earth than the Moon is, where a lot of infrared space cameras - made to pick up what she describes as "heat light"- operate.

She told the BBC this is to make sure infrared light from the Moon and Earth don't interfere with the cameras.

Nasa's James Webb Space Telescope, launched in 2021, also orbits the Sun around one million miles from Earth, but its field of vision is not as expansive. Nasa's Hubble Space Telescope, launched in 1990, orbits at about 300 miles above Earth's surface.

While Roman will look outward into the Universe, Millard said scientists are also anticipating it will find thousands of new worlds in our own galaxy.

The telescope is named after physicist Nancy Grace Roman, who was Nasa's first chief astronomer in the 1960s and its first female executive.

During her career, she was instrumental in getting the Hubble Space Telescope approved by US Congress and later said its most interesting discovery was dark energy.

The new telescope is similarly expected to...
body.zh: 美国宇航局强大的下一代望远镜已从佛罗里达州的发射台发射升空，其任务是探索暗能量、黑洞和宇宙的其他奥秘。 美国宇航局表示，南希·格雷斯·罗曼望远镜将捕捉广阔的太空全景，其视野比哈勃和詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜大100倍。 该任务从为期 100 天的旅程开始，到达距地球约 100 万英里的有利位置，然后望远镜将开始绘制太阳系外行星（称为系外行星）的图表。 “罗曼将改变我们看待宇宙的方式，”美国宇航局管理员尼基福克斯说。 该望远镜于当地时间周日上午在佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心成功发射。 美国宇航局罗马望远镜的项目经理杰基·汤森德在随后的新闻发布会上形容这是“光荣的”。 “这次旅程非常棒。它让我们到达了我们想去的地方。” 发射后约 30 分钟，Roman 与 SpaceX 火箭分离，目前正朝着约 100 万英里外的轨道点前进。 福克斯表示，罗曼“将发现数万颗，甚至可能是 10 万颗新的系外行星”——指的是位于太阳系之外的行星。 “为什么我们如此关心系外行星？因为美国宇航局的主要目标之一就是回答这个问题：‘我们在宇宙中孤独吗？’”她补充道。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普拨通了航天局的新闻发布会，向从事该项目的科学家表示祝贺。 “你们是太空中最热门的国家，我们拥有世界上最热门的国家。所以，让我们继续努力。你们是其中的重要组成部分，”特朗普说。 天文学家詹妮弗·米勒德表示，这架望远镜距离地球的距离将是月球距离的四倍，月球上有许多红外太空相机，用于捕捉她所说的“热光”。 她告诉英国广播公司，这是为了确保来自月球和地球的红外光不会干扰相机。 美国宇航局 (NASA) 的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜于 2021 年发射，也绕太阳运行，距地球约 100 万英里，但其视野没有那么广阔。美国宇航局的哈勃太空望远镜于 1990 年发射，其轨道距地球表面约 300 英里。 米勒德表示，虽然罗曼将向外观察宇宙，但科学家们也预计它将在我们自己的星系中发现数千个新世界。 该望远镜以物理学家南希·格雷斯·罗曼 (Nancy Grace Roman) 的名字命名，她是 20 世纪 60 年代美国宇航局第一位首席天文学家，也是第一位女性高管。 在她的职业生涯中，她在哈勃太空望远镜获得美国国会批准方面发挥了重要作用，后来表示其最有趣的发现是暗能量。 新望远镜同样有望...

reflection.en: The launch of the Roman telescope reminds us that our curiosity is a response to a universe that seems designed to be discovered. As we peer into the mysteries of space with a field of vision 100 times wider than before, we find that the vastness does not diminish human significance but rather highlights the majesty of Yahweh. Each new map of the stars is a...
reflection.zh: 罗曼望远镜的发射提醒我们，人类的好奇心是对这个似乎注定要被发现的宇宙的一种回应。当我们以比以往宽100倍的视野窥探太空的奥秘时，我们发现这种浩瀚并没有削弱人类的意义，反而彰显了雅伟的雄伟。每一份新的星图都是宇宙故事中崭新的一页，不断宣告着远超我们自身的荣耀。

title.en: 1.4-million-year-old footprints reveal a surprisingly large human relative
title.zh: 140万年前的足迹揭示了一个令人惊讶的大型人类近亲

summary.en: Ancient footprints discovered in Kenya suggest that eight individuals of Paranthropus boisei may have traveled together approximately 1.4 million years ago. Some of these individuals were surprisingly large, approaching human-like body sizes, offering rare insights into their social behavior and suggesting these...
summary.zh: 在肯尼亚发现的古代足迹表明，大约在140万年前，八名鲍氏傍人可能曾一同出行。其中一些个体体型异常高大，接近人类体型，这为了解它们的社会行为提供了罕见的线索，并表明这些已灭绝的人类近亲比之前认为的更为复杂。

body.en:
A remarkable set of fossil footprints from northern Kenya is offering scientists a rare glimpse of how an extinct human relative may have moved and interacted about 1.4 million years ago.

The tracks, preserved near an ancient lakeshore, appear to record eight Paranthropus boisei individuals occupying the same place at roughly the same time. Researchers describe the discovery as a snapshot of "fossil behavior" because, unlike bones that can accumulate over long periods, footprints can capture a brief moment in the lives of individuals.

The international team, made up of researchers from the US and Kenya, concluded that all eight trackmakers were likely adults. Several also appear to have been considerably larger than earlier estimates of Paranthropus boisei body size based on the limited skeletal remains available.

The researchers used analytical techniques first developed by their team in 2024 to identify the footprints as belonging to Paranthropus boisei . The classification was based on clues in foot anatomy as well as the way the individuals appear to have moved.

"The sizes of the footprints indicate human-like body sizes - up to 1.8 meters tall and around 75 kilograms," says lead author Kevin Hatala, of Chatham University and an associated researcher of the Department of Human Origins at the Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology in Leipzig.

For decades, most known fossils of Paranthropus boisei consisted of skulls, including specimens with exceptionally large jaws and teeth. Much less has been known about what the species looked like below the neck because fossils from the rest of the skeleton are far rarer.

The new tracks now challenge earlier research suggesting that Paranthropus boisei was substantially smaller than Homo erectus , another hominin that lived during the same general period and is considered a possible direct ancestor of modern humans.

Footprints can reveal more than anatomy. Because a walking surface may be formed and preserved over a very short span of time, fossil tracks can provide direct evidence about movement, group size, and possible social interactions.

In this case, the eight individuals appear to have been traveling together. Most were likely adult males, with no obvious evidence of females or children among them.

"The fact that eight, mostly adult male, Paranthropus boisei individuals seemingly traveled together as a group, without females or children, hints at a complex social structure in this species," says co-author Neil Roach of Harvard University. "They may have lived in large groups, where males competed for mates, but also tolerated each other at times for safety in a dangerous environment."

That possibility adds a new dimension to what scientists know about Paranthropus boisei . The...
body.zh: 肯尼亚北部发现的一组引人注目的化石足迹让科学家们得以难得一睹已灭绝的人类亲戚在大约 140 万年前是如何移动和互动的。 这些足迹保存在一个古老的湖岸附近，似乎记录了八个博氏傍人个体在大约同一时间占据同一地点。研究人员将这一发现描述为“化石行为”的快照，因为与可以长期积累的骨头不同，脚印可以捕捉个人生活中的短暂时刻。 由来自美国和肯尼亚的研究人员组成的国际小组得出的结论是，所有八名田径运动员都可能是成年人。其中一些似乎比先前根据有限的骨骼遗骸估计的博伊西拟人的体型要大得多。 研究人员使用他们的团队于 2024 年首次开发的分析技术来识别这些脚印是否属于博伊人傍人 (Paranthropus boisei)。该分类是基于足部解剖学的线索以及个体的移动方式。 查塔姆大学的主要作者、莱比锡马克斯·普朗克进化人类学研究所人类起源系的研究员凯文·哈塔拉（Kevin Hatala）说：“脚印的大小表明了类似人类的身体尺寸——高1.8米，重约75公斤。” 几十年来，大多数已知的博氏拟人化石都是由头骨组成，其中包括具有异常大的下巴和牙齿的标本。人们对这个物种脖子以下的样子知之甚少，因为骨骼其余部分的化石要少得多。 这些新足迹现在挑战了早期的研究，即博伊人傍人比直立人小得多，直立人是生活在同一时期的另一种古人类，被认为可能是现代人类的直接祖先。 足迹不仅仅能揭示解剖结构。由于行走表面可能在很短的时间内形成并保存，因此化石足迹可以提供有关运动、群体规模和可能的社会互动的直接证据。 在这种情况下，这八个人似乎是一起旅行的。大多数可能是成年男性，没有明显证据表明其中有女性或儿童。 哈佛大学的合著者尼尔·罗奇（Neil Roach）表示：“八个博氏傍人（其中大多数是成年雄性）似乎作为一个群体一起旅行，没有雌性或儿童，这一事实暗示了该物种复杂的社会结构。” “它们可能生活在大群体中，雄性争夺配偶，但有时也会在危险的环境中为了安全而互相容忍。” 这种可能性为科学家们对博氏傍人的了解增加了一个新的维度。这...

reflection.en: The fossilized footprints in Kenya, dating back 1.4 million years, offer a tangible connection to our distant ancestors. They remind us that even in the deep past, our human relatives exhibited complex social behaviors and physical diversity. Observing the natural world, from ancient tracks to modern ecosystems, can reveal profound truths about life and our...
reflection.zh: 肯尼亚发现的140万年前的化石足迹，为我们提供了与遥远祖先的切实联系。它们提醒我们，即使在遥远的过去，我们的人类近亲也表现出复杂的社会行为和身体多样性。观察自然世界，从古代足迹到现代生态系统，都能揭示关于生命以及我们在其中位置的深刻真理。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.

title.en: This strange “spacetime crystal” can suddenly become a black hole
title.zh: 这种奇怪的“时空晶体”会突然变成黑洞

summary.en: Physicists have mathematically described a peculiar "spacetime crystal" that can either dissolve or collapse into a microscopic black hole with a minor energy change. This breakthrough, achieved through an unusual method involving infinite dimensions, could offer new insights into physics.
summary.zh: 物理学家在数学上描述了一种奇特的“时空晶体”，它只需微小的能量变化就会溶解或坍缩成一个微型黑洞。这一突破是通过一种涉及无限维度的不寻常方法实现的，可能为物理学提供新的见解。

body.en:
Physics allows for black holes far smaller than the enormous objects typically found at the centers of galaxies or created when massive stars collapse. Under the right conditions, microscopic black holes could also form when spacetime enters an unusual critical state and organizes into a repeating, crystal-like pattern.

Researchers from Goethe University Frankfurt and TU Wien have now found a way to describe this process mathematically. For the first time, they derived an exact formula for the phenomenon by using an unconventional mathematical approach.

Most familiar black holes are associated with violent cosmic events, including the deaths of massive stars. In theory, however, there is no strict lower size limit. Extremely small black holes could arise from special critical states in which even a tiny addition of energy can determine whether the system disperses or collapses.

Conditions like these may have existed in the early universe, shortly after the Big Bang, when matter and energy were packed into an intensely chaotic environment. Such circumstances could potentially have produced primordial black holes.

Computer simulations had already shown that these unusual critical structures should be possible. The challenge was finding a mathematical description that could reproduce what the simulations revealed. Researchers at Goethe University Frankfurt and TU Wien have now done that with a formula that can be worked out analytically, using what the scientists describe as essentially paper and pencil.

"Sometimes a tiny, seemingly insignificant cause is enough to trigger a huge and dramatic change," says Prof. Daniel Grumiller from TU Wien. "Take liquid water at zero degrees Celsius, for example. A very small change is enough to make the water freeze. The water molecules then spontaneously arrange themselves into a regular pattern and form an ice crystal."

Einstein's theory of relativity suggests that spacetime can undergo something conceptually similar. Matter influences the geometry of spacetime, and changes in the distribution of particles can therefore alter its curvature.

"We say that spacetime is curved by mass," explains Christian Ecker from the Institute for Theoretical Physics at Goethe University Frankfurt. "Large objects such as stars curve spacetime strongly -- for example, we can observe this when light rays are deflected by massive stars. But smaller masses also produce spacetime curvature, just to a lesser extent."

Under critical conditions, that curvature can arrange itself into a repeating pattern across space and time. The researchers describe the resulting structure as a kind of "spacetime crystal." The process that produces this finely balanced state is known as critical collapse.

body.zh: 物理学允许黑洞比通常在星系中心发现的或大质量恒星坍缩时产生的巨大物体小得多。在适当的条件下，当时空进入不寻常的临界状态并组织成重复的晶体状图案时，微观黑洞也可能形成。 法兰克福歌德大学和维也纳工业大学的研究人员现在找到了一种用数学方法描述这一过程的方法。他们第一次使用非常规的数学方法推导出该现象的精确公式。 大多数熟悉的黑洞都与剧烈的宇宙事件有关，包括大质量恒星的死亡。然而，理论上，没有严格的尺寸下限。极小的黑洞可能产生于特殊的临界状态，在这种状态下，即使添加少量的能量也可以决定系统是分散还是崩溃。 像这样的条件可能存在于早期宇宙中，即大爆炸后不久，当时物质和能量被挤入一个极其混乱的环境中。这种情况可能会产生原始黑洞。 计算机模拟已经表明这些不寻常的关键结构应该是可能的。挑战在于找到一种可以重现模拟结果的数学描述。法兰克福歌德大学和维也纳工业大学的研究人员现在已经通过一个可以分析计算出的公式做到了这一点，使用科学家所说的本质上是纸和铅笔。 “有时，一个看似微不足道的微小原因足以引发巨大而戏剧性的变化，”维也纳工业大学的丹尼尔·格鲁米勒教授说。 “以零摄氏度的液态水为例。一个非常小的变化就足以使水结冰。然后水分子会自发地排列成规则的图案并形成冰晶。” 爱因斯坦的相对论表明，时空可以经历概念上类似的事情。物质影响时空的几何形状，因此粒子分布的变化可以改变时空的曲率。 “我们说时空是由质量弯曲的，”法兰克福歌德大学理论物理研究所的克里斯蒂安·埃克解释道。 “像恒星这样的大物体会强烈地弯曲时空——例如，当光线被大质量恒星偏转时我们可以观察到这一点。但较小的质量也会产生时空弯曲，只是程度较小。” 在临界条件下，这种曲率可以在空间和时间上排列成重复的模式。研究人员将由此产生的结构描述为一种“时空晶体”。产生这种精细平衡状态的过程称为临界崩溃。 “这颗时空晶体，是一个非常……

reflection.en: The universe continues to reveal its intricate workings, inviting us to explore its depths with curiosity and awe. As scientists delve into the mathematical structures of spacetime, they echo the ancient wisdom that creation itself holds profound lessons for those who observe it closely. May we approach such discoveries with humility, recognizing the...
reflection.zh: 宇宙不断揭示其错综复杂的运作方式，邀请我们以好奇和敬畏之心去探索其深邃之处。当科学家们深入研究时空的数学结构时，他们呼应了古老的智慧：创造本身为那些仔细观察它的人们提供了深刻的教训。愿我们以谦卑的态度对待这些发现，认识到我们尚未理解的浩瀚之处。

title.en: HEPA air purifiers may boost brain function after just one month
title.zh: HEPA空气净化器可能在一个月内提升大脑功能

summary.en: Adults aged 40 and older performed about 12% faster on a test of executive function after using a HEPA air purifier at home for one month. The findings suggest that cleaner indoor air could offer a simple way to help protect the brain from the effects of traffic-related...
summary.zh: 40岁及以上的成年人在家中使用了HEPA空气净化器一个月后，其执行功能测试表现快了约12%。研究结果表明，更清洁的室内空气可能提供一种简单的方法，帮助保护大脑免受交通相关影响。

body.en:
Using an in-home HEPA purifier for one month spurs a small but significant improvement in brain function in adults age 40 and older. That’s the result of a new study we co-authored in the journal Scientific Reports .

HEPA purifiers – HEPA stands for high efficiency particulate air – remove particulate matter from the air . Exposure to particulate matter has been connected to respiratory and cardiovascular illnesses as well as neurological diseases such as Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s . Environmental health researchers increasingly recommend that people use HEPA air purifiers in their homes to lower their exposure to particulate matter , but few studies have examined whether using them boosts mental function.

We analyzed data from a study of 119 people ages 30 to 74 living in Somerville, Massachusetts. Somerville sits along Interstate 93 and Route 28, two major highways, resulting in relatively high levels of traffic-related air pollution . This makes it an especially good location for testing the health effects of air purifiers.

We randomly assigned participants to one of two groups. One used a HEPA air purifier for one month and then a sham air purifier – which looked and acted like the real thing but did not contain the air-cleaning filter – for one month, with a monthlong break in between. The second group used the real and sham purifiers in reverse order.

After each month, participants took a test that measured different aspects of their mental capacity . The test probed people’s visual memory and motor speed skills by measuring how quickly they could draw lines between sequential numbers, and it tested executive function and mental flexibility by asking them to draw lines between alternating sequential numbers and letters.

We found that participants 40 years and older – about 42% of our sample – on average completed the section testing for mental flexibility and executive function 12% faster after using the HEPA purifier than after using the sham purifier. That was true even when we accounted for factors like differences in the amount of time participants spent indoors, with either filter, as well as how stressful they found the test.

This improvement may seem small, but it is similar to the cognitive benefits that people experience from increasing their daily exercise . While you may not experience a sudden increase in clarity from a 12% boost, preventing cognitive decline is vital for long-term well-being. Even small decreases in cognitive functioning may be associated with a higher risk of death .

Air pollution can negatively affect mental function after just a few hours of exposure . Studies show that air purifiers are effective at reducing particulates , but it’s...
body.zh: 使用家用 HEPA 净化器一个月可以使 40 岁及以上成年人的大脑功能得到小幅但显着的改善。这是我们在《科学报告》杂志上共同撰写的一项新研究的结果。 HEPA 净化器 – HEPA 代表高效颗粒空气 – 去除空气中的颗粒物质。接触颗粒物与呼吸系统和心血管疾病以及阿尔茨海默氏症和帕金森氏症等神经系统疾病有关。环境健康研究人员越来越多地建议人们在家中使用 HEPA 空气净化器来减少接触颗粒物的机会，但很少有研究探讨使用它们是否可以增强心理功能。 我们分析了一项针对居住在马萨诸塞州萨默维尔的 119 名年龄在 30 岁至 74 岁之间的人的研究数据。萨默维尔位于 93 号州际公路和 28 号公路这两条主要高速公路沿线，导致与交通相关的空气污染水平相对较高。这使得它成为测试空气净化器对健康影响的特别好的场所。 我们将参与者随机分配到两组中的一组。其中一个人使用了 HEPA 空气净化器一个月，然后又使用了假空气净化器（外观和功能都与真品一样，但没有空气净化过滤器）一个月，中间休息了一个月。第二组以相反的顺序使用真实和假净化器。 每个月后，参与者都会进行一项测试，测量他们心理能力的不同方面。该测试通过测量人们在连续数字之间画线的速度来探究人们的视觉记忆和运动速度技能，并通过要求他们在交替的连续数字和字母之间画线来测试执行功能和心理灵活性。 我们发现，40 岁及以上的参与者（约占样本的 42%）在使用 HEPA 净化器后完成心理灵活性和执行功能部分测试的速度比使用假净化器后平均快 12%。即使我们考虑了参与者在室内使用任一过滤器的时间差异以及他们在测试中感受到的压力等因素，情况也是如此。 这种改善可能看起来很小，但它类似于人们通过增加日常锻炼而体验到的认知益处。虽然您可能不会体验到 12% 的清晰度突然提高，但防止认知能力下降对于长期健康至关重要。即使认知功能的小幅下降也可能与更高的死亡风险相关。 接触空气污染几个小时后就会对精神功能产生负面影响。研究表明空气净化器可以有效减少颗粒物，但它......

reflection.en: This scientific discovery, showing how HEPA air purifiers can boost brain function in adults aged 40 and older, reminds us of the profound value in uncovering hidden truths. There is a quiet glory in the patient research that reveals simple ways to improve human well-being, like performing 12% faster on executive function tests. Yahweh delights when we seek...
reflection.zh: 这项科学发现揭示了HEPA空气净化器如何在一个月内提升40岁及以上成年人的大脑功能，它提醒我们揭示隐藏真理的深远价值。耐心研究所带来的荣耀是无声的，它揭示了改善人类福祉的简单方法，例如在执行功能测试中表现快了12%。雅伟喜悦我们寻求带来实际益处并保护我们宝贵心智的知识。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Hundreds of hidden earthquakes found at Antarctica’s Doomsday Glacier
title.zh: 南极“末日冰川”下发现数百次隐秘地震

summary.en: Hundreds of previously overlooked seismic events have been detected beneath Antarctica, including 245 near the marine edge of the Thwaites Glacier. Many appear to be glacial earthquakes caused when huge icebergs break off, capsize, and collide with the glacier. The surge in activity coincided with a period when...
summary.zh: 在南极洲发现数百次此前被忽视的地震活动，其中245次发生在思韦茨冰川的海洋边缘。许多似乎是冰川地震，由巨大的冰山断裂、倾覆并撞击冰川引起。活动激增恰逢思韦茨冰川流向海洋的速度加快，这暗示着海洋条件的变化可能正在破坏冰川的稳定。

body.en: Hundreds of previously overlooked seismic events have been detected beneath Antarctica, including 245 near the marine edge of the Thwaites Glacier. Many appear to be glacial earthquakes caused when huge icebergs break off, capsize, and collide with the glacier. The surge in activity coincided with a period when Thwaites was flowing faster toward the ocean, hinting that changing ocean conditions may be destabilizing the ice.
body.zh: 在南极洲下方检测到了数百起以前被忽视的地震事件，其中 245 起位于思韦茨冰川海洋边缘附近。许多地震似乎是巨大冰山断裂、倾覆并与冰川碰撞时引发的冰川地震。活动的激增恰逢思韦茨向海洋加速流动的时期，这暗示海洋条件的变化可能会破坏冰的稳定。

reflection.en: The groaning of creation is not just a metaphor for ecological distress, but a reality felt in the deep places of our world. The seismic activity beneath Thwaites Glacier, a sign of instability, echoes the biblical description of a world in travail. As we observe these changes, we are reminded of our interconnectedness with the natural world and the...
reflection.zh: 受造界的叹息不仅是对生态困境的隐喻，也是我们世界深处真实的感受。思韦茨冰川下方的地震活动，是其不稳定的迹象，呼应了圣经中关于世界在生产之苦的描述。当我们观察到这些变化时，我们被提醒我们与自然世界的相互联系，以及不断变化的环境所带来的深远影响。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Scientists discover a massive heat anomaly deep inside Mars
title.zh: 科学家发现火星深处存在巨大的热异常

summary.en: Scientists have uncovered a significant temperature imbalance deep within Mars, with its southern interior estimated to be 200 to 400 degrees Celsius warmer than the north and possibly partially molten. This finding could illuminate long-standing Martian mysteries and shed light on past environments potentially...
summary.zh: 科学家们发现火星内部存在显著的温度不平衡，其南部内陆估计比北部高出 200 至 400 摄氏度，并且可能部分熔化。这一发现可能有助于阐明火星长期存在的谜团，并揭示过去可能支持生命的潜在环境。

body.en:
Researchers have uncovered a major temperature imbalance deep inside Mars, with the planet's southern interior appearing significantly hotter than its northern half.

Gravity measurements suggest that the interior beneath Mars's southern hemisphere is about 200 to 400 degrees Celsius warmer than the north and may be partially molten. The finding offers a new window into the Red Planet's geologic history, including periods when Mars may have had environments capable of supporting life.

The study was led by Caltech alumnus Alexander Berne (PhD '26), now a postdoctoral associate at the University of Arizona. The results were published August 27 in Nature .

While completing his graduate work at Caltech, Berne developed a model that uses subtle variations in gravity to estimate the internal structure of a planetary body. He and his colleagues later applied that approach to Mars.

The researchers analyzed decades of observations from three Mars missions: Mars Global Surveyor, Mars Odyssey, and Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter. By tracking extremely small changes in the spacecrafts' velocities, the team was able to reconstruct the gravitational field surrounding Mars.

The Sun's gravitational pull on Mars changes over the course of the planet's seasons because Mars travels along a slightly elliptical orbit and rotates on a tilted axis. The researchers used a method known as tidal tomography to study how these gravitational signatures change over time and to build a model of the planet's interior.

"Scientists usually assume that the interiors of planetary bodies are generally spherically symmetric, but this is not necessarily true," Berne says. "As we get more gravity data, we can determine the three-dimensional intricacies of a planet's interior structure. These inferences in turn give us a blueprint for designing future missions and scientific exploration of these worlds. Understanding the interior structure of planetary bodies helps us unravel the processes that shaped their formation and evolution."

Mars has long been known to look very different across its two hemispheres. The southern surface is dominated by tall mountains and heavily cratered terrain, while the northern hemisphere consists largely of broad, low-lying plains.

The new results show that this contrast may extend far below the surface. Researchers were surprised to find that Mars is also thermally uneven inside, with the southern interior hundreds of degrees hotter than the north.

Scientists have detected unusual magnetic signatures in iron-rich minerals in the southern hemisphere. A hotter southern mantle could indicate that Mars once had a magnetic field strong enough to produce differences in magnetism between the two hemispheres.

NASA's InSight mission also previously found that...
body.zh: 研究人员发现火星深处存在严重的温度失衡，火星的南半部内部似乎比北半部要热得多。 重力测量表明，火星南半球下方的内部温度比北半球高约 200 至 400 摄氏度，并且可能部分熔化。这一发现为了解这颗红色星球的地质历史提供了一个新的窗口，包括火星可能拥有能够支持生命的环境的时期。 这项研究由加州理工学院校友 Alexander Berne（26 届博士）领导，他现在是亚利桑那大学的博士后助理。研究结果发表在8月27日的《自然》杂志上。 在加州理工学院完成研究生工作时，伯尔尼开发了一个模型，利用重力的微妙变化来估计行星体的内部结构。他和他的同事后来将这种方法应用于火星。 研究人员分析了三个火星任务数十年的观测结果：火星全球勘测者号、火星奥德赛号和火星勘测轨道器。通过跟踪航天器速度的极小变化，该团队能够重建火星周围的引力场。 太阳对火星的引力随着地球季节的变化而变化，因为火星沿着略呈椭圆形的轨道运行并在倾斜的轴上旋转。研究人员使用一种称为潮汐断层扫描的方法来研究这些引力特征如何随时间变化，并建立行星内部的模型。 “科学家通常认为行星体的内部通常是球对称的，但这不一定是真的，”伯尔尼说。 “随着我们获得更多的重力数据，我们可以确定行星内部结构的三维复杂性。这些推论反过来为我们设计未来任务和对这些世界进行科学探索提供了蓝图。了解行星体的内部结构有助于我们揭示塑造其形成和演化的过程。” 人们早就知道火星的两个半球看起来非常不同。南半球主要是高山和坑坑洼洼的地形，而北半球主要由广阔的低洼平原组成。 新的结果表明，这种对比可能会延伸到表面以下很远的地方。研究人员惊讶地发现，火星内部的温度也不均匀，南部内部比北部高数百度。 科学家在南半球富含铁的矿物中发现了不寻常的磁性特征。更热的南地幔可能表明火星曾经有一个足够强大的磁场，足以在两个半球之间产生磁性差异。 美国宇航局的洞察号任务此前还发现……

reflection.en: The vastness of creation continues to reveal its intricate wonders, even on distant planets like Mars. This discovery of a hidden heat anomaly reminds us that the universe holds depths of mystery, inviting us to observe and learn with humility. As we probe the secrets of other worlds, we are reminded of the profound wisdom embedded within the natural order,...
reflection.zh: 造物的浩瀚继续揭示其错综复杂的奇迹，即使是在火星这样的遥远行星上。这一隐藏热异常的发现提醒我们，宇宙蕴藏着深邃的奥秘，邀请我们以谦卑的心去观察和学习。当我们探索其他世界的秘密时，我们被提醒自然秩序中蕴含着深刻的智慧，这是造物主精妙设计的明证。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Nasa space telescope launches after surviving Trump budget cuts
title.zh: 美国宇航局太空望远镜在特朗普削减预算后有望发射

summary.en: The Nancy Grace Roman space telescope, a $4.3 billion project searching for exoplanets and clues about planet formation, is scheduled to launch Sunday morning from Florida. It survived multiple proposed White House budget cuts and will embark on a million-mile journey into deep space from the Kennedy Space Center,...
summary.zh: 价值43亿美元的南希·格蕾丝·罗马人太空望远镜将于周日早晨从佛罗里达州发射升空，该望远镜旨在寻找系外行星并探索行星形成的线索。它曾两次躲过白宫的预算削减提议，并将从肯尼迪航天中心启程，开始一段长达一百万英里的深空之旅，但发射日期仍可能受限于技术问题或佛罗里达州夏季多变的天气。

body.en: Searching for exoplanets and clues on planet formation, the Roman telescope begins million-mile journey from Florida launchpad A $4.3bn space telescope that Donald Trump tried to kill has lifted off from Florida as Nasa embarks on the next stage of its quest to unlock the secrets of the universe. The Nancy Grace Roman space telescope survived two rounds of proposed White House budget cuts, and began a million-mile journey into deep space from a launchpad at the Kennedy Space Center on Sunday morning. . Continue reading...
body.zh: 为了寻找系外行星和行星形成的线索，罗马望远镜将于周日早上在佛罗里达州升空。唐纳德·特朗普试图摧毁的这台价值 43 亿美元的太空望远镜将于周日早些时候从佛罗里达州升空，美国宇航局将开始下一阶段的探索，以解开宇宙的秘密。南希·格蕾丝·罗曼太空望远镜在白宫提出的两轮预算削减中幸存下来，并将于美国东部时间上午 7 点 26 分从肯尼迪航天中心的发射台开始一百万英里的深空之旅，除非出现后期技术问题或受到佛罗里达州臭名昭著的反复无常的夏季天气的干扰。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The launch of the Nancy Grace Roman space telescope represents humanity's enduring curiosity about the cosmos. As this powerful instrument begins its journey, it serves as a reminder that the vastness of space and the intricate workings of planet formation are a testament to a Creator's design. The heavens indeed declare the glory of Yahweh, inviting us to...
reflection.zh: 南希·格蕾丝·罗马人太空望远镜的发射，代表了人类对宇宙永恒的好奇心。当这个强大的仪器开始它的旅程时，它提醒我们，宇宙的浩瀚和行星形成的复杂运作，都是造物主设计的证明。诸天确实述说着雅伟的荣耀，邀请我们惊叹于祂所创造的宇宙，并怀有敬畏之心。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Charity thanks inmates for work to save hedgehogs
title.zh: 慈善机构感谢囚犯拯救刺猬的工作

summary.en: Prisoners at HMP La Moye are constructing feeding and nesting boxes for the Jersey Hedgehog Preservation Group using reclaimed timber. This initiative is praised for teaching inmates valuable carpentry skills, potentially reducing reoffending rates by equipping them for future employment and fostering a sense of...
summary.zh: 位于拉莫耶监狱（HMP La Moye）的囚犯正在利用回收的木材为泽西刺猬保护协会制作喂食箱和筑巢箱。这项倡议因教授囚犯宝贵的木工技能而受到赞扬，有可能通过为他们未来的就业做准备并培养社区贡献感来降低再犯率。

body.en:
An animal charity has thanked prison inmates for helping to save hedgehogs' lives.

Prisoners in HMP La Moye, in St Brelade, have given Jersey Hedgehog Preservation Group 20 feeding and nesting boxes which they have made out of reclaimed pallet timber.

Peter Gould, the prison's vocational manager, said the work could help reduce reoffending because it taught inmates skills to support future employment and helped them feel they were contributing to the community.

Dru Burdon, from the hedgehog group, said: "If it helps with carpentry skills training, so much the better, these boxes are certainly saving hedgehogs' lives."

Gould said the project also taught health and safety best practice and gave prisoners experience of using machinery and equipment.

"For some, the project provides a valuable introduction to skills that could lead to recognised qualifications and careers in the construction industry."

He said the project helped inmates have a "sense of purpose, achievement and connection to the community" which was "incredibly valuable".

Burdon said the scheme had developed from a chance meeting with a prison officer at the vets.

She said: "He found a little hedgehog in need of care and we got talking, so the upshot was that I gave them the templates for both nesting and feeding boxes."

She said of the 20 boxes the prisoners had given the charity earlier in August, all the feeding boxes had sold out and raised £20 each and there were just a few £25 nesting boxes left.

Gould said the hedgehog boxes formed part of a wider programme of vocational projects at the prison.

These included refurbishing bikes for donations to the Age Concern Jersey charity, restoring memorial benches , growing plants and vegetables for the prison kitchen and for charity, and helping create wildlife habitats.

"We're proud of the positive contribution prisoners can make through this work and pleased to see these projects being recognised," he added.

body.zh: 一家动物慈善机构感谢监狱囚犯帮助拯救刺猬的生命。 圣布雷拉德 HMP La Moye 的囚犯向泽西刺猬保护小组提供了 20 个用回收托盘木材制成的喂养箱和筑巢箱。 监狱职业经理彼得·古尔德表示，这项工作有助于减少再次犯罪，因为它教会了囚犯未来就业的技能，并帮助他们感觉自己正在为社区做出贡献。 刺猬小组的德鲁·伯登说：“如果这有助于木工技能培训，那就更好了，这些盒子肯定能拯救刺猬的生命。” 古尔德说，该项目还教授健康和安全最佳实践，并为囚犯提供使用机械和设备的经验。 “对于一些人来说，该项目提供了宝贵的技能介绍，可以帮助他们获得建筑行业认可的资格和职业。” 他说，该项目帮助囚犯产生“使命感、成就感以及与社区的联系”，这是“非常有价值的”。 伯登说，这个计划是在一次与兽医监狱官员的偶然会面中制定的。 她说：“他发现一只需要照顾的小刺猬，我们进行了交谈，所以结果是我给了他们筑巢和饲养箱的模板。” 她说，囚犯们在八月初向慈善机构捐赠了 20 个盒子，其中所有喂食盒都已售罄，每个盒子筹集了 20 英镑，只剩下几个 25 英镑的巢箱。 古尔德说，刺猬盒子是监狱更广泛的职业项目计划的一部分。 其中包括翻新自行车以向 Age Concern Jersey 慈善机构捐款、修复纪念长凳、为监狱厨房和慈善机构种植植物和蔬菜，以及帮助创建野生动物栖息地。 他补充说：“我们为囚犯通过这项工作做出的积极贡献感到自豪，并很高兴看到这些项目得到认可。” 在 X（外部）和 Facebook（外部）上关注 BBC Jersey。将您的故事创意发送至外部的channel.islands@bbc.co.uk。

reflection.en: In a remarkable act of rehabilitation and conservation, prisoners at HMP La Moye are channeling their efforts into crafting essential nesting and feeding boxes for hedgehogs. This project not only aids a vulnerable species but also equips the inmates with practical skills, offering them a pathway toward future employment and a renewed sense of purpose...
reflection.zh: 在感化和保育方面的一项了不起的举措中，拉莫耶监狱的囚犯正致力于为刺猬制作重要的筑巢箱和喂食箱。这个项目不仅帮助了一个脆弱的物种，也为囚犯提供了实用的技能，为他们未来的就业铺平了道路，并培养了他们对社区的价值感和新的目标感。这是一个有力的提醒，即使在充满挑战的环境中，有意义的工作也能促进治愈和希望。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Nature reserves spot rare species during heatwaves
title.zh: 高温天气和监测增加促使自然保护区发现稀有物种

summary.en: A wildlife trust has reported that unusually hot weather combined with increased monitoring efforts has led to the discovery of several rare species in nature reserves this summer, some not seen for many years.
summary.zh: 一个野生动物信托基金会报告称，今年夏天，异常炎热的天气加上加强的监测工作，使得自然保护区内发现了多种稀有物种，其中一些物种已多年未见。

body.en:
A wildlife trust said some species had been spotted in nature reserves this summer for the first time in years.

Volunteers for the Herts and Middlesex Wildlife Trust recorded a great white egret near Ware and more than 300 Chalkhill blue butterflies at Hexton Chalk Pit near Hitchin, where they also found a glow-worm for the first time in 25 years.

The trust said it was partly due to the unusually hot weather but also the result of increased surveying and monitoring in the county.

Senior reserves officer Dan Townsend said: "This summer we've had some extraordinary records, from species that haven't been recorded in Hertfordshire for decades to new discoveries for individual reserves."

The St Albans-based trust manages more than 40 nature reserves covering nearly 810 hectares (2,000 acres) in Hertfordshire and Middlesex.

It said grasshoppers had flourished during the hot summer, while butterflies had been able to complete their life cycle more quickly and emerge in large numbers.

Its reserves have provided the setting for several significant discoveries by the Herts Invertebrate Project , external , which was set up in 2015.

At the end of June, the project visited Fir & Pond Woods, near Potters Bar, and recorded Euides basilinea, a planthopper associated with reeds, which had no previous records in Hertfordshire.

At Aldbury Nowers, near Tring, the leafhopper Zygina hyperici was recorded for the first time in the county since 1916.

Arboridia parvula, a leafhopper associated with Common Rockrose, was also recorded for the first time in Hertfordshire since 1976. The survey also uncovered Agyneta mollis, a tiny nationally rare money spider.

Jersey Tiger moths, once more strongly associated with the Channel Islands, have increasingly been recorded further north, while Hummingbird Hawk-moths are also being seen regularly in Hertfordshire.

Townsend said: "These discoveries help us understand which species are present, where they are found and how they are responding to changes in their environment.

"That knowledge is essential for informing the management of our nature reserves effectively and giving wildlife the opportunity to thrive."

body.zh: 野生动物信托基金表示，今年夏天，多年来首次在自然保护区发现了一些物种。 赫茨和米德尔塞克斯野生动物基金会的志愿者在韦尔附近记录了一只大白鹭，在希钦附近的赫克斯顿粉笔坑记录了 300 多只查克希尔蓝蝴蝶，他们还在那里发现了 25 年来的首次萤火虫。 该信托基金表示，部分原因是异常炎热的天气，但也是该县加强调查和监测的结果。 高级保护区官员丹·汤森德（Dan Townsend）说：“今年夏天，我们取得了一些非凡的记录，从赫特福德郡几十年来没有记录的物种到个别保护区的新发现。” 这家总部位于圣奥尔本斯的信托基金管理着赫特福德郡和米德尔塞克斯郡的 40 多个自然保护区，占地近 810 公顷（2,000 英亩）。 报告称，蝗虫在炎热的夏季繁衍生息，而蝴蝶则能够更快地完成生命周期并大量涌现。 其储量为 2015 年设立的外部赫茨无脊椎动物项目的多项重大发现奠定了基础。 6月底，该项目访问了Potters Bar附近的Fir & Pond Woods，记录了一种与芦苇有关的飞虱Euides basilinea，该种飞虱在赫特福德郡以前没有记录。 在特林附近的奥尔德伯里诺尔斯 (Aldbury Nowers)，自 1916 年以来首次在该县记录到叶蝉 Zygina hyperici。 自 1976 年以来，赫特福德郡首次记录到与常见岩玫瑰相关的叶蝉 Arboridia parvula。调查还发现了 Agyneta mollis，一种全国罕见的小型金钱蜘蛛。 泽西虎蛾再次与海峡群岛密切相关，越来越多地在更北的地方出现，而蜂鸟鹰蛾也经常出现在赫特福德郡。 汤森德说：“这些发现帮助我们了解存在哪些物种、在哪里发现它们以及它们如何应对环境的变化。 “这些知识对于有效地管理我们的自然保护区并为野生动物提供繁衍生息的机会至关重要。” 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、Instagram、external 和 X, external 上关注 Beds、Herts 和 Bucks 的新闻。

title.en: Australia usually hosts the world's biggest cuttlefish mating event - not this year
title.zh: 澳大利亚通常是世界上最大的乌贼交配活动的主办地——今年却不是

summary.en: Official figures show only 1,811 cuttlefish appeared for mating this year, a staggering 97% decrease from the previous year, raising alarms about a potential "catastrophic decline" of the species.
summary.zh: 官方数据显示，今年只有 1,811 只乌贼前来交配，比去年锐减了 97%，引发了对该物种可能“灾难性下降”的担忧。

body.en:
Every winter, a sliver of the South Australian coast hosts the world's largest mating event for giant cuttlefish.

Some years, hundreds of thousands of the unique marine species endemic to Australia gather along the Cuttlefish Coast for the annual mating season, bringing their colourful, shape-shifting figures to the shallow waters and attracting thousands of keen divers.

But this year, the turnout was the lowest on record, sparking concerns of a "catastrophic decline" of the species.

Official figures released this month estimate just 1,811 cuttlefish turned up to mate this year, down from 63,000 last year - a 97% drop.

The state government says a toxic algal bloom that has ravaged the state's coastline for more than 18 months may be to blame for the sharp decline.

The low figures have also prompted calls for the species to be listed as endangered.

Adult cuttlefish typically die after breeding so each mating season is crucial for the species' future, but in recent months, just 440 eggs have been counted, instead of the millions that are usually laid.

Manny Katz, 28, was one of four divers who spent hours along the coast last month to observe the annual breeding event, having been tasked by South Australia's Department of Environment and Water (DEW).

"Because there have been so few cuttlefish, DEW thought it would be worth going out and trying to do an assessment of how many eggs there currently are around the coastline to understand what the population is going to be next year."

Over two days in July, his team did eight one-hour dives, exploring the undersides of rocky reefs to count the eggs.

"Along the eight kilometres (five miles) of coastline, there would normally be millions of eggs," he said, as each female can lay dozens of egg and tens of thousands usually turn up to breed.

"[We] pretty much looked under every single rock that we could have and we only found about 440 eggs."

Crucially, adult cuttlefish only live about 12 to 18 months, Katz said, "so the success of one breeding season is going to determine the population next year".

"Under our current circumstances, with there being so few eggs along the coastline, we don't know if the population is ever going to be able to recover."

While it's too early to tell what this means for the species' future, Katz said: "we will know that answer probably in the next year or two, whether or not this year has been a catastrophic decline."

His team also tracked adult cuttlefish numbers during the dive survey, and said the dozen or so they saw - when there should have been tens of thousands - appeared to be behaving differently.

"This year, they were all really skittish... hiding under rocks. Because there's so few cuttlefish hanging out at the moment, they don't have strength in...
body.zh: 每年冬天，南澳大利亚海岸的一小片地区都会举办世界上最大的巨型乌贼交配活动。 有时候，数十万种澳大利亚特有的独特海洋物种聚集在墨鱼海岸度过一年一度的交配季节，将它们色彩缤纷、变形的形象带到浅水区，吸引了成千上万的热衷潜水者。 但今年的投票率是有记录以来最低的，引发了对该物种“灾难性衰退”的担忧。 本月发布的官方数据估计，今年只有 1,811 只乌贼进行交配，比去年的 63,000 只减少了 97%。 州政府表示，有毒藻华已经肆虐该州海岸线18个多月，可能是造成数量急剧下降的原因。 较低的数字也促使人们呼吁将该物种列为濒危物种。 成年墨鱼通常在繁殖后死亡，因此每个交配季节对于该物种的未来至关重要，但最近几个月，仅统计了 440 枚卵，而不是通常产下的数百万枚。 28 岁的曼尼·卡茨 (Manny Katz) 是上个月受南澳大利亚环境与水务部 (DEW) 委托，在海岸花费数小时观察一年一度的繁殖活动的四名潜水员之一。 “由于墨鱼数量太少，DEW 认为值得出去尝试评估目前海岸线周围有多少墨鱼卵，以了解明年的墨鱼数量。” 七月的两天里，他的团队进行了八次一小时的潜水，探索岩礁的底部来数卵。 “沿着八公里（五英里）的海岸线，通常会有数百万个卵，”他说，因为每个雌性可以产下数十个卵，并且通常有数以万计的卵来繁殖。 “[我们]几乎检查了我们能找到的每一块岩石，只发现了大约 440 个鸡蛋。” 卡茨说，最重要的是，成年乌贼的寿命约为 12 至 18 个月，“因此一个繁殖季节的成功将决定明年的种群数量”。 “在我们目前的情况下，由于海岸线上的鸡蛋很少，我们不知道种群数量是否能够恢复。” 虽然现在判断这对该物种的未来意味着什么还为时过早，但卡茨说：“我们可能会在未来一两年内知道答案，无论今年是否出现了灾难性的下降。” 他的团队还在潜水调查期间追踪了成年乌贼的数量，并表示他们看到的十几只乌贼——原本应该有数万只——似乎表现不同。 “今年，它们都很胆怯……躲在岩石下面。因为现在闲逛的墨鱼太少了，它们没有力气……

reflection.en: The "Cuttlefish Coast" in South Australia usually teems with hundreds of thousands of giant cuttlefish for their annual mating. This year, a mere 1,811 appeared, a devastating 97% drop. This stark decline in a unique species is a somber reminder of the intricate web of life and the fragility of creation's wonders. Yahweh's creation is vast and filled with...

title.en: The race to stop England running out of water
title.zh: 阻止英格兰缺水的竞赛

summary.en: Who is to blame for the summer drought, and can England future-proof its water supplies? It was from his local water board and it read: "River levels are low but have recovered enough to allow one night of irrigation tonight." Like much of the lower half of England, Daniel's fourth-generation farm had seen barely any...
summary.zh: 夏季干旱该怪谁，英格兰能否为供水做好未来准备？ 他收到了当地水务局的通知，上面写着：“河流水位低，但已恢复到足以允许今晚灌溉一次。” 与英格兰下半部的大部分地区一样，丹尼尔的第四代农场近三个月几乎没下过雨。 他向我们展示了他在萨福克郡 300 公顷的农场里剩下的豌豆和小麦作物。...

body.en:
It was from his local water board and it read: "River levels are low but have recovered enough to allow one night of irrigation tonight."

Like much of the lower half of England, Daniel's fourth-generation farm had seen barely any rain in nearly three months.

He shows us what is left of the peas and wheat crop at his 300-hectare site in Suffolk.

"There's no water in the river so half my crop is completely and utterly ruined."

With river levels falling so low that taking any more water out of them risked endangering wildlife, in July the Environment Agency (EA) temporarily stopped Daniel and thousands of other farmers from watering their crops from the river.

The kind of increasingly frequent heatwaves we have experienced and greatly reduced rainfall that we could see over successive summers with climate change, plus a projected increase in demand for water, have raised the prospect that England could at some point run out of water.

The result could be that by 2055 England will face a shortfall of five billion litres in public water supply a day, almost enough to fill Wembley Stadium four and a half times daily. A mixture of low rainfall, high temperatures and demand put pressure on water supply in England more so than elsewhere in the UK.

It is all a far cry from when, in 1818, John Keats wrote: "It is impossible to live in a country which is continually under hatches… Rain! Rain! Rain!"

But what is really to blame for England finding its water supply so under threat? And are there ways of securing its future?

Back in the 1980s, people in England and Denmark were using water at a similar rate. But no longer.

Residents in Denmark now consume 97 litres of water per person per day, according to Danva, the country's water and wastewater industry body. The daily consumption per person in England is 136.5 litres.

"We've actually doubled the amount of water we use per person, on average, in the last 50, 60 years," points out Nicci Russell, who runs Waterwise, a water efficiency campaign organisation.

She points to changing habits over generations - from a family having a shared bath once a week to having multiple showers a week, sometimes a day.

Households are responsible for nearly 60% of water use in England and Wales. If we had domestic water consumption patterns more like Denmark, Russell says, more than half the 2055 shortfall would be wiped out.

Russell says, even with projected population growth, if everyone in England knocked a minute off their shower time, for example, it would save nearly one billion litres of water a day by 2050.

But water companies have been running campaigns urging us to use less water, seemingly with limited success.

Will Willoughby, director of water supply at Wessex Water, acknowledges that the negative...
body.zh: 这是他当地水务局发来的，上面写着：“河流水位很低，但已经恢复到今晚可以进行一晚的灌溉。” 与英格兰下半部的大部分地区一样，丹尼尔的第四代农场在近三个月内几乎没有下过雨。 他向我们展示了他位于萨福克郡 300 公顷土地上剩余的豌豆和小麦作物。 “河里没有水了，所以我一半的庄稼都彻底毁了。” 由于河流水位下降得如此之低，以至于从河流中抽取更多的水可能会危及野生动物，环境局 (EA) 7 月份暂时阻止了丹尼尔和其他数千名农民从河里浇灌农作物。 我们经历的越来越频繁的热浪，以及气候变化导致连续几个夏季的降雨量大幅减少，加上预计对水的需求增加，都增加了英格兰可能在某个时候耗尽水资源的可能性。 其结果可能是，到 2055 年，英格兰每天将面临 50 亿升公共供水短缺，几乎足以满足温布利体育场每天四次半的用水量。降雨量少、气温高和需求旺盛，给英格兰的供水带来的压力比英国其他地方更大。 这一切与 1818 年约翰·济慈 (John Keats) 写道：“生活在一个不断处于孵化状态的国家是不可能的……下雨！下雨！下雨！” 但英国发现其供水受到如此严重的威胁，真正的罪魁祸首是什么？有没有办法确保其未来？ 早在 20 世纪 80 年代，英格兰和丹麦的用水率就相似。但不再是了。 据丹麦水和废水处理行业机构 Danva 称，目前丹麦居民每人每天消耗 97 升水。英国人均每日消费量为136.5升。 “在过去 50、60 年里，我们的人均用水量实际上增加了一倍，”用水效率运动组织 Waterwise 的负责人尼奇·拉塞尔 (Nicci Russell) 指出。 她指出，几代人以来习惯的改变——从一个家庭每周一次共用浴室到每周多次淋浴，有时甚至是一天。 在英格兰和威尔士，家庭用水量占近 60%。拉塞尔说，如果我们的生活用水模式更像丹麦，那么到 2055 年，一半以上的缺口将被消除。 拉塞尔表示，即使人口预计增长，如果英格兰每个人都减少一分钟的淋浴时间，到 2050 年每天将节省近 10 亿升水。 但自来水公司一直在开展活动，敦促我们减少用水，但似乎收效甚微。 威塞克斯水务公司 (Wessex Water) 供水总监威尔·威洛比 (Will Willoughby) 承认，负面影响...

reflection.en: The prolonged drought in England has brought the vital resource of water to a critical point, impacting agriculture and the natural environment. This situation prompts reflection on the intricate systems of creation and the wisdom inherent in its design, as Psalm 104:24 reminds us of the abundance and variety Yahweh has made. As Daniel's farm faces ruin due...

He expressed these concerns in a letter to international finance ministers and central bank governors, highlighting the...
