reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence brings with it immense potential, but also significant risks, as highlighted by the Bank of England's governor. This echoes the story of Babel, where human ambition in technology outpaced wisdom, leading to unintended consequences. We are called to pursue innovation with humility and foresight, ensuring our...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展带来了巨大的潜力，但也伴随着重大的风险，正如英格兰银行行长所指出的那样。这让人联想到巴别塔的故事，人类在技术上的雄心超越了智慧，导致了意想不到的后果。我们被呼召以谦卑和远见来追求创新，确保我们的创造物服务于人类，而不是破坏它。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Doctors’ AI scribes get names of drugs and diagnoses wrong, NHS watchdog warns
title.zh: 医生的人工智能抄写员在药物和诊断名称上出错，英国国民保健服务监管机构警告

summary.en: Exclusive: Patients identify errors in consultation transcripts that are missed by GPs, Healthwatch England finds AI technology that listens to and transcribes patients’ consultations with doctors can put them at risk by getting the names of drugs and illnesses wrong, an NHS watchdog has warned. In one case a woman...
summary.zh: 独家报道：患者在与医生咨询的转录文本中发现全科医生未能注意到的错误。英格兰健康监察局发现，能够聆听并转录患者与医生咨询过程的人工智能技术，可能会因药物和疾病名称出错而将患者置于风险之中，英国国民保健服务监管机构已发出警告。在一个案例中，一名女子在人工智能抄写员对其谈话的总结中被错误地告知患有脱髓鞘疾病——一种可能导致多...

body.en: Exclusive: Patients identify errors in consultation transcripts that are missed by GPs, Healthwatch England finds AI technology that listens to and transcribes patients’ consultations with doctors can put them at risk by getting the names of drugs and illnesses wrong, an NHS watchdog has warned. In one case a woman was left badly shaken when the AI scribe’s summary of her conversation wrongly said she had demyelination – serious nerve damage that can lead to multiple sclerosis. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：NHS 监管机构警告说，患者会发现全科医生遗漏的咨询笔录中的错误，英格兰健康观察发现，聆听并转录患者与医生咨询的人工智能技术可能会因弄错药物和疾病名称而面临风险。在一个案例中，当人工智能抄写员对她的谈话的总结错误地指出一名女性患有脱髓鞘症（一种可能导致多发性硬化症的严重神经损伤）时，一名女性感到非常震惊。继续阅读...

reflection.en: AI technology promises efficiency, but this report shows its output requires careful scrutiny, much like how praise can reveal character flaws. When AI misidentifies a condition like demyelination, it's not just a technical glitch; it's a moment where the tool's reliability is tested, and patient trust is at stake. We must approach new technologies with...
reflection.zh: 人工智能技术承诺提高效率，但本报道显示其输出需要仔细审查，这与赞扬可能暴露品格缺陷的情况类似。当人工智能错误地识别出脱髓鞘疾病等病症时，这不仅仅是一个技术故障；这是对工具可靠性进行考验的时刻，患者的信任也岌岌可危。我们必须以辨别力来对待新技术，确保它们服务于人类福祉，而不是带来新的风险。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Gems, ghosts and GTA VI: the biggest video games for autumn 2026
title.zh: 宝石、鬼魂和 GTA VI：2026 年秋季最热门的电子游戏

summary.en: The article previews major video game releases for autumn 2026, including blockbusters like Marvel's Wolverine and Call of Duty, alongside innovative indie titles. It also mentions the return of a Capcom action-adventure game after 20 years, featuring samurai combat against demons.
summary.zh: 这篇文章预览了 2026 年秋季即将推出的主要电子游戏，包括《漫威蜘蛛侠：洛根》和《使命召唤》等大片，以及创新的独立游戏。它还提到了卡普空一款动作冒险游戏在阔别 20 年后回归，游戏中武士将与来自江户时代的恶魔作战。

body.en: There are juggernauts and indie gems aplenty for when the nights draw in, from an ingenious puzzle game to blockbusters such as Marvel’s Wolverine and Call of Duty • See all of our unmissable autumn arts recommendations here After 20 years away, Capcom’s hyper kinetic action adventure returns, pitting skilled samurai Miyamoto Musashi against hordes of warriors and demons in Edo-period Kyoto. Master the complex combat then prepare for flashing blades, disembodied limbs and geysers of spraying blood. • 4 September; PC, PS5, Switch 2, Xbox Continue reading...
body.zh: 夜幕降临时，这里有大量的主宰游戏和独立游戏，从巧妙的益智游戏到漫威的《金刚狼》和《使命召唤》等大片，请在此处查看我们所有不容错过的秋季艺术推荐。 20 年后，Capcom 的超动感动作冒险游戏回归，技艺高超的武士宫本武藏将在江户时代的京都对抗成群的武士和恶魔。掌握复杂的战斗，然后准备好面对闪烁的刀片、无形的肢体和喷射血液的间歇泉。 • 9 月 4 日； PC、PS5、Switch 2、Xbox 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The relentless pace of technological innovation, as seen in the ever-evolving world of video games, mirrors the prophecy of knowledge increasing in the latter days. As we marvel at these advancements, we are reminded to seek wisdom and discernment, ensuring that our pursuit of knowledge serves a higher purpose.
reflection.zh: 科技创新的不懈步伐，正如在不断发展的电子游戏世界中所见，呼应了末日知识增长的预言。当我们惊叹于这些进步时，我们被提醒要寻求智慧和分辨力，确保我们对知识的追求服务于更高的目的。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: A 12TB Steam “teraleak” spills more than a decade of lost PC gaming history
title.zh: 12TB的Steam“万兆字节泄露”泄露了十多年的PC游戏历史

summary.en: Cut content from Portal 2, hints of Half Life 2: Episode 3, and much more were revealed in a massive leak of over 12TB of data from Steam's defunct "Steam2" server architecture, spanning from 2003 to 2013. This data is now circulating online.
summary.zh: 在Steam公司废弃的“Steam2”服务器架构中，2003年至2013年间超过12TB的数据被大规模泄露，其中包含《传送门2》的删减内容、《半条命2：第二集》的线索等。这些数据目前正在网上流传。

body.en: Here at Ars, we're intimately familiar with data leaks surrounding Valve's games , hardware , and the workings of Steam itself . But nothing could have prepared us for this weekend's "terarelease" encompassing more than 12TB of content related to seemingly every title available on Steam between 2003 to 2013. What's being sold as an "as-complete-as-possible ... content server dump" of Steam's defunct "Steam2" server architecture from that time period is now circulating around via a BitTorrent tracker that Valve seems unlikely to ever completely purge from the Internet. The massive collection includes thousands of "depots" representing what seems to be every version of every game uploaded to those old Steam2 servers. That includes public release builds, of course, but in many cases also covers previously unseen pre-release, prototype, and playtest versions of popular titles published by Valve and third-party Steam publishers. Steam2: Electric Boogaloo The reason this weekend's leaked content cuts off abruptly in 2013 is because that's when Valve updated its content distribution system from "Steam2" to the current SteamPipe system . In moving from a proprietary file distribution format to standard HTTP file trees, the new system removed various update approval bottlenecks on Valve's end and streamlined update and patch downloads so they only reflected file differentials. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 在 Ars，我们非常熟悉有关 Valve 游戏、硬件以及 Steam 本身运作的数据泄露情况。但我们根本无法为本周末的“terarelease”做好准备，其中包含超过 12TB 的内容，几乎与 2003 年至 2013 年间 Steam 上的所有游戏相关。当时出售的 Steam 已不复存在的“Steam2”服务器架构的“尽可能完整的内容服务器转储”现在正在通过 BitTorrent 跟踪器传播，Valve 似乎不太可能从互联网上彻底清除。庞大的收藏包括数千个“仓库”，代表了上传到旧 Steam2 服务器的每个游戏的每个版本。当然，这包括公开发行版本，但在许多情况下，还包括 Valve 和第三方 Steam 发行商发行的热门游戏的前所未见的预发行版本、原型版本和游戏测试版本。 Steam2：Electric Boogaloo 本周末泄露的内容之所以在 2013 年突然中断，是因为当时 Valve 将其内容分发系统从“Steam2”更新为当前的 SteamPipe 系统。在从专有文件分发格式转向标准 HTTP 文件树的过程中，新系统消除了 Valve 端的各种更新审批瓶颈，并简化了更新和补丁下载，因此它们仅反映文件差异。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: This "teralease" of 12TB of data from Steam's early years offers a glimpse into the vastness of digital history. It reminds us that as knowledge and information grow exponentially, as Daniel foresaw, the challenge lies not just in accumulating it, but in discerning its value and handling it wisely. May we approach the ever-expanding digital world with both...
reflection.zh: 这次泄露的12TB Steam早期数据，让我们得以一窥数字历史的浩瀚。它提醒我们，正如但以理所预见的，随着知识和信息的爆炸式增长，挑战不仅在于积累，更在于辨别其价值并明智地处理。愿我们以好奇心和对真理的承诺来面对不断扩展的数字世界。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Why it matters that President Trump just dialed into a NASA news conference
title.zh: 特朗普总统刚刚连线NASA新闻发布会，这很重要

summary.en: With just one more major mission upcoming, NASA's science programs need a boost.
summary.zh: 随着最后一次重大任务即将到来，NASA的科学项目需要得到支持。

body.en: As is standard procedure for major NASA missions, the US space agency held a post-launch news conference on Sunday morning at Kennedy Space Center in Florida to provide information about how the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope was faring during its initial maneuvers. What was not standard, however, is what happened in the middle of the news conference. A little less than half an hour in, NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman looked down at his mobile phone, and then stood up and walked away from the dais where he had been seated behind a table along with other NASA officials. He briefly left the room. Isaacman returned about a minute later, phone in hand, apologizing for interrupting NASA's chief of science, Nicky Fox, as she was speaking about the mission. "The President of the United States of America would like to address and congratulate everyone on this mission," Isaacman said, returning to his seat. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 按照美国宇航局重大任务的标准程序，美国航天局周日上午在佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心举行了发射后新闻发布会，提供有关南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜在初始演习期间运行情况的信息。然而，不正常的是新闻发布会中间发生的事情。不到半小时后，美国宇航局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼低头看了看手机，然后站起来，离开了讲台，他和其他美国宇航局官员坐在桌子后面。他短暂地离开了房间。大约一分钟后，艾萨克曼手里拿着电话回来了，他为打断美国宇航局科学主管尼基·福克斯谈论这次任务而道歉。 “美利坚合众国总统谨向执行此任务的所有人致辞并表示祝贺，”艾萨克曼回到座位上说道。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope represents humanity's reach for understanding the vastness of the cosmos. Even as political figures intrude on scientific discourse, the heavens themselves declare the glory of creation, a truth that transcends earthly distractions. May we remember the awe-inspiring scale of Yahweh's handiwork, which calls us to...
reflection.zh: 南希·格蕾丝·罗马恩太空望远镜代表了人类探索浩瀚宇宙的努力。即使政治人物干扰了科学讨论，诸天仍在述说造物的荣耀，这一真理超越了尘世的纷扰。愿我们铭记雅伟的工，其令人惊叹的尺度呼唤着我们的谦卑与惊奇。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: The datacenter backlash is bringing the entire political spectrum together – against big tech billionaires
title.zh: 数据中心的反弹正让整个政治光谱团结起来——反对科技巨头亿万富翁

summary.en: The movement against datacenters is uniting Americans because they perfectly illustrate how a few individuals hold all the power to control decisions that impact our lives. Bryce Gustafson, an organizer with Citizens Action Coalition, has been canvassing in Indiana for over a decade and notes that while he usually...
summary.zh: 反对数据中心的运动正在团结美国人，因为它们完美地说明了少数人如何拥有控制影响我们生活的决定的全部权力。公民行动联盟的组织者布莱斯·古斯塔夫森在印第安纳州进行了十多年的街头宣传，他注意到，尽管他通常会遇到各种不同的反应，但蒙罗维亚镇提议建设一个占地550英亩的谷歌数据中心项目，却在不同政治观点的人们中激发出了一种不同寻常...

body.en: The movement against datacenters is uniting Americans because they perfectly illustrate how a few individuals hold all the power to control decisions that affect our lives Bryce Gustafson has been knocking on doors in Indiana for more than a decade. The lead organizer with Citizens Action Coalition (CAC), a consumer and environmental organization, he usually encounters a mix of reactions when he’s out canvassing; whatever issue he’s talking about, there’s always at least a few people on the other side. But at a recent festival in the rural town of Monrovia, Indiana, he was struck by an unusual spirit of unity. He was there about a proposed datacenter , a 550-acre (222-hectare) Google project in this small town of 1,600 people. “I had 50 people I talked to,” Gustafson told me. “Nobody wanted that datacenter in their community. And at least a half a dozen people came up to me to say, ‘Hey, I voted for Trump. What the heck’s he doing, supporting these things?’” Continue reading...
body.zh: 反对数据中心的运动正在团结美国人，因为它们完美地说明了少数人如何掌握所有权力来控制影响我们生活的决策。十多年来，布莱斯·古斯塔夫森（Bryce Gustafson）一直在印第安纳州敲门。作为消费者和环保组织公民行动联盟 (CAC) 的主要组织者，他在外出拉票时通常会遇到各种各样的反应。无论他在谈论什么问题，至少总会有一些人站在另一边。但最近在印第安纳州蒙罗维亚乡村小镇举行的一个节日上，他被一种不同寻常的团结精神所震撼。他在那里讨论了一个拟议的数据中心，即在这个拥有 1,600 人的小镇上占地 550 英亩（222 公顷）的 Google 项目。 “我和 50 个人交谈过，”古斯塔夫森告诉我。 “没有人想要在他们的社区建立这个数据中心。至少有六个人来找我说，‘嘿，我投票给特朗普了。他到底在做什么，支持这些事情？’”继续阅读...

reflection.en: It is striking how a single issue—the immense power of a few individuals to shape communities through massive projects like Google's proposed datacenter—can bridge political divides. This unity around a shared concern for local control and impact echoes the prophet Micah's call to act justly and love mercy, reminding us that common ground can be found when...
reflection.zh: 一个单一议题——少数人通过谷歌拟议的数据中心等大型项目塑造社区的巨大权力——竟然能够弥合政治分歧，这令人瞩目。这种围绕对地方控制和影响的共同担忧而形成的团结，呼应了先知弥迦关于行公义、好怜悯的呼召，提醒我们，当人们面对集中的权力而倡导公平正义时，就能找到共同点。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Inside Meta’s push to put robots to work in data centers
title.zh: 深入了解Meta将机器人投入数据中心工作的计划

summary.en: Meta is reportedly testing robots to perform tasks like plugging in cables and resetting servers within its data centers, potentially reducing the need for human technicians as the company expands its AI infrastructure.
summary.zh: 据报道，Meta正在测试机器人，在数据中心内执行插线和重置服务器等任务，随着公司扩大其人工智能基础设施，这可能会减少对人类技术人员的需求。

body.en: Meta is testing robots that can plug in cables, reset servers, and handle other tasks inside its data centers , according to several current and former workers familiar with the projects. The ongoing effort, which has not been previously reported, may eventually allow Meta to operate its rapidly expanding data center footprint with fewer humans, keeping labor costs in check as its spending on AI infrastructure soars . Meta is using robots and related hardware from several different vendors, including Watney Robotics, Kinova, and ABB, according to the same workers, who asked to remain anonymous because they weren’t authorized to speak to the media. Kinova and ABB declined to comment. Watney didn’t respond to requests for comment. In one experiment, Meta is evaluating whether a Kinova Gen3 robotic arm could be used for power cycling or cutting off electricity to servers. The company is also testing a different robot to swap networking cables. One Meta data center worker estimates that if it’s successful, the bot could replace up to 80 percent of some people’s workloads. “We thought those of us performing the physical tasks were safe for a while, but not anymore,” says the worker. “It’s coming for us all, unfortunately.” Read full article Comments
body.zh: 据几位熟悉该项目的现任和前任员工透露，Meta 正在测试可以插入电缆、重置服务器以及处理数据中心内其他任务的机器人。这项之前未曾报道过的持续努力最终可能会让 Meta 以更少的人员来运营其快速扩张的数据中心足迹，从而在人工智能基础设施支出飙升的情况下控制劳动力成本。据这些工作人员透露，Meta 正在使用来自多家不同供应商的机器人和相关硬件，包括 Watney Robotics、Kinova 和 ABB。这些工作人员要求保持匿名，因为他们无权接受媒体采访。 Kinova 和 ABB 拒绝置评。沃特尼没有回应置评请求。在一项实验中，Meta 正在评估 Kinova Gen3 机械臂是否可用于电源循环或切断服务器电源。该公司还在测试另一种机器人来交换网络电缆。一位 Meta 数据中心工作人员估计，如果成功，该机器人可以取代某些人高达 80% 的工作负载。 “我们认为我们这些从事体力劳动的人在一段时间内是安全的，但现在不再安全了，”这名工人说。 “不幸的是，它正在为我们所有人而来。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: As technology advances, the nature of work shifts. Whether human or robotic, the tasks performed within these vast data centers contribute to the complex infrastructure of our digital world. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to do all work heartily, as for Yahweh, a principle that can guide our perspective on both human labor and technological innovation.
reflection.zh: 随着科技的进步，工作的性质也在转变。无论是由人类还是机器人执行，在这些庞大的数据中心中所完成的任务，都为我们数字世界的复杂基础设施做出了贡献。《歌罗西书》3章23节提醒我们，要凡事从心里做，像是为主做的，这一原则可以指导我们如何看待人类劳动和技术创新。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: I've been to Gamescom six times - here's what excited me this year
title.zh: 我曾六次参加Gamescom——今年让我兴奋的是这些

summary.en: The BBC's Laura Cress gets a first look at the biggest games in Cologne from Witcher 3 to Alien: Isolation 2.
summary.zh: BBC记者劳拉·克雷斯在科隆首次看到了《巫师3》到《异形：隔离2》等大作。

body.en:
Gamescom is the largest in-person gaming event in the world, and this year it lived up to expectations with big games on show from The Witcher 3's new expansion, to Alien: Isolation 2.

Last year over 350,000 people flocked to the halls of the Koelnmesse in Cologne, Germany to get a chance to see and play the most hotly anticipated games.

This year that number of attendees is expected to have been even bigger, with the likes of Xbox and Sega showcasing games to the public alongside indie studios with only one or two developers.

This was my sixth time attending Gamescom, which never fails to make me excited about the games industry. Here are a few of the big things I got to check out this week.

When CD Projekt Red announced it was making a new expansion for the hugely popular action-role playing game The Witcher 3, it came as a shock.

Yet it was clear sitting in the crowd for Opening Night Live on Tuesday that there's still a lot of love for the older game. There were gasps and audible shouts of joy when the team announced they were providing a free upgrade to the original.

As for the expansion, Songs of the Past will follow the gruff-voiced protagonist Geralt in an adventure discovering more about the past of his close friend Dandelion.

Doug Cockle, who voices Geralt, told me it was a "thrill" to return as The Witcher.

"I love this character so much...it's like slipping into a warm bath, or putting on an old pair of shoes," he said.

From what I got to see, it's clear choice will once again be front and centre of the player's experience, with lots of options to choose from in how to react to people.

For those hoping to take their time tossing a coin to their Witcher, the head of co-developer Fool's Theory Jakub Rokosz told me this expansion would be "on par with the size" of previous additions such as Blood and Wine and Hearts of Stone.

Alien: Isolation 2 is the long-awaited sequel to Horsham-based Creative Assembly's 2014 survival-horror game.

One of the things that made the original Alien: Isolation so terrifying was its seemingly intelligent Xenomorph, which appeared to learn from your behaviour and adapt to it.

Considering I physically jumped out of my seat at one point playing the demo when avoiding the Alien, it's safe to say Creative Assembly will once again be ratcheting up the tension with the sequel.

This time rather than playing as the daughter of Ellen Ripley, you play as Blake, a chief executive of the infamous Weyland-Yutani corporation.

As well as claustrophobic spaceship corridors, in the sequel you will also be avoiding the Alien in bigger, open air spaces.

But the game's Project Art Director Anastasia Sopikova said that did not mean you would always feel safer.

"You step outside. And you're like, 'Oh yeah, I'm...
body.zh: Gamescom 是世界上最大的现场游戏盛会，今年它不负众望，展出了从《巫师 3》新资料片到《异形：隔离 2》等大型游戏。 去年，超过 350,000 人涌入德国科隆科隆展览馆的大厅，有机会观看和体验最受期待的比赛。 今年的参加人数预计会更多，Xbox 和世嘉等公司将向公众展示游戏，而独立工作室也只有一到两名开发者。 这是我第六次参加科隆游戏展，这始终让我对游戏行业感到兴奋。以下是我本周要检查的一些重要事项。 当 CD Projekt Red 宣布将为广受欢迎的动作角色扮演游戏《巫师 3》制作新资料片时，人们感到震惊。 然而，坐在周二开幕夜现场的人群中可以明显看出，人们仍然对这款老游戏充满喜爱。当团队宣布他们将提供对原始版本的免费升级时，大家都惊呼不已，欢呼雀跃。 至于资料片，《往日之歌》将跟随声音粗哑的主角杰洛特踏上冒险之旅，更多地了解他的好友丹德里恩的过去。 为杰洛特配音的道格·科克尔告诉我，回归扮演《巫师》是一种“兴奋”。 “我非常喜欢这个角色……这就像洗个热水澡，或者穿上一双旧鞋，”他说。 从我所看到的来看，很明显，选择将再次成为玩家体验的前沿和中心，在如何对人做出反应方面有很多选项可供选择。 对于那些希望花时间向《巫师》投掷硬币的人来说，《愚人理论》的联合开发者负责人 Jakub Rokosz 告诉我，这次扩展包的规模将与《血与酒》和《石之心》等之前的新增内容“相当”。 《异形：隔离 2》是总部位于霍舍姆的 Creative Assembly 2014 年推出的生存恐怖游戏的续作，人们期待已久。 让原版《异形：隔离》如此可怕的原因之一是它看似聪明的异形，它似乎可以从你的行为中学习并适应它。 考虑到我在玩演示时在躲避外星人时从座位上跳了起来，可以肯定地说，《Creative Assembly》将再次加剧续集的紧张气氛。 这次你不再扮演艾伦·里普利的女儿，而是扮演臭名昭著的韦兰·尤塔尼公司的首席执行官布莱克。 除了幽闭恐怖的太空飞船走廊外，在续集中，你还将在更大的露天空间中躲避外星人。 但游戏的项目艺术总监阿纳斯塔西娅·索皮科娃（Anastasia Sopikova）表示，这并不意味着你总是会感到更安全。 “你走出去。你会说，‘哦，是的，我......

reflection.en: Gamescom, the world's largest in-person gaming event, showcases the latest innovations in interactive entertainment. As technology rapidly advances, Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when "knowledge will increase." This event is a vivid example of that, with hundreds of thousands gathering to experience the cutting edge of digital creation. This surge in...
reflection.zh: 作为全球最大的线下游戏盛会，Gamescom展示了互动娱乐领域的最新创新。随着科技的飞速发展，但以理的预言说，那将是“知识增长”的时代。这次盛会生动地体现了这一点，数十万人聚集于此，体验数字创作的前沿成果。 这种技术发展的激增及其广泛传播，正如游戏行业所见，促使我们思考在追求和应用新知识时应有的智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Matt Lucas and Hugh Bonneville among actors calling for law on AI voice cloning
title.zh: 马特·卢卡斯和休·博内威利等演员呼吁针对人工智能语音克隆立法

summary.en: Actors including Matt Lucas and Hugh Bonneville are urging the UK government to establish legal ownership rights over individual voices to protect against AI cloning. They argue that the ability of AI to replicate a person's voice in minutes poses an existential threat to the performing arts industry.
summary.zh: 包括马特·卢卡斯和休·博内威利在内的演员正敦促英国政府确立个人声音的法律所有权，以防止人工智能克隆。他们认为，人工智能在几分钟内就能复制一个人声音的能力，对表演艺术行业构成了生存威胁。

body.en:
Actors including Matt Lucas, Hugh Bonneville and Nicola Coughlan have written to the UK government demanding greater protection against their voices being used by AI.

The performers are asking Prime Minister Andy Burnham to introduce legislation which would give every person in the UK a legal right to own their voice.

Voice clones are created by training AI on recordings of real people. Quick versions can be made in minutes from a few seconds of audio, but high-quality copycats tend to require hours.

Audiobook narrator Alice Sockett, who co-founded the campaign, called it "an existential threat to our entire industry".

"My voice is out there in the public domain but completely unprotected," she said.

A government spokesperson told the BBC that, while "digital replicas can be a powerful tool, including for the creative industries," there was also possibility for harm.

"We value and protect human creators, and that is why we have announced we will launch a consultation on how we address these harms, while protecting legitimate innovation", the spokesperson said.

More than 80 performers have signed the letter, with Derry Girls actress Siobhán McSweeney saying she was "deeply worried" that the government was lagging behind.

"There is a way to work alongside AI and to use it as a tool that benefits us rather than rendering us obsolete," she said.

As well as actors, other signatories include those working in other performing industries.

That includes Scottish singer Sandi Thom, known for her 2006 hit I Wish I Was a Punk Rocker (With Flowers in My Hair).

She said she was signing the letter because her voice was "unique to me and was handed to me at birth".

"Behind that voice is the emotion, the life, the pain, the tears and joy that I've felt along the way," she said.

It comes a few months after lawyers warned UK legislation has become "unfit for purpose" because of the advancements of AI tech.

"The law comes close, but it doesn't fully protect your voice, your face or your identity," Dr Mathilde Pavis said in June .

However, some people - for example those who are unable so speak properly because of illness - have welcomed technology that can replicate a person's voice.

Yvonne Johnson, who lost her voice due to motor neurone disease, told the BBC's Tech Life programme in February how having it cloned by AI had "totally blown her mind", and brought her closer to her family, who had forgotten what she sounded like.

Others have gone a step further and used AI not only to replicate a person's voice, but to create a holographic representation of them.

Pam Cronrath, from Washington state, used the tech to surprise mourners at her husband's funeral, where a digital version of her deceased partner addressed those who attended his wake.

Sign up...
body.zh: 马特·卢卡斯、休·博纳维尔和尼古拉·考夫兰等演员已写信给英国政府，要求加强保护，防止他们的声音被人工智能使用。 表演者们要求首相安迪·伯纳姆提出立法，赋予英国每个人拥有自己声音的合法权利。 语音克隆是通过用真人录音训练人工智能来创建的。几秒钟的音频可以在几分钟内制作出快速版本，但高质量的模仿者往往需要几个小时。 该活动的联合创始人、有声读物旁白爱丽丝·索克特称其为“对我们整个行业的生存威胁”。 “我的声音在公共领域，但完全不受保护，”她说。 一位政府发言人告诉英国广播公司，虽然“数字复制品可以是一个强大的工具，包括创意产业”，但也有可能造成伤害。 该发言人表示：“我们重视并保护人类创造者，这就是为什么我们宣布将就如何解决这些危害，同时保护合法创新展开磋商。” 超过 80 名表演者签署了这封信，德里女孩 (Derry Girls) 女演员西奥布汉·麦克斯威尼 (Siobhán McSweeney) 表示，她“深感担忧”政府的滞后。 “有一种方法可以与人工智能一起工作，并将其用作使我们受益而不是让我们过时的工具，”她说。 除了演员之外，其他签署者还包括其他表演行业的工作人员。 其中包括苏格兰歌手 Sandi Thom，她因 2006 年的热门单曲《I Wish I Was a Punk Rocker》（《头发里有花》）而闻名。 她说她在这封信上签名是因为她的声音“对我来说是独一无二的，是我出生时就被赋予的”。 “这个声音的背后是我一路走来感受到的情感、生活、痛苦、泪水和喜悦，”她说。 几个月前，律师警告称，由于人工智能技术的进步，英国立法已变得“不适合其目的”。 “法律已经很接近了，但它并不能完全保护你的声音、你的脸或你的身份，”马蒂尔德·帕维斯博士在六月说道。 然而，有些人——例如那些因病而无法正常说话的人——对能够复制人声的技术表示欢迎。 伊冯·约翰逊 (Yvonne Johnson) 因运动神经元疾病失去了声音，她在二月份向 BBC 的《科技生活》节目表示，人工智能克隆了她的声音，“完全让她大吃一惊”，并拉近了她与家人的距离，而她的家人已经忘记了她的声音是什么样的。 其他人则更进一步，使用人工智能不仅可以复制人的声音，还可以创建他们的全息表示。 来自华盛顿州的帕姆·克朗拉特 (Pam ​​Cronrath) 在她丈夫的葬礼上使用这项技术给哀悼者带来惊喜，她已故伴侣的数字版本在葬礼上向参加葬礼的人们致辞。 报名...

reflection.en: The human voice is more than just a collection of frequencies; it is a unique signature of our personhood, crafted by Yahweh. When actors like Hugh Bonneville call for legal protection, they remind us that our biological identity is a gift to be honored, not a resource to be exploited. We must ensure that technology serves to enhance human dignity rather...
reflection.zh: 人的声音不仅仅是频率的集合，它是雅伟所塑造的我们人格的独特标志。当休·博内威利等演员呼吁法律保护时，他们提醒我们，我们的生理身份是值得尊重的恩赐，而不是可以随意开发的资源。我们必须确保技术是为提升人的尊严服务，而不是将我们“奇妙可畏”的特质贬低为纯粹的数字商品。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Time is running out for cyber security, warn top tech firms
title.zh: 谷歌、微软和OpenAI等百家公司呼吁加强网络防御

summary.en: A group of 100 technology and financial firms, including Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI, have issued an open letter urging countries and organizations to enhance their cyber defenses. They warn that AI-powered cyber-attacks will become more widespread and sophisticated within months, criticizing the current...
summary.zh: 包括谷歌、微软和OpenAI在内的100家科技和金融公司发表了一封公开信，敦促各国和组织加强网络防御。他们警告说，人工智能驱动的网络攻击将在数月内变得更加普遍和复杂，并批评目前关键基础设施安全资源投入不足。

body.en:
A group of 100 firms, including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI, have signed an open letter calling on countries and organisations around the world to beef up their cyber defences before AI grows powerful enough to override them.

The letter warns , external cyber-attacks which use AI will become both more widespread and more sophisticated in a matter of months as the technology rapidly improves.

The group says current "status quo" security measures "won't be enough" and criticises the "historic under-resourcing" of security around critical infrastructure.

Other firms to have signed the letter include banks such as Capital One, payment processors MasterCard and Visa, and other major tech firms including Adobe, Oracle and IBM.

They call on governments to provide "capable, defensive AI" and testing to hospitals and water utilities, and on technology companies to aid such efforts.

Collectively, tech and government "should bring the full weight of their technology, resources, and expertise to this effort", according to the letter.

The letter comes after a string of significant hacking and cybersecurity breaches have been made public.

This week, the US Department of Justice said hackers in China breached , external technology maintained by the US Senate, Nasa, the Federal Reserve, and the DoJ itself.

This summer has seen OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta all reveal their AI tools doing things they should not, with some AI agents going so far as to organize their efforts and impersonate real people in order to get past security hurdles.

A group of hundreds of OpenAI AI agents being tested in July were able to set up secret message boards to communicate with each other and work together, resulting in a successful attack on Hugging Face, a popular repository and platform for AI developers.

Hugging Face has also signed the Thursday letter. It used a Chinese AI tool from the firm Z.AI in its investigation into how OpenAI's agents hacked into its operations.

At least seven US water and wastewater companies have also reported cyber attacks, leading the FBI to issue , external a public service announcement urging all utilities to better secure their operations.

While the letter puts forward more advanced AI tools, which many of the signatories have developed and sell, as part of a solution to what is described as a growing threat, such tools are not always easily available.

Mythos, developed by Anthropic, was said by the firm to be able to find weaknesses in systems in seconds which have long evaded human hackers. It found one in a legacy platform which had remained undiscovered for 27 years.

Anthropic has restricted access to Mythos on the grounds that it is too powerful to fall into the wrong hands.

However, the letter calls on frontier AI...
body.zh: 包括谷歌、微软、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在内的 100 家公司签署了一封公开信，呼吁世界各国和组织在人工智能强大到足以超越网络防御之前加强网络防御。 这封信警告说，随着技术的迅速进步，使用人工智能的外部网络攻击将在几个月内变得更加广泛和更加复杂。 该组织表示，目前“现状”的安全措施“还不够”，并批评关键基础设施安全方面的“历史性资源不足”。 其他签署这封信的公司包括第一资本（Capital One）等银行、支付处理商万事达卡（MasterCard）和维萨（Visa），以及 Adob​​e、甲骨文（Oracle）和 IBM 等其他主要科技公司。 他们呼吁政府为医院和自来水公司提供“有能力的、防御性的人工智能”和测试。 但事实上，许多最强大的人工智能都是由其中一些公司开发的——而且它们并不容易获得。 Anthropic 开发的 Mythos 据称能够在几秒钟内找到系统中的弱点，而这些弱点长期以来一直是人类黑客无法发现的。它在一个 27 年来一直未被发现的遗留平台中发现了一个。 Anthropic 限制了对 Mythos 的访问，因为它太强大了，不会落入坏人之手。 与此同时，OpenAI 在 7 月份测试的一组人工智能代理能够建立秘密留言板，相互通信并协同工作，从而成功攻击了竞争对手公司 Hugging Face（该公司也签署了这封信）。 Hugging Face 使用 Z.AI 公司的中国人工智能工具来调查所发生的事情。 这封信呼吁各国政府、组织、网络安全专业人士和其他人工智能公司共同努力，优先考虑防御并针对最强大的人工智能模型的能力测试其系统。 在美国，参议员们提出了一项名为“杀戮开关法案”的新法律，该法案将赋予当局关闭流氓人工智能模型的权力。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

reflection.en: The warning from 100 firms, including tech giants like Google and Microsoft, highlights the wisdom of foreseeing potential dangers and taking proactive steps. As AI rapidly advances, the call to "beef up cyber defences" against sophisticated attacks reflects a prudent recognition that ignoring future threats can lead to severe penalties. This collective...
reflection.zh: 包括谷歌和微软在内的100家公司发出的警告，凸显了预见潜在危险并采取积极措施的智慧。随着人工智能的迅速发展，呼吁“加强网络防御”以应对复杂的攻击，反映出一种审慎的认知，即忽视未来的威胁可能导致严重的后果。这种集体的远见提醒我们，要明智地为未来的挑战做好准备，而不是等到伤害发生。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: US man says ‘hold tight’ to loved ones after wife and toddler killed by lightning
title.zh: 美国男子在妻子和幼儿遭雷击身亡后，呼吁人们“紧紧抓住”所爱之人

summary.en: Kameron Glasgow of Florida is honoring his wife Kenya and two-year-old daughter Kennedi, who were killed by a rare lightning strike on August 23rd. At a vigil, he urged others to "hold tight" to their loved ones.
summary.zh: 佛罗里达州的卡梅隆·格拉斯戈正在悼念他于8月23日在一场罕见的雷击中丧生的妻子肯尼亚和两岁的女儿肯尼迪。在一次守夜活动中，他敦促他人“紧紧抓住”他们的亲人。

body.en: Kameron Glasgow of Florida honors wife Kenya and daughter Kennedi at local vigil after last week’s tragedy A Florida man whose wife and toddler daughter were killed by a lightning strike while he was near them recently has implored people to “hold … tight” to their loved ones. Kameron Glasgow made that arresting remark to local media at a weekend gathering honoring the memories of his wife, Kenya, and two-year-old daughter Kennedi after they died on 23 August from an exceedingly rare cause. Continue reading...
body.zh: 佛罗里达州卡梅隆·格拉斯哥在上周的悲剧发生后，在当地守夜纪念妻子肯尼亚和女儿肯尼迪。佛罗里达州一名男子的妻子和蹒跚学步的女儿最近在他附近时被雷击身亡，他恳求人们“紧紧抓住”他们的亲人。卡梅伦·格拉斯哥在周末聚会上向当地媒体发表了这一引人注目的言论，纪念他的妻子肯尼亚和两岁的女儿肯尼迪，他们于 8 月 23 日因极其罕见的原因去世。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The suddenness of Kameron Glasgow's loss, losing his wife and daughter to a lightning strike, is a stark reminder of life's fragility. In the face of such profound grief, his plea to "hold tight" to loved ones resonates deeply, pointing to the preciousness of human connection amidst life's unpredictable storms. We are reminded of the ultimate hope found in...
reflection.zh: 卡梅隆·格拉斯戈的突然丧妻丧女之痛，因一场雷击而变得尤为惨烈，这是对生命脆弱性的严峻提醒。面对如此深切的悲痛，他呼吁“紧紧抓住”亲人的话语，在生命不可预测的风暴中，深刻地触及了人际关系的可贵。我们被提醒，在雅伟最终的应许中——他要擦去一切眼泪，不再有悲伤和死亡——我们能找到最终的盼望。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Recording a rainforest before Indonesia’s new capital changes it
title.zh: 在印尼新首都改变它之前录制雨林

summary.en: Researchers in East Kalimantan, Indonesian Borneo, have deployed audio recorders across 20 sites over 18 months to capture the sounds of wildlife, including gibbons, frogs, hornbills, and insects. This effort aims to establish a baseline ecological record before the development of Indonesia's new capital city,...
summary.zh: 在印尼婆罗洲东加里曼丹，研究人员在18个月内于20个地点部署了音频记录器，以捕捉包括长臂猿、青蛙、犀鸟和昆虫在内的野生动物的声音。此举旨在为印度尼西亚新首都努桑塔拉的开发可能改变周边景观之前，建立一个基线的生态记录。

body.en: Founder’s Briefs: An occasional series where Mongabay founder Rhett Ayers Butler shares analysis, perspectives and story summaries. In the forests around Pemaluan in East Kalimantan, Indonesian Borneo, researchers led by Wendy Erb at the Cornell K. Lisa Yang Center for Conservation Bioacoustics in the U.S. have placed audio recorders on mountains, beside caves, and among mangroves. Over 18 months, they sampled 20 sites, collecting the calls of gibbons, frogs, hornbills, insects, and other wildlife. They want to establish a baseline before Nusantara, Indonesia’s new capital city, alters the surrounding landscape, according to a video produced by Mongabay, Scientific American, and Project Multatuli. Nusantara is being built in East Kalimantan province to relieve some of Jakarta’s congestion and pressure from land subsidence. Its planners describe a “smart forest city” where development and biodiversity can coexist. Roads, apartment buildings, a hotel, and a presidential palace have already appeared. Construction and chainsaws are becoming part of the local soundscape. The recordings will allow scientists to compare conditions over time. They may show where species remain, where they decline, and whether development is pushing wildlife into other areas. The findings could also help identify places where conservation measures are most needed. The project also records knowledge held by the Indigenous Balik people. Animal calls have long helped them interpret the forest. Gibbons marked the approach of dawn and, in unusual circumstances, were thought to warn of a death in the village. The great argus (Argusianus argus), a large pheasant native to the island’s forests,…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 创始人简介：Mongabay 创始人 Rhett Ayers Butler 分享分析、观点和故事摘要的临时系列。在印度尼西亚婆罗洲东加里曼丹的佩马陆安周围的森林中，美国康奈尔大学 K.丽莎杨生物声学保护中心的温迪·埃尔布 (Wendy Erb) 领导的研究人员在山上、洞穴旁边和红树林中放置了录音机。在 18 个月的时间里，他们对 20 个地点进行了采样，收集了长臂猿、青蛙、犀鸟、昆虫和其他野生动物的叫声。根据 Mongabay、《科学美国人》和 Project Multatuli 制作的一段视频，他们希望在印度尼西亚新首都努桑塔拉改变周围景观之前建立一条基线。 Nusantara 正在东加里曼丹省兴建，以缓解雅加达的交通拥堵和地面沉降带来的压力。它的规划者描述了一个“智慧森林城市”，发展与生物多样性可以共存。道路、公寓楼、酒店和总统府已经出现。建筑和电锯正在成为当地音景的一部分。这些记录将使科学家能够比较一段时间内的情况。它们可能会显示物种在哪里仍然存在，在哪里衰落，以及发展是否正在将野生动物推向其他地区。研究结果还可以帮助确定最需要采取保护措施的地方。该项目还记录了巴利克原住民所拥有的知识。长期以来，动物的叫声一直帮助他们解读森林。吉本斯标志着黎明的到来，在不寻常的情况下，人们认为这是在警告村里有人死亡。大乌雉 (Argusianus argus) 是一种原产于岛上森林的大型雉鸡，……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The intricate symphony of the rainforest, captured by researchers, speaks to the profound wisdom woven into creation. Each call, from the gibbon's song to the insect's buzz, is a testament to the Creator's artistry and the complex systems He sustains. As development approaches, this sonic archive serves as a reminder of the irreplaceable beauty and...
reflection.zh: 研究人员捕捉到的雨林复杂交响乐，体现了造物主编织进受造界的深邃智慧。从长臂猿的歌声到昆虫的嗡嗡声，每一个叫声都证明了造物主的艺术造诣和他所维系的复杂系统。随着开发的临近，这个声音档案提醒我们大自然不可替代的美丽和精巧设计，促使我们去欣赏和保护它。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Bhutan hosts first ‘conscious food summit’ amid threats to global supplies
title.zh: 不丹主办首届“有意识食品峰会”，以应对全球供应威胁

summary.en: Organizers state that people must revive their spiritual connection with food amidst the dual threats of the climate crisis and conflict. Addressing the damaged food system, strained by climate-driven extreme weather and conflict, requires more than just economic solutions and intensive farming, according to the...
summary.zh: 组织者表示，在气候危机和冲突的双重威胁下，人们必须重拾与食物的精神联系。据峰会组织者称，修复受气候驱动的极端天气和冲突影响的脆弱食品系统，需要的不仅仅是经济解决方案和集约化农业。

body.en: Organisers say people must revive spiritual relationship with food amid double threat of climate crisis and conflict Mending the broken food system under the threat of climate-driven weather extremes will require more than economic fixes and intensive agriculture, according to the organisers of a pioneering summit this week, who say the world must revive its spiritual relationship with food. Delegates from more than 60 countries and the UN will gather for the next five days in Paro in the tiny Himalayan nation of Bhutan for the world’s first “conscious food summit”, which will bring together governments and farmers, mindfulness experts and yoga therapists. Continue reading...
body.zh: 组织者表示，在气候危机和冲突的双重威胁下，人们必须恢复与食物的精神关系 本周举行的一次开创性峰会的组织者表示，在气候驱动的极端天气威胁下修复破碎的粮食系统需要的不仅仅是经济修复和集约化农业，他们表示世界必须恢复与食物的精神关系。来自 60 多个国家和联合国的代表将在接下来的五天内齐聚喜马拉雅山小国不丹的帕罗，参加世界首届“有意识的食品峰会”，届时各国政府和农民、正念专家和瑜伽治疗师将齐聚一堂。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As delegates gather in Bhutan for the first 'conscious food summit,' they are reminded that food is not merely a commodity but a gift from creation, declared 'very good' by its Maker. This perspective calls for a deeper reverence and responsibility in how we produce, consume, and relate to the sustenance that nourishes us.
reflection.zh: 当代表们齐聚不丹参加首届“有意识食品峰会”时，他们被提醒食物不仅仅是一种商品，而是造物主所宣告的“甚好”的创造之礼。这一视角呼吁我们在生产、消费和对待滋养我们的食物时，怀有更深的敬畏和责任感。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: ‘You can’t protect what you don’t know:’ Interview with marine scientist Loyiso Dunga
title.zh: “你不知道就无法保护：”海洋科学家洛伊索·东加访谈

summary.en: Scientist Loyiso Dunga began mapping the Great African Seaforest in 2016, an 800-mile kelp forest along South Africa's coast. Growing up in a coastal community, he considered the ocean sacred, but a snorkeling trip in 2016 was his first time experiencing it for recreation, which enchanted him. His research now focuses...
summary.zh: 科学家洛伊索·东加于2016年开始绘制非洲大海洋森林的地图，这是一片绵延800英里的海藻林，横跨南非的两段海岸和两大洋。他在沿海社区长大，视海洋为神圣之地，但2016年的一次浮潜经历让他首次以娱乐的心态进入海洋，并为此着迷。他目前的研究重点是评估海藻生态系统。

body.en: CAPE TOWN — When scientist Loyiso Dunga began mapping the Great African Seaforest in 2016, he decided to go snorkeling. The South African section of the kelp forest stretches around 800 miles or 1,300 kilometers, straddling two coasts and two oceans. Dunga grew up in a coastal community, Nqabara, in South Africa’s Wild Coast. As a member of the Xhosa nation, the ocean was kin or family to Dunga, and a sacred place. But that snorkeling trip was the first time he went into the ocean for fun. “That moment enchanted me,” said Dunga, who lives in Cape Town. Dunga’s research is now focused on evaluating kelp ecosystems. He works in South Africa as the executive director for the Seas of Good Hope program and globally with the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) and the Kelp Forest Alliance, a group that is dedicated to protecting over 9 million acres (3.6 million hectares) of kelp forests by 2040. But, for this conservation work to succeed, Dunga says that Indigenous wisdom, science and policy must be better connected. Dunga founded Asili Blue Renaissance, a nonprofit, to provide diverse, legitimate ocean conservation measures, including working with Indigenous communities. Dunga is now working on an initiative with the Kelp Forest Alliance to rename global kelp forests by their Indigenous names. Mongabay spoke with Dunga on the phone about his work. The interview has been edited for length and clarity. Loyiso Dunga. Image courtesy of Loyiso Dunga. Mongabay: How did you first become…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 开普敦——2016 年，当科学家洛伊索·邓加 (Loyiso Dunga) 开始绘制非洲大海洋森林地图时，他决定去浮潜。南非的海带森林绵延约 800 英里或 1,300 公里，横跨两个海岸和两个海洋。邓加在南非狂野海岸的恩卡巴拉沿海社区长大。作为科萨民族的一员，海洋是邓加的亲人或家人，也是一个神圣的地方。但那次浮潜是他第一次下海玩耍。 “那一刻让我着迷，”住在开普敦的邓加说。邓加的研究现在集中在评估海带生态系统。他在南非担任好望海计划的执行董事，并在全球范围内与国际自然保护联盟 (IUCN) 和海带森林联盟合作，该组织致力于到 2040 年保护超过 900 万英亩（360 万公顷）的海带森林。但是，邓加表示，为了使这项保护工作取得成功，必须将土著智慧、科学和政策更好地结合起来。邓加创立了非营利组织阿斯利蓝色复兴组织，提供多样化、合法的海洋保护措施，包括与原住民社区合作。邓加目前正在与海带森林联盟合作开展一项倡议，以原住民名称重新命名全球海带森林。 Mongabay 在电话中与 Dunga 谈论了他的工作。为了篇幅和清晰度，采访内容经过编辑。洛伊索·邓加。图片由洛伊索·邓加提供。 Mongabay：你最初是如何成为的……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The vastness and intricate beauty of the Great African Seaforest, as explored by Loyiso Dunga, speak to the profound wisdom inherent in Yahweh's creation. Dunga's personal enchantment with this underwater world mirrors the awe we can feel when contemplating the sheer diversity and complexity of life, reminding us of the Creator's masterful design.
reflection.zh: 洛伊索·东加所探索的非洲大海洋森林的广阔与精妙之美，彰显了雅伟创造中所蕴含的深邃智慧。东加对这个水下世界的个人迷恋，呼应了我们在沉思生命的多样性和复杂性时所能感受到的敬畏之情，提醒我们造物主的精湛设计。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: ‘Breakthrough’ as Turkmenistan starts fixing ‘mindboggling’ methane mega-leaks
title.zh: 土库曼斯坦开始修复“惊人”的甲烷巨型泄漏点

summary.en: Turkmenistan has begun repairing significant methane leaks from its aging oil and gas facilities, a move praised as a breakthrough. Methane is a potent greenhouse gas, and addressing these leaks is seen as a rapid and effective climate action.
summary.zh: 土库曼斯坦已开始修复其老旧油气设施的重大甲烷泄漏点，此举被誉为一项突破。甲烷是一种强效温室气体，解决这些泄漏被视为一项快速有效的气候行动。

body.en: Secretive state begins repairs on ageing facilities after being revealed as worst country for leaks of potent greenhouse gas Turkmenistan has started plugging the mega-leaks of methane that spew from its ageing oil and gas facilities, the latest UN data shows, in a move hailed as a breakthrough. Methane, also called natural or fossil gas, is a potent greenhouse gas. It traps 80 times more heat than carbon dioxide and causes 25% of global heating today. Stopping leaks can be quick and cheap and, because methane breaks down in the atmosphere far quicker than CO2, this has a rapid impact, with some experts calling it the climate “emergency brake”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 联合国最新数据显示，在被揭露为强效温室气体泄漏最严重的国家后，土库曼斯坦开始修复老化设施，土库曼斯坦已开始堵塞其老化石油和天然气设施喷出的大量甲烷泄漏，此举被誉为一项突破。甲烷，也称为天然气体或化石气体，是一种有效的温室气体。它吸收的热量是二氧化碳的 80 倍，造成了当今全球 25% 的热量。阻止泄漏既快捷又便宜，而且由于甲烷在大气中的分解速度比二氧化碳快得多，因此会产生迅速的影响，一些专家称其为气候“紧急刹车”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news from Turkmenistan highlights a crucial step in addressing environmental damage. It reminds us that the Earth and all its resources are ultimately the possession of Yahweh. Our stewardship of creation, including fixing leaks that harm the atmosphere, is a responsibility before the Creator.
reflection.zh: 来自土库曼斯坦的消息强调了应对环境损害的关键一步。它提醒我们，地球及其所有资源最终都属于雅伟。我们对受造界的管理，包括修复损害大气的泄漏，是面对造物主的一项责任。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: One dead and 15 people may be missing after flash flood in Arizona’s Grand Canyon
title.zh: 亚利桑那州大峡谷山洪暴发一人死亡，15人可能失踪

summary.en: One person died and approximately 15 people are missing or unaccounted for following a major flash flood that swept through Arizona's Grand Canyon National Park on Saturday afternoon. Over 60 people were evacuated from the Bright Angel Canyon and Phantom Ranch area by Sunday morning.
summary.zh: 周六下午，一场大规模的洪水席卷了亚利桑那州的大峡谷国家公园，造成一人死亡，约15人失踪或下落不明。截至周日上午，已有60多人从亮天使峡谷和幻影牧场地区被疏散。

body.en: Dozens evacuated after flash-flood event near Bright Angel Canyon and Phantom Ranch, officials say One person died and about 15 people were missing or unaccounted for after a major flash flood swept through the Grand Canyon national park in Arizona on Saturday afternoon, according to the National Park Service. The flash-flood event occurred in the area of Bright Angel Canyon and the Phantom Ranch, where park staff and the Arizona department of public safety had evacuated more than 60 people as of Sunday morning. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据国家公园管理局称，周六下午，一场特大山洪席卷了亚利桑那州大峡谷国家公园，官方称，光明天使峡谷和幻影牧场附近的山洪爆发后，数十人被疏散，造成一人死亡、约 15 人失踪或下落不明。山洪爆发发生在光明天使峡谷和幻影牧场地区，截至周日上午，公园工作人员和亚利桑那州公共安全部门已疏散了 60 多人。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The raw power of nature, as seen in the Grand Canyon flash flood, reminds us of the deep distress that creation experiences. Romans 8:22 speaks of the whole of creation groaning in travail, awaiting redemption. In moments of tragedy, we lament the brokenness of our world and pray for the day when all things are made new.
reflection.zh: 大峡谷山洪暴发所展现出的自然力量，提醒我们受造界所经历的深切痛苦。罗马书8:22提到，万物都在一同劳苦，盼望得赎。在悲剧时刻，我们哀叹世界的破碎，并祈求那万物更新的日子。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: ‘It was like fighting a dinosaur’: Sydney shark attack survivor recalls left hook that helped save her life
title.zh: “就像在与恐龙搏斗”：悉尼鲨鱼袭击幸存者回忆用左勾拳救了自己一命

summary.en: Leah Stewart, who lost an arm after a shark attack at Sydney's Coogee beach, described punching a four-meter great white shark as it lunged at her. She recounted asking herself 'which limb am I willing to lose' as she fought back against the predator.
summary.zh: 在悉尼库吉海滩遭遇鲨鱼袭击并失去一条手臂的莉亚·斯图尔特（Leah Stewart）描述了她如何用一记“左勾拳”击退一条四米长的巨鲨。她回忆说，在与鲨鱼搏斗时，她问自己“我愿意失去哪条肢体”。

body.en: Leah Stewart, who was bitten while swimming at Coogee beach, says she asked herself ‘which limb am I willing to lose’ as she fought back An Australian woman who lost an arm after a shark attack at a Sydney beach has described delivering a “left hook” punch to the four-metre great white as its open mouth came within centimetres of her face. Leah Stewart, 34, a teacher and mother of a one-year-old, was attacked by the shark while on a morning swim at Coogee beach in Sydney’s eastern suburbs on 13 June. Continue reading...
body.zh: 莉亚·斯图尔特(Leah Stewart)在库吉海滩游泳时被咬伤，她在反击时问自己“我愿意失去哪一条肢体”。一名在悉尼海滩遭遇鲨鱼袭击后失去手臂的澳大利亚妇女描述，当鲨鱼张开的嘴距离她的脸只有几厘米时，她向这条四米长的大白鲨打出了“左勾拳”。 34 岁的 Leah Stewart 是一名教师，也是一名一岁孩子的母亲，6 月 13 日，她在悉尼东郊库吉海滩晨泳时遭到鲨鱼袭击。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Leah Stewart’s harrowing encounter with a great white shark highlights the primal instinct for survival when faced with overwhelming danger. Her courageous fight back, even as she contemplated losing a limb, speaks to the human spirit’s capacity to resist and overcome when confronted by forces that threaten to consume it. It reminds us that even in the face...
reflection.zh: 莉亚·斯图尔特与大白鲨惊心动魄的遭遇，凸显了在面对压倒性危险时，人类最原始的生存本能。她勇敢地反击，甚至在思考失去肢体的可能时，也展现了人类精神在面对威胁要吞噬自己的力量时的抵抗和克服能力。这提醒我们，即使面对巨大的邪恶，求生和为生命而战的意志也可以是一种强大的力量。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: ‘Lost’ for 170 years, rare plant recorded in Sri Lanka
title.zh: 失传170年，稀有植物在斯里兰卡被重新记录

summary.en: Researchers have found a population of the extremely rare plant species, Indianthus virgatus, last recorded in Sri Lanka in 1855. The plant, which grows in lowland forest fragments, was presumed extinct in the country despite being known from many locations in India. The finding was documented in a recent study.
summary.zh: 研究人员发现了一个极其稀有的植物物种印度藤（Indianthus virgatus）的种群，该物种上次在斯里兰卡被记录是在1855年。这种生长在低地森林碎片中的植物，尽管在印度有许多分布点，但在斯里兰卡被认为已灭绝。这一发现已在最近的一项研究中得到记录。

body.en: Researchers have a population of an extremely rare plant species, last recorded in Sri Lanka in 1855, growing in a lowland forest fragment along the Sitawaka Ganga River. Documenting the finding in a recent study, researchers write that the plant, Indianthus virgatus, while officially listed as critically endangered in Sri Lanka, was presumed possibly extinct in the wild in the country. I. virgatus, which has small white flowers, grows in the understory of wet tropical forests. It’s known from some 150 locations in India, but the only verified record of the plant in Sri Lanka is from a specimen collected in 1855, the study says. Using a combination of historical records across India and Sri Lanka, and predictive habitat modeling to identify potential habitats, researchers looked for the plant in southwestern Sri Lanka, in Sabaragamuwa Province. In January 2025, the research team successfully located a small population of I. virgatus of 70 to 100 individuals. This population was found in an area that researchers had predicted to be highly suitable for the species. I. virgatus, which is the only species within the Indianthus genus, has unique evolutionary and biogeographical context, said Vivek Pandi, coauthor of the study and assistant professor of ecology and evolutionary biology at Manipal Academy of Higher Education, India. The species has a disjunct occurrence across the Indian subcontinent and Sri Lanka, Pandi told Mongabay by email, meaning populations of the species are separated by a large geographical gap. This raises an intriguing question, he added,…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 研究人员掌握了一种极其稀有的植物物种，最后一次记录于 1855 年，生长在西塔瓦卡恒河沿岸的低地森林碎片中。研究人员在最近的一项研究中记录了这一发现，并写道，这种植物——印度草（Indianthus virgatus）虽然在斯里兰卡被正式列为极度濒危植物，但据推测在该国的野外可能已经灭绝。 I. virgatus 开有小白花，生长在潮湿的热带森林的林下。研究称，印度约有 150 个地点有这种植物，但斯里兰卡有关该植物的唯一经过验证的记录来自于 1855 年采集的标本。研究人员结合印度和斯里兰卡的历史记录以及预测栖息地模型来识别潜在的栖息地，在斯里兰卡西南部的萨巴拉格穆沃省寻找这种植物。 2025年1月，研究小组成功找到了一小群I. virgatus，数量为70至100只。该种群是在研究人员预测非常适合该物种生存的地区发现的。该研究的合著者、印度马尼帕尔高等教育学院生态学和进化生物学助理教授 Vivek Pandi 表示，I. virgatus 是印度花属中唯一的物种，具有独特的进化和生物地理背景。潘迪通过电子邮件告诉 Mongabay，该物种在印度次大陆和斯里兰卡都有分布，这意味着该物种的种群之间存在很大的地理差距。他补充道，这提出了一个有趣的问题……本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The rediscovery of Indianthus virgatus, a plant unseen in Sri Lanka for 170 years, is a testament to the enduring wonders of creation. It reminds us that even what seems lost can be found through diligent observation and care, reflecting the deep wisdom embedded in the natural world that Job spoke of. This finding offers a quiet hope, showing that life can...
reflection.zh: 印度藤（Indianthus virgatus）在斯里兰卡消失了170年后被重新发现，这是大自然持久奇迹的证明。它提醒我们，即使是看似失落的东西，也能通过勤奋的观察和关怀被找回，这呼应了约伯所说的，自然界蕴含着深刻的智慧。这一发现带来了平静的希望，表明生命可以延续并被重新发现，这是雅伟创造大能的微妙回响。

title.en: In Africa, a Growing Underground Solar Boom
title.zh: 非洲地下太阳能蓬勃发展

summary.en: Households and businesses across Africa are driving a significant, yet largely unrecorded, solar energy boom. This rapid expansion of rooftop arrays and small-scale systems is pushing new solar installations to record levels, despite often being overlooked in official statistics.
summary.zh: 非洲各地的家庭和企业正在推动一场规模可观但大多未被官方记录的太阳能热潮。屋顶太阳能板和其他小型系统的迅速普及，正将新增太阳能装机量推向创纪录水平，尽管这些数据常被官方统计所忽视。

body.en:
Households and businesses are driving a solar boom in Africa, where rooftop arrays and other small systems account for the bulk of new solar installations. But this rapid buildout, which is driving solar additions to record levels, is largely unaccounted for in official statistics, analysts say.

“The rapid spread of distributed solar in sub-Saharan Africa is an underreported success story,” write analysts at the energy think tank Ember and the African Tech Futures Lab. “However, since African countries are running blind to this change, they are not reflecting this rise in distributed solar in their plans.”

Because most distributed solar systems are not tracked or regulated, most households cannot sell their surplus power back to the grid, analysts say. Ultimately, the lack of data on distributed solar could lead countries to underinvest in the batteries and grid infrastructure needed to store and distribute solar energy, and to overinvest in fossil fuels.

Because official statistics are lacking, analysts used customs data to track the flow of solar equipment to Africa from China, the biggest manufacturer of solar panels globally. They found that Africa will add the equivalent of 17 gigawatts of solar capacity this year, more than enough to meet the continent’s average yearly growth in demand. Some 36 countries will install record volumes of solar in 2026, while 19 will install more than twice as much solar as they did last year.

In countries with rickety power grids, many people rely on diesel generators to cope with recurrent blackouts. But analysts say the Iran war has pushed up diesel prices, making solar a more attractive alternative. “Generating the same electricity from a diesel generator as from a solar panel would cost as much in diesel, every three months, as the solar panel itself,” they write. In almost every country in Africa, more than half of solar capacity installed since 2023 is distributed, analysts estimate.

“This transition is chaotic and disruptive, and far from the orderly model planned in national strategies,” said Joel Nana, research director at African Tech Futures Lab. “The choice now is whether these distributed assets remain a parallel power system that compensates for grid failure or are integrated in ways that unleash a wider range of benefits.”
body.zh: 家庭和企业正在推动非洲太阳能热潮，其中屋顶阵列和其他小型系统占新太阳能装置的大部分。但分析人士表示，这种快速建设将太阳能发电量推向创纪录水平，但官方统计数据很大程度上没有考虑到这一点。 能源智库 Ember 和非洲科技期货实验室的分析师写道：“分布式太阳能在撒哈拉以南非洲的迅速普及是一个被低估的成功故事。” “然而，由于非洲国家对这一变化视而不见，他们没有在计划中反映分布式太阳能的增长。” 分析师表示，由于大多数分布式太阳能系统没有被跟踪或监管，因此大多数家庭无法将剩余电力卖回电网。最终，缺乏分布式太阳能数据可能导致各国对存储和分配太阳能所需的电池和电网基础设施投资不足，并对化石燃料投资过度。 由于缺乏官方统计数据，分析师利用海关数据来追踪从全球最大太阳能电池板制造商中国流向非洲的太阳能设备。他们发现，非洲今年将新增相当于 17 吉瓦的太阳能装机容量，足以满足非洲大陆年均增长的需求。到 2026 年，约 36 个国家的太阳能安装量将创历史新高，其中 19 个国家的太阳能安装量将是去年的两倍多。 在电网不稳定的国家，许多人依靠柴油发电机来应对经常性的停电。但分析人士表示，伊朗战争推高了柴油价格，使太阳能成为更具吸引力的替代方案。他们写道：“每三个月用柴油发电机产生与太阳能电池板相同的电力，柴油成本与太阳能电池板本身一样多。”分析师估计，自 2023 年以来，非洲几乎每个国家安装的太阳能发电量一半以上都是分布式的。 非洲科技未来实验室研究主任乔尔·纳纳表示：“这种转变是混乱和破坏性的，与国家战略中规划的有序模式相去甚远。” “现在的选择是，这些分布式资产是否仍然是一个并行电力系统，以补偿电网故障，或者以释放更广泛效益的方式进行集成。”

reflection.en: The 'underground solar boom' in Africa, where households and businesses are rapidly adopting small-scale systems, highlights a profound human capacity for discernment and innovation. As people seek practical solutions for their energy needs, they embody the wisdom of acquiring knowledge and applying it to improve daily life, even when official recognition...
reflection.zh: 非洲“地下太阳能热潮”中，家庭和企业迅速采用小型系统，这凸显了人类卓越的洞察力和创新能力。当人们寻求实用的能源解决方案时，他们体现了获取知识并将其应用于改善日常生活的智慧，即便官方认可迟迟未到。这种足智多谋的精神反映了人类深入理解和利用周围世界以造福自身的内在动力。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: A Hard-Won Rule to Cut Chemical Plant Pollution Is Being Unraveled
title.zh: 一项来之不易的削减化工厂污染的法规正在被废除

summary.en: In 2024, the Biden administration enacted wide-ranging regulations to protect communities near petrochemical plants from air toxics. The Trump administration has since granted exemptions to scores of polluting facilities and is working to rewrite the long-awaited rule.
summary.zh: 2024年，拜登政府颁布了广泛的法规，以保护石化厂附近的社区免受有毒空气的侵害。此后，特朗普政府已向数十家污染设施授予豁免权，并正在着手修改这项期待已久的法规。

body.en:
In 2024, the Biden administration enacted wide-ranging regulations to protect communities near petrochemical plants from air toxics. The Trump administration has since granted exemptions to scores of polluting facilities and is working to rewrite the long-awaited rule.

In April 2024, Tish Taylor and her father, Robert, stood behind President Joe Biden’s Environmental Protection Agency chief, Michael Regan, as he signed a regulation designed to dramatically reduce toxic pollution from petrochemical plants like those that cluster near the Taylors’ homes along the lower Mississippi River, in Louisiana.

Taylor struggled not to cry through the signing ceremony, which followed years of demands from communities like hers — in the 85-mile corridor between New Orleans and Baton Rouge that has become known as Cancer Alley — for tighter limits on plants’ emissions. The new regulation, known as the HON rule, was “a wonderful gift to generations ahead of us,” Taylor said. “It’s hard for me to find the words to say how validated we felt.”

For decades, regulations on emissions of hazardous chemicals such as toluene, ethylene oxide, and vinyl chloride have been weaker than restrictions on more common pollutants, such as those emitted by vehicles.

The Biden administration took major steps to strengthen Clean Air Act rules on those hazardous air pollutants, and the HON rule was a centerpiece of that effort. Toughening requirements on six different pollutants at more than 200 petrochemical plants , it was one of a slate of regulations the Biden administration enacted on air toxics, each covering a specific industry, from steelmaking to tire manufacturing.

But shortly after President Donald Trump began his second term, his administration began unraveling those rules, including the one the Taylors had so recently celebrated. Last year, Trump granted two-year exemptions from the HON rule to more than 50 petrochemical facilities. This July, he issued 20 more temporary exemptions, and the EPA said it would propose a rewrite of the regulation this fall. The new version is all but certain to significantly scale back the rule’s protections.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

“Everything that the Biden administration did to help protect us was pretty much just thrown in the garbage,” Tish Taylor said in July, and replaced by “a death sentence.” St. John the Baptist Parish, where her family lives, has the country’s highest risk of cancer from air pollution — nearly 50 times the national average. A disproportionate percentage of those exposed to the highest levels of pollution in the region are Black.

A set of amendments to several existing regulations on toxic air pollutants, the HON rule — which stands for Hazardous...
body.zh: 2024 年，拜登政府颁布了广泛的法规，保护石化厂附近的社区免受空气有毒物质的影响。此后，特朗普政府已对数十家污染设施给予豁免，并正在努力重写这项期待已久的规则。 2024 年 4 月，蒂什·泰勒和她的父亲罗伯特支持乔·拜登总统的环境保护局局长迈克尔·里根签署了一项法规，旨在大幅减少石化厂（例如路易斯安那州密西西比河下游泰勒家附近聚集的石化厂）的有毒污染。 泰勒在签字仪式上努力不哭，多年来，像她这样的社区——位于新奥尔良和巴吞鲁日之间的 85 英里走廊，被称为“癌症巷”——要求更严格地限制植物排放。泰勒说，这项被称为 HON 规则的新规定是“给我们前几代人的一份美妙礼物”。 “我很难找到合适的词来表达我们的感受。” 几十年来，对甲苯、环氧乙烷和氯乙烯等危险化学品排放的法规一直弱于对车辆排放等更常见污染物的限制。 拜登政府采取了重大措施，加强《清洁空气法》对这些有害空气污染物的规定，而 HON 规定是这一努力的核心。这是拜登政府针对空气有毒物质颁布的一系列法规之一，对 200 多家石化厂的六种不同污染物提出了严格要求，每项法规都涵盖从炼钢到轮胎制造等特定行业。 但在唐纳德·特朗普总统开始第二个任期后不久，他的政府开始解开这些规则，包括泰勒家族最近庆祝的规则。去年，特朗普向 50 多家石化设施授予两年 HON 规则豁免。今年 7 月，他又发布了 20 项临时豁免，美国环保署表示将在今年秋天提议重写该法规。新版本几乎肯定会大幅缩减该规则的保护范围。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 蒂什·泰勒 (Tish Taylor) 在 7 月表示：“拜登政府为保护我们所做的一切几乎都被扔进了垃圾堆，取而代之的是“死刑”。她家人居住的施洗者圣约翰教区因空气污染而患癌症的风险是全国最高的——几乎是全国平均水平的 50 倍。在该地区暴露于最高污染水平的人群中，黑人所占比例过高。 HON 规则是对多项有关有毒空气污染物的现行法规的一系列修正案，它代表危险……

reflection.en: The story of Tish Taylor and her father, who stood by as a vital regulation was signed to protect communities from toxic air, highlights the constant need for leaders to uphold justice. Yahweh's word in Jeremiah 22:3 calls those in authority to "do justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who has been robbed." When hard-won...
reflection.zh: 蒂什·泰勒和她的父亲见证了一项旨在保护社区免受有毒空气侵害的重要法规的签署，这个故事凸显了领导者维护正义的持续必要性。雅伟在耶利米书22:3中的话语呼吁掌权者“施行公平和公义，从欺压者手中拯救被抢夺的”。当像密西西比河下游沿岸社区这样脆弱的群体，他们来之不易的保护措施受到威胁时，这提醒我们，在灵性和人性上，都需要有公义的治理来保障所有人的福祉。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Access to Urban Woodlands Linked With Lower Use of Antidepressants
title.zh: 城市林地与较低的抗抑郁药使用率相关

summary.en: A study in Scotland has found that living near accessible urban woodlands is linked to a significantly lower likelihood of being prescribed antidepressants. The research examined the impact of the Woods In and Around Towns (WIAT) program, which aims to improve mental health by creating and maintaining accessible...
summary.zh: 苏格兰的一项研究发现，居住在可及的城市林地附近，被开具抗抑郁药的可能性会显著降低。该研究考察了“城镇内及周边林地”（WIAT）项目的影响，该项目旨在通过在贫困地区创建和维护可及的林地来改善心理健康。

body.en:
A study from Scotland found that living near an accessible urban woodland significantly lowered the likelihood of being prescribed antidepressants.

The research focused on Scotland’s Woods In and Around Towns program , which aims to plant, restore, or protect woodlands in deprived neighborhoods and make them accessible to the public by installing signs, trails, and walking paths. Launched in 2005, the WIAT program has revitalized nearly 30,000 acres of urban woodlands.

From the beginning, one of the central aims of the program has been to improve mental health. To gauge its success, researchers at the Universities of Edinburgh and Glasgow tracked more than 129,000 people across Scotland over five years. They found that when people moved to within a 10-minute walk of a WIAT woodland, their odds of being prescribed an antidepressant dropped by 10 percent, while their odds of being prescribed anti-anxiety medication dropped by 6 percent.

“Our results tell us that relatively modest investments in local green spaces can make a real difference to people’s mental health,” said lead author Scott Ogletree of the University of Edinburgh. The findings were published in The Lancet Planetary Health .

A host of prior studies have found that living near green spaces can reduce stress , improve moods , and lower the risk of developing anxiety or depression. Some research has even found that exposure to nature can help reduce violent crime. In light of the well-documented benefits of living near green spaces, the World Health Organization recommends urban planners establish at least 1 acre of green space within 1,000 feet of every home.
body.zh: 苏格兰的一项研究发现，居住在可到达的城市林地附近会显着降低服用抗抑郁药物的可能性。 该研究重点关注苏格兰城镇内及周边的森林计划，该计划旨在种植、恢复或保护贫困社区的林地，并通过安装标志、步道和步行道使公众能够进入这些林地。 WIAT 计划于 2005 年启动，已振兴了近 30,000 英亩的城市林地。 从一开始，该计划的中心目标之一就是改善心理健康。为了衡量其成功程度，爱丁堡大学和格拉斯哥大学的研究人员在五年内对苏格兰各地超过 129,000 人进行了追踪。他们发现，当人们搬到距离 WIAT 林地 10 分钟步行路程的地方时，他们服用抗抑郁药物的几率会下降 10%，而服用抗焦虑药物的几率会下降 6%。 “我们的研究结果告诉我们，对当地绿地的相对适度的投资可以对人们的心理健康产生真正的影响，”爱丁堡大学的主要作者斯科特·奥格特里说。研究结果发表在《柳叶刀行星健康》上。 先前的大量研究发现，居住在绿色空间附近可以减轻压力，改善情绪，并降低患焦虑或抑郁的风险。一些研究甚至发现，接触大自然有助于减少暴力犯罪。鉴于居住在绿色空间附近的好处已得到充分证明，世界卫生组织建议城市规划者在每个家庭 1,000 英尺范围内至少建立 1 英亩的绿色空间。

reflection.en: This study from Scotland offers a hopeful glimpse into how nature can be a balm for the soul. The finding that accessible urban woodlands correlate with lower antidepressant use suggests that proximity to green spaces can alleviate mental distress. It echoes the ancient truth that Yahweh "heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds," reminding us of...
reflection.zh: 这项来自苏格兰的研究为我们提供了一个充满希望的视角，展示了自然如何能抚慰心灵。研究发现，可及的城市林地与较低的抗抑郁药使用率相关，这表明亲近绿色空间可以缓解精神痛苦。这呼应了一个古老的真理：雅伟“医治伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处”，提醒我们可以在受造界中找到恢复的力量。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: The Black Garden review – haunting study of growing up in war-torn Nagorno-Karabakh
title.zh: 《黑花园》评论——对在战火纷飞的纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫长大的孩子的凄美研究

summary.en: Alexis Pazoumian’s documentary follows Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys whose lives will be unavoidably scarred by brutal conflict. After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, a decades-long territorial dispute exploded in the region of Nagorno-Karabakh, as its largely Armenian population fought against countless...
summary.zh: 亚历克西斯·帕祖米扬的纪录片讲述了萨姆维尔和阿沃两个十岁出头的男孩的故事，他们的生活将不可避免地被残酷的冲突所伤害。苏联于1991年解体后，一场持续数十年的领土争端在纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫地区爆发，当地主要是亚美尼亚人口与阿塞拜疆军队进行了无数次军事战役的斗争。这部影片拍摄历时三年，于2023年纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫分离主义政...

body.en: Alexis Pazoumian’s documentary follows Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys whose lives will be unavoidably scarred by brutal conflict After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, a decades-long territorial dispute exploded in the region of Nagorno-Karabakh, as its largely Armenian population fought against countless military campaigns from the Azerbaijani army. Shot over the course of three eventful years, which culminated in the surrender of Nagorno-Karabakh’s separatist government in 2023 , Alexis Pazoumian’s haunting documentary harnesses the collective turmoil that dominated generations of Armenians. From the elderly to the very young, the community are united by an unwavering sense of pride, one that carries them through never-ending bloodshed and displacement. The film opens with the harrowing sight of a bombed-out school in the small village of Talish, where childlike innocence contrasts with wartime trauma. Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys, roam through the wreckage and scavenge for remains of past normalcy, like the scattered notebooks left behind by their former classmates. The threat of the enemy, however, is drilled into every aspect of their daily life. At school, they learn how to assemble guns, and at family gatherings, they join in songs that speak of heroic valour. That the children here – boys and girls – will grow up to become soldiers is a foregone conclusion. Continue reading...
body.zh: 亚历克西斯·帕祖米安 (Alexis Pazoumian) 的纪录片讲述了萨姆维尔 (Samvel) 和阿沃 (Avo) 这两个青春期男孩的故事，他们的生活将不可避免地因残酷的冲突而受到创伤。 1991 年苏联解体后，纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫地区爆发了长达数十年的领土争端，该地区主要是亚美尼亚人，与阿塞拜疆军队的无数军事行动进行了斗争。亚历克西斯·帕祖米安 (Alexis Pazoumian) 这部令人难忘的纪录片历时三年多的时间拍摄，最终导致纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫分离主义政府于 2023 年投降，讲述了统治几代亚美尼亚人的集体动乱。从老年人到年幼的孩子，社区都以一种坚定不移的自豪感团结在一起，这种自豪感使他们经历了永无休止的流血和流离失所。影片以塔利什小村庄一所被炸毁的学校的悲惨景象开始，孩子般的纯真与战时的创伤形成鲜明对比。萨姆维尔和阿沃是两个青春期前的男孩，他们在废墟中漫步，寻找过去常态的遗迹，比如他们以前的同学留下的散落的笔记本。然而，敌人的威胁渗透到他们日常生活的方方面面。在学校，他们学习如何组装枪支，在家庭聚会上，他们一起唱颂英雄勇气的歌曲。这里的孩子们——男孩和女孩——长大后成为士兵已成定局。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary "The Black Garden" brings to light the profound impact of war on children, focusing on Samvel and Avo. Their young lives are shaped by conflict, a stark reminder of the voiceless who bear the brunt of adult disputes. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute."...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《黑花园》揭示了战争对儿童的深远影响，聚焦于萨姆维尔和阿沃。他们年幼的生活被冲突所塑造，这鲜明地提醒我们那些承受着成人争端重担的无声者。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能自辩的开口，为所有困苦者判定公正”。这部影片有力地证明了这一呼召，敦促我们铭记并倡导那些卷入全球冲突战火中的儿童。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: The Isaac Mizrahi Documentary ‘Unzipped’ Is the Ultimate ’90s Fashion Portrait — Watch the Trailer
title.zh: 纪录片《Unzipped》是终极的90年代时尚肖像——观看预告片

summary.en: Douglas Reeve's 1995 documentary follows Mizrahi into his 1994 fall collection. Access was helped amply by the fact that they were dating at the time.
summary.zh: 道格拉斯·里夫1995年的纪录片跟随米兹拉希进入他1994年的秋季系列。由于当时他们正在约会，因此获得了充分的便利。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

Filmmaker Douglas Keeve’s 1995 documentary “ Unzipped ” follows fashion designer and eventual mogul Isaac Mizrahi, then the director’s boyfriend, into his fall 1994 collection. The ’90s-centric movie remains the ultimate portrait of New York’s high fashion world at the time, with guest appearances including Cindy Crawford, Naomi Campbell, Linda Evangelista, and Kate Moss. Plus, the film won the audience award at the 1995 Sundance Film Festival. Now, Janus Films is bringing the movie back to theaters courtesy of a new restoration. Watch the trailer below.

Here’s the synopsis courtesy of Janus Films: “Designer Isaac Mizrahi proved a force of nature on the road to his legendary fall 1994 collection, a career-defining triumph that was documented with an effervescent intimacy by Douglas Keeve, Mizrahi’s then-partner. Both a time capsule of the buoyant, raucous 1990s, when pop culture and high art became interchangeable, and a vérité-style, in-the-trenches report on the daily agonies and ecstasies of the creative process, this seminal artistic portrait — sumptuously shot by Ellen Kuras and Robert Leacock — transcends glitz and glamour to offer an extraordinary view of the charisma and force of will inherent to genius, as well as its personal costs.” Related Stories ‘Coyote vs. Acme,’ Viewed as Unreleasable by Warner Bros., Just Beat a Jacob Elordi and Ridley Scott Movie at the Box Office From Timothée Chalamet and Tom Cruise to Cynthia Erivo: It’s Time for Some Overdue Actors to Finally Win an Oscar

Charli XCX recently told Vogue : “Directed by Douglas Keeve, it follows Isaac Mizrahi as he gets ready for his New York Fashion Week collection. If you love fashion, you have to see this documentary. All the legends are there — Kate, Naomi, Christy — and even Galliano and Polly Mellen. But most importantly, the film perfectly captures the artist’s creative process: bursts of inspiration, self-doubt, vulnerability, and finally, triumph.”

Janus Films opens “Unzipped” on Friday, September 25 at Film Forum in New York City. Then, the film opens in Los Angeles at the Laemmle Royal and Glendale on Friday, October 9. A national rollout will follow. The Sundance Institute and UCLA Film & Television Archive digitally restored the film.

reflection.en: The documentary 'Unzipped' offers a glimpse into the intense dedication and creative labor behind Isaac Mizrahi's 1994 fall fashion collection. It showcases the passion and effort poured into bringing a vision to life, reminding us that all work, whether in design or any other field, can be offered as a service to God.
reflection.zh: 纪录片《Unzipped》让我们得以一窥艾萨克·米兹拉希1994年秋季时装系列背后倾注的专注和创造性劳动。它展示了将一个愿景变为现实所付出的热情和努力，提醒我们，所有工作，无论是在设计领域还是其他任何领域，都可以作为对雅伟的服事。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Guardian-produced Gaza documentary from Oscar-winning Israeli directors of No Other Land to screen at Venice film festival
